Estudos de caso

Juntos, podemos reinventar sua empresa

Nossa ampla gama de capacidades, parcerias com ecossistemas e conhecimento inigualável do setor podem ajudar sua empresa a se tornar a próxima melhor versão de si mesma.

CAPACIDADES

As capacidades para sua empresa se reinventar

Nuvem

Close

Nuvem

Leve o mundo todo na nuvem

Todos os dias, a computação na nuvem se torna mais completa na condução da reinvenção e no atendimento às necessidades em constante mudança das pessoas pelo mundo todo.

Saiba mais

Customer Service

Close

Customer Service

Transforme o atendimento e o suporte em um mecanismo de crescimento

Interações impessoais e inconsistentes estão fazendo as organizações correr para entender como atender melhor os clientes. Experiências orientadas por dados, proativas, que parecem intuitivas, são essenciais para gerar novas oportunidades de crescimento.

Saiba mais

Cibersegurança

Close

Cibersegurança

Aumente a segurança cibernética hoje para ter um futuro sem riscos

Integre a cibersegurança em sua estratégia e ecossistema para proteger o valor, prevenir ameaças e construir confiança à medida que sua empresa cresce.

Saiba mais

Dados e Inteligência Artificial

Close

Dados e Inteligência Artificial

Use a IA com propósito

A IA está mais acessível do que nunca e transforma rapidamente as empresas e as formas como vivemos e trabalhamos. A maneira como você usa esse potencial é que determina o impacto e a posição que sua empresa conquistará para competir e alcançar novos patamares de desempenho.

Saiba mais

Engenharia Digital e Manufatura

Close

Engenharia Digital e Manufatura

Digitalize o que você faz, reinvente como você faz

Reinvente seus produtos e sua maneira de fabricá-los. Use dados, capacidades digitais e a inteligência artificial para aumentar a resiliência e a produtividade e melhorar a segurança e a sustentabilidade em toda a cadeia de valor.

Saiba mais

Parcerias de ecossistemas

Close

Parcerias de ecossistemas

Da mudança para o valor mais rápido

Adapte-se às coisas rapidamente com plataformas e aplicativos integrados que trazem novas capacidades do setor e da função, aproveite dados e IA e capacite seus funcionários para oferecer mais valor.

Saiba mais

Tecnologias Emergentes

Close

Tecnologias Emergentes

Molde o futuro

Em um mundo em rápida mudança, adote as tecnologias que surgem para transformar e alcançar maior eficiência, eficácia e inovação pioneira.

Saiba mais

Gestão de Riscos e Finanças

Close

Gestão de Riscos e Finanças

Invista para construir resiliência e reduzir o risco empresarial

Em meio à intensificação das disrupções no mercado e à crescente volatilidade dos negócios, há mais pressão sobre os Diretores de Finanças (CFOs) e de Riscos (CROs) para equilibrar múltiplas transformações interconectadas, mantendo o desempenho, a lucratividade e a segurança da empresa.

Saiba mais

Projetos de infraestrutura de capital

Close

Projetos de infraestrutura de capital

Projetos de infraestrutura de capital

Planeje, gerencie e execute projetos de capital eficientemente. Combine criatividade humana, dados e IA para entregar projetos em grande escala no prazo e no orçamento, alcançando objetivos mais amplos de investimento e sustentabilidade.

Saiba mais

Aprendizado

Close

Aprendizado

Seja um criador de talentos

A tecnologia desempenha um papel fundamental na reinvenção dos negócios, mas são as pessoas que determinam o seu sucesso. Como você pode desenvolver as habilidades que as pessoas querem e que você precisa para crescer mais rápido?

Saiba mais

Serviços Gerenciados Estratégicos

Close

Serviços Gerenciados Estratégicos

Mude mais e mais rápido

À medida que as organizações se esforçam para otimizar custos e acelerar o crescimento, os serviços gerenciados estratégicos podem ajudar a prepará-las melhor para reinventar operações e gerar valor holístico em grande escala.

Saiba mais

Marketing e Experiência

Close

Marketing e Experiência

Marketing para um mundo multidimensional

As opções se multiplicam. As demandas dos consumidores evoluem. O que é tendência hoje talvez não seja amanhã. A relevância é essencial para o crescimento – crie experiências com os clientes que acompanham o ritmo das mudanças.

Saiba mais

Metaverso

Close

Metaverso

Faça a mágica acontecer no metaverso

Os mundos físico e virtual estão se misturando. O metaverso oferece novas maneiras de se conectar, criar e consumir. E traz uma nova chance de fazer experiências totalmente inclusivas e responsáveis.

Saiba mais

Vendas e Comércio

Close

Vendas e Comércio

Comércio na velocidade da vida

O comércio se misturou na cultura à medida que as preferências mudaram – e continuam mudando. O desafio? Manter-se sempre atualizado. Continue sendo relevante, acompanhe o ritmo das coisas e transforme a complexidade em conveniência.

Saiba mais

Estratégia

Close

Estratégia

Liderança na próxima década

Assuma com coragem o compromisso com a reinvenção contínua e faça parte do pequeno, mas crescente número de empresas que estão alcançando novos níveis de crescimento rentável para os seus negócios, ao mesmo tempo em que fornecem maiores contribuições para a humanidade.

Saiba mais

Cadeias de suprimentos

Close

Cadeias de suprimentos

Lidere o futuro com as redes de cadeias de suprimentos

Antecipe-se e responda à demanda dos clientes. Resilientes desde a criação e capazes de aguentar disrupções, as redes de supply chain impulsionam a eficiência, a sustentabilidade e o crescimento.

Saiba mais

Sustentabilidade

Close

Sustentabilidade

O imperativo da sustentabilidade

A sustentabilidade tem a ver com questões ambientais, sociais e de governança. Toda organização deve abraçar a sustentabilidade para conseguir ser competitiva no futuro.

Saiba mais

Talento e Organização

Close

Talento e Organização

Impulsione o crescimento por meio das pessoas e da tecnologia

As organizações prósperas impulsionam as mudanças na interseção entre tecnologia e talento. A poderosa combinação entre dados e IA e criatividade humana de verdade cria novas estruturas de trabalho, funções e ambientes, que permitem que pessoas e empresas prosperem.

Saiba mais

Transformação Tecnológica

Close

Transformação Tecnológica

Transforme sua tecnologia para entregar mudanças mais rapidamente

Reinvente seu núcleo digital com as estratégias, os talentos e as práticas modernas para aumentar o ROI, impulsionar a eficiência e redirecionar os gastos para as inovações que impulsionam o crescimento.

Saiba mais

Mais de 350 parcerias para ajudar a acelerar as mudanças

Conheça todos os parceiros

INDÚSTRIAS

Experiência inigualável nos setores

Aeroespacial e Defesa

Close

Aeroespacial e Defesa

Navegue com coragem

Seja em termos de incerteza econômica, interrupções das cadeias de suprimentos ou lacunas de habilidades e expectativas sempre diferentes dos consumidores: os setores aeroespacial e de defesa sempre enfrentam desafios. Chegou a hora de abraçar uma mentalidade que prioriza a tecnologia digital.

Saiba mais

Automóvel

Close

Automóvel

Vá além do que já é comum

A indústria automotiva tradicional chegou a uma encruzilhada. Atualmente operamos em um ecossistema de mobilidade, partindo na direção da próxima iteração do setor automotivo. Para progredirmos, é hora de abraçar o ecossistema, colaborar além dos limites do nosso setor e encontrar outras maneiras de inovar e fazer parcerias de sucesso.

Saiba mais

Banca

Close

Banca

Construindo a próxima geração dos serviços bancários

A tecnologia mudou a forma como as pessoas e as empresas consomem serviços bancários, e as estratégias tradicionais não funcionam mais. Agora é a hora de abordagens novas e ousadas para lidar com a disrupção cada vez maior.

Saiba mais

Mercados de Capitais

Close

Mercados de Capitais

Mercados de Capitais: Encontre oportunidades em todos os lugares

Um número crescente de investidores de varejo. A transição para economias de baixo carbono. Investimentos em infraestrutura em mercados em crescimento. Para quem se reinventa, a mudança constante é também uma oportunidade constante.

Saiba mais

Química

Close

Química

Trabalhe com as mudanças como algo constante

Tradicionalmente vistas como maduras e estáticas, as indústrias químicas enfrentam cada vez mais pressão para serem proativas e acelerarem a inovação.

Saiba mais

Comunicações e Media

Close

Comunicações e Media

Seja hiperessencial para ser hiperconectado

As pessoas e as empresas estão on-line o tempo todo, seja assistindo algo ou trabalhando em um novo e inovador crescimento. Mantenha o engajamento e o sucesso desses players oferecendo as experiências e as capacidades contínuas que esperam e precisam.

Saiba mais

Bens de Consumo e Serviços

Close

Bens de Consumo e Serviços

Os seres humanos estão reinventando o setor de bens de consumo e serviços

Na era do comércio digital, é difícil prever o que as pessoas vão comprar – e porque, quando e onde vão fazer isso. Para se antecipar aos tempos de incerteza, pense como um consumidor e se concentre na construção de relacionamentos fortes.

Saiba mais

Energia

Close

Energia

Use a disrupção como combustível para promover mudanças

A demanda está em alta. A competição é feroz. As pessoas esperam sustentabilidade. Com pressões inflacionárias, disrupções na rede das cadeias de suprimentos e um foco maior na segurança, as empresas de energia precisam mudar hoje para serem competitivas amanhã.

Saiba mais

Saúde

Close

Saúde

Humanize o setor de saúde

As pessoas querem ter acesso intuitivo e experiências personalizadas na área de saúde. Líderes que se reinventam para facilitar o acesso e proporcionar experiências envolventes permanecerão resilientes sem deixar de gerar melhores resultados.

Saiba mais

Alta Tecnologia

Close

Alta Tecnologia

Transforme a indústria que transforma o mundo

É preciso lidar com a pressão que há para desenvolver produtos e serviços tecnológicos inovadores, reimaginar as redes de fabricação e de cadeia de suprimentos e identificar novas fontes de talentos. Quem se reinventar é quem vai liderar.

Saiba mais

Indústrial

Close

Indústrial

Se destaque pela velocidade no setor industrial

Uma miríade de tendências, como mudanças tecnológicas, diferentes expectativas dos clientes B2B, propósito de produtos orientados por software, serviços aprimorados e muito mais, levam as empresas a adotar a reinvenção contínua. E agora chegou a hora de redefinirmos os modelos de negócios industriais.

Saiba mais

Seguros

Close

Seguros

Mude para buscar resiliência

Seguro é proteção. À medida que as pessoas e as sociedades mudam o tempo todo, as operadoras de seguros devem digitalizar, conectar e personalizar para atender às necessidades mais complexas dos clientes atuais.

Saiba mais

Ciências da Vida

Close

Ciências da Vida

Redefinindo o possível na área de ciências da vida

Para lidar com fatores como mudanças nas necessidades dos pacientes, aumento dos custos, demandas por novos tratamentos e a necessidade de inovação acelerada na área de pesquisa e desenvolvimento, as organizações de ciências da vida devem adotar uma abordagem de transformação moderna.

Saiba mais

Recursos Naturais

Close

Recursos Naturais

Administre os recursos naturais do mundo

À medida que o mundo se volta para a descarbonização, a mineração, os metais, os produtos florestais e os materiais de construção, as empresas enfrentam uma pressão crescente para deixarem de ser produtoras de recursos para se tornarem administradoras deles.

Saiba mais

Administração Pública

Close

Administração Pública

Crie um impacto relevante hoje e construa comunidades mais fortes para o futuro

Enfrentando recursos limitados, avanços tecnológicos cada vez mais rápidos e um estado de crise permanente, as organizações que atuam na área de serviços públicos e que adotam mudanças contínuas podem ter impactos importantes nos resultados para indivíduos e comunidades como um todo.

Saiba mais

Private Equity

Close

Private Equity

Reinvente as maneiras como você cria valor

A próxima geração de líderes do setor de private equity terá acesso a um conjunto expandido de capacidades de valor para chegar mais rápido nos resultados básicos enquanto reduz os riscos e cria maneiras de crescer.

Saiba mais

Varejo

Close

Varejo

Uma redefinição responsável

Agora é a hora de redefinir de forma responsável, o que significa melhor atender às necessidades dos clientes, funcionários e das comunidades onde vivem e trabalham. O desafio é alavancar experiências de varejo digitais e físicas para atender novas demandas, sem comprometer os resultados.

Saiba mais

Software e Plataformas

Close

Software e Plataformas

Um novo amanhecer para o setor de software e plataformas

O próximo capítulo do hipercrescimento está aqui. A tecnologia expandida, a batalha pela atenção e as mudanças macroeconômicas levaram a um ponto de inflexão da indústria, com novas oportunidades se apresentando no horizonte.

Saiba mais

Turismo

Close

Turismo

Descubra novos destinos

O setor de viagens já está acostumado com disrupções. No mundo pós-pandemia, as empresas de viagens precisam se reinventar o tempo todo para superar circunstâncias imprevistas, e isso sem deixar de proporcionar experiências coesas e aprimoradas aos clientes.

Saiba mais

Utilities

Close

Utilities

Reinvente radicalmente a área de energia buscando o net zero

As Utilities são o caminho na transição para um mundo neutro em carbono. Alcançar metas de net zero exige movimentos radicais em direção à reinvenção que gerará valor sustentável para todos.

Saiba mais

Somos una Industria de Uno

No relatório de 2024, a Accenture recebeu a maior pontuação na categoria Current Offering, e entre as maiores pontuações nas categorias Strategy e Market Presence.

A pesquisa realizada pela Forrester avaliou 12 provedores de serviços de trabalho em 25 critérios, incluindo Workday Human Capital Management, Workday Financial Management, Workday Extend e Cloud Platform, Workday Adaptive Planning e Workday Analytics and Reporting (Prism).

Somo líderes na Everest Group’s PEAK Matrix: Marketing Services Assessment 2024

De acordo com o relatório, "a Accenture fundiu a maioria de suas agências de marketing para formar a Accenture Song, um dos maiores provedores de serviços de marketing alimentado por tecnologia do mundo".

Para esta pesquisa, o Everest Group avaliou 34 provedores de serviços de marketing. A Accenture é a líder mais bem colocada nos eixos Vision and Capability e Market Impact.

Somos líderes no inaugural IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Life Sciences R&D Lab of the Future Technology Solutions and Consulting Services 2024 Vendor Assessment

Awards

Reinvent what your business could be

Our wide range of capabilities, ecosystem partnerships and unmatched industry expertise can help your business become the next best version of itself.

Capabilities

The capabilities to help you reinvent

Cloud

Cloud

Take the world by cloud

Every day, cloud computing becomes more integral in driving reinvention, and meeting the ever-changing needs of people around the world.

Customer Service

Customer Service

Turn customer service and proactive support into a growth engine

Impersonal and inconsistent interactions are leaving organizations scrambling to understand how to better support customers. Delivering seamless, data-driven experiences that feel intuitive, not reactive, is vital to unlocking new opportunities for growth.

Cybersecurity

Cybersecurity

De-risk tomorrow by boosting cybersecurity today

Infuse cybersecurity into your strategy and ecosystem to protect value, help prevent threat and build trust as you grow.

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Use AI with purpose

AI is more accessible than ever, and it’s rapidly transforming enterprises and the ways we live and work. The way you apply its potential will determine the impact and position your business to compete and achieve new levels of performance.

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digitize what you make, revolutionize how you make it

Reimagine the products you make and how you make them. Use data, digital and AI to increase resiliency and productivity and improve security and sustainability across the value chain.

Ecosystem Partners

Ecosystem Partners

From change to value faster

Reinvention doesn’t happen in a silo. Fast-track your journey with integrated applications and platforms that bring the latest industry- and function-specific capabilities, plus advanced data and AI offerings, to empower your people and business.

Emerging Technology

Emerging Technology

Shape the future

In a rapidly changing world, embrace emerging technology to transform and achieve greater efficiency, effectiveness, and breakthrough innovation.

Finance and Risk Management

Finance and Risk Management

Investing to build resilience and reduce enterprise risk

Amid intensifying market disruptions and escalating business volatility, there’s more pressure on Chief Financial Officers (CFOs) and Chief Risk Officers (CROs) to balance multiple interconnected transformations while sustaining company performance, profitability and safety.

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Plan, manage and execute capital projects efficiently

Combine human ingenuity with data and AI to deliver large-scale projects on time and within budget, while also achieving broader investment and sustainability objectives.

Learning

Learning

Become a talent creator

While technology plays a key role in business reinvention, it’s your people who determine its success. How can you build the skills they want, and you need, to grow faster?

Managed Services

Managed Services

Change more, faster

As organizations strive to optimize cost and accelerate growth, strategic managed services can help to better prepare them to reinvent operations and drive holistic value at scale.

Marketing and Experience

Marketing and Experience

Marketing for a multidimensional world

Options multiply. Consumer demands evolve. What’s trending today may not be tomorrow. Relevance is essential for growth—create customer experiences that keep up with change.

Metaverse

Metaverse

Make magic in the metaverse

The physical and virtual worlds are blending. The metaverse offers new ways to connect, create and consume. And it’s a fresh chance to make totally inclusive, responsible experiences.

Sales and Commerce

Sales and Commerce

Commerce at the speed of life

Commerce has blended into culture as preferences shift moment to moment. The challenge? Keeping up. Stay relevant by matching the pace and turning complexity into convenience.

Strategy

Strategy

Leading in the next decade

Boldly commit to continuous reinvention and join the small but growing number of companies reaching new levels of profitable growth for their businesses, while also providing greater contributions to humanity.

Supply Chain

Supply Chain

Lead the future with supply chain networks

Anticipate and respond to customer demand. Resilient by design and able to withstand disruptions, supply chain networks drive efficiency, sustainability and growth.

Sustainability

Sustainability

The sustainability imperative

Sustainability spans environmental, social and governance issues. Today every organization must embrace sustainability for future competitiveness.

Talent and Organization

Talent and Organization

Driving growth through people and technology

Thriving organizations are driving change at the intersection of technology and talent. The powerful combination of data and AI and real human experience unlocks new work structures, roles and environments which enable people and businesses to thrive.

Technology Transformation

Technology Transformation

Transform your technology to deliver change faster

Reinvent your digital core with the right strategy, talent and modern practices to increase ROI, drive efficiency and redirect spend to innovations that drive growth.

~250 partnerships to help accelerate change

View all partners

Industries

Unmatched industry expertise

Aerospace and Defense

Aerospace and Defense

Navigate headwinds

From economic uncertainty and supply chain disruptions to skill gaps and shifting consumer expectations, the Aerospace and Defense industry is being challenged. The time is now to embrace a digital-first mindset.

Automotive

Automotive

Get beyond the wheel

The traditional automotive industry has reached a crossroads. We are now operating in a mobility ecosystem, shifting into the next iteration of automotive. To move forward, it’s time to embrace the ecosystem, collaborate beyond industry lines, and find new ways of innovating and partnering for success.

Banking

Banking

Building the next generation of banks

Technology has changed the way people and businesses bank, and traditional strategies no longer work. Now is the time for bold new approaches to intensifying disruption.

Capital Markets

Capital Markets

Capital Markets: See opportunity everywhere

A growing number of retail investors. The transition to low-carbon economies. Infrastructure investments in growing markets. For those who reinvent, constant change is constant opportunity.

Chemicals

Chemicals

Embrace change as a constant

Traditionally seen as a mature, static industry, chemical companies are facing building pressure to move from reactive to proactive and speed innovation.

Communications and Media

Communications and Media

Be hyper-essential for the hyper-connected

People and businesses are always on, whether watching, working, or enabling innovative new growth. Keep them engaged and successful by delivering the continuous experiences and capabilities they expect and need.

Consumer Goods and Services

Consumer Goods and Services

Humans are reinventing the Consumer Goods and Services industry

In the age of digital commerce, it is hard to predict what consumers will buy – and why, when and where they buy it. To stay ahead of uncertainty, think like a consumer and focus on building strong relationships.

Energy

Energy

Use disruption to fuel change

Demand is up. Competition is fierce. People expect sustainability. With inflationary pressures, supply chain network disruptions, and an increased focus on security, energy companies need to change today to compete tomorrow.

Health

Health

Humanizing healthcare

People expect intuitive access to their healthcare and personalized experiences. Leaders that reinvent to create easy access and engaging experiences will stay resilient while delivering better outcomes.

High Tech

High Tech

Transforming the industry that transforms the world

The pressure is on to build innovative tech products and services, reimagine supply chain and manufacturing networks and identify new talent sources. Those who reinvent will lead.

Industrial

Industrial

Excelling at speed in Industrial

A myriad of trends from technology shifts to evolving B2B customer expectations, software-driven product purpose, enhanced services and more are driving companies to embrace continuous reinvention. The time is now to redefine industrial business models.

Insurance

Insurance

Change for resilience

Insurance is protection. As people and societies continuously change, carriers must digitize, connect and personalize to meet today’s more complex customer needs.

Life Science

Life Science

Redefining the possible in Life Sciences

To address the changing needs of patients, rising costs, demands for new treatments, and the need for accelerated R&D innovation, life sciences organizations must adopt a modern transformation approach.

Natural Resources

Natural Resources

Be a steward of the world’s natural resources

As the world looks towards decarbonization, mining, metals, forest products and building materials companies face increasing pressure to shift from being resource producers to resource stewards.

Public Service

Public Service

Create meaningful impact today and build stronger communities for tomorrow

Facing limited resources, increasingly rapid technology advances and a state of perma-crisis, public service organizations who embrace continuous change can have meaningful impact on outcomes for individuals and entire communities.

Private Equity

Private Equity

Reinvent the ways you create value

The next generation of private equity leaders will use an expanded set of value levers to achieve better outcomes.

Retail

Retail

Reset responsibly

Now is the time to responsibly reset, which means better serving the needs of customers, employees and the communities where they live and work. The challenge is to leverage both digital and physical retail experiences to meet new demands—without compromising results.

Software and Platforms

Software and Platforms

A new dawn for the Software & Platforms Industry

The next chapter of hypergrowth is here. Expanded tech, the battle for attention, and macroeconomic shifts have all led to an industry inflection point, with new opportunities on the horizon.

Travel

Travel

Discover new destinations

The travel industry is no stranger to disruption. And in the post-pandemic world, travel companies must continuously reinvent to outwit unforeseen circumstances, while providing cohesive, elevated experiences for customers.

Utilities

Utilities

Radically reinventing power for net zero

Utilities are the cornerstone in the transition to a carbon-neutral world. Achieving net-zero ambitions requires radical moves toward reinvention that will generate sustainable value for all.

See reinvention in action

Every day, we help our clients reinvent their businesses to reach their full potential. Using technology, data, AI and new ways of working. We push boundaries and shape the future of industries.

View client stories

We are an Industry of One

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in The Forrester Wave™: Workday Services, Q2 2024

In the 2024 report, Accenture received the highest score in the Current Offering category, and among the highest scores in the Strategy and Market Presence categories.

The research conducted by Forrester evaluated 12 Workday services providers across 25 criteria, including Workday Human Capital Management, Workday Financial Management, Workday Extend and cloud platform, Workday Adaptive Planning, and Workday Analytics and Reporting (Prism).

Explore more

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in Everest Group’s PEAK Matrix: Marketing Services Assessment 2024

Per the report, “Accenture merged most of its marketing agencies to form Accenture Song, one of the largest technology-powered marketing service providers in the world.”

For this research, Everest Group assessed 34 marketing services providers. Accenture is the highest Leader on the Vision and Capability axis and the highest leader on the Market Impact axis.

Explore more

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in inaugural IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Life Sciences R&D Lab of the Future Technology Solutions and Consulting Services 2024 Vendor Assessment

In the report, Accenture is positioned as a Leader for both “Strategies” and “Capabilities”.

The IDC MarketScape evaluated 13 vendors who provide services to help implement a Lab of the Future (LotF) strategy and transform and modernize labs across the value chain, from experiment design to manufacturing.

Explore more

Rejoignez un environnement de travail où vous faites grandir votre expertise et vous contribuez à la réinvention des entreprises en créant un impact durable.

Rechercher les postes vacants

Développez votre carrière

Des développeurs/développeuses aux concepteurs/conceptrices, en passant par les stratèges et les spécialistes SAP, les possibilités d'apprendre, de progresser et de faire une différence sont infinies.

Service-conseil

Dégagez des connaissances utiles et des capacités de prise de décision améliorées, et créez de nouvelles valeurs à partir de données insoupçonnées.

Explorer le service-conseil

Technologie

Mettez-vous au diapason des technologies émergentes dont nos clients ont besoin pour se développer et travailler d'une manière nouvelle.

Explorer Technologie

Stratégie

Utilisez vos connaissances et votre réflexion stratégique pour comprendre comment nos clients ont besoin de se réinventer et montrez-leur pourquoi nous sommes le partenaire idéal pour les aider.

Explorer la Stratégie

Service clientèle

Mettez votre entregent et votre passion pour la résolution de problèmes au service du soutien des clients les plus importants d'Accenture dans les moments qui comptent vraiment, lorsqu'ils sont confrontés à un défi. En tant que membre de l'un des groupes de spécialistes en opérations commerciales les plus diversifiés au monde, vous bénéficierez d'un soutien pour réussir ainsi que d'occasions pour vous développer.

Ingénierie et fabrication numériques

Utilisez les données, le numérique et la pensée créative pour aider les clients à réimaginer les produits qu'ils fabriquent et la manière dont ils les fabriquent — mieux, plus rapidement et de manière plus durable.

Explorer l’ingénierie et la fabrication numériques

IA et analytique

L'IA est partout et elle évolue rapidement. Utilisez vos compétences et vos approches innovantes pour nous aider à la faire progresser de manière responsable.

Explorer l’IA et l’analytique

SAP

Utilisez la réflexion conceptuelle et les plus récentes technologies et plateformes pour créer des solutions de prochaine génération au sein de notre équipe SAP. Aidez les entreprises à réussir grâce à une réinvention totale et préparez-vous pour l'avenir.

Explorer SAP

Cybersécurité

Utilisez votre expertise et votre mentalité de « startup » pour aider vos clients à se doter d’entreprises cyberrésilientes dans un contexte de menaces complexes et en constante évolution.

Explorer la cybersécurité

Peu importe où vous en êtes dans votre carrière

Étudiants/Étudiantes

Étudiants/Étudiantes

Vous rejoindrez un endroit idéal pour développer vos compétences et lancer votre carrière. Des stages d'été aux occasions axées sur l'innovation, votre curiosité sera la bienvenue.

Programmes d’apprentissage

Programmes d’apprentissage

Si vous voulez faire partie d’une équipe et que vous possédez d'excellentes aptitudes à la communication, préparez-vous à acquérir de l’expérience sur le terrain dans le cadre d’un apprentissage rémunéré.

Professionnels/professionnelles de niveau débutant

Professionnels/professionnelles de niveau débutant

Vous êtes nos futurs leaders. Mettez vos compétences et votre passion au service des technologies les plus récentes pour relever certains des plus grands défis au monde.

Professionnels/Professionnelles chevronné(e)s

Professionnels/Professionnelles chevronné(e)s

Vous voyez tous les angles et vous créez des solutions. Faites partie de notre groupe mondial d’innovation pour aider à transformer le monde pour le mieux.

Dirigeants exécutifs/Dirigeantes exécutives

Dirigeants exécutifs/Dirigeantes exécutives

Vous voyez des possibilités infinies et vous acceptez les défis... et le changement. Voyez comment faire valoir votre ingéniosité et votre expertise ici.

Vous êtes ici à votre place

L’inclusion et la diversité font partie de notre identité. Et tout ce qui fait partie de votre identité nous est bienvenu ici.

Études de cas

Ensemble, nous pouvons réinventer votre entreprise

Notre large éventail de capacités, nos partenariats avec les écosystèmes et notre expertise inégalée de l'industrie peuvent aider votre entreprise à se perfectionner.

CAPACITÉS

Les capacités pour vous aider à vous réinventer

Cloud

Close

Cloud

Prenez le monde en main grâce au cloud

Chaque jour, le cloud computing joue un rôle de plus en plus important dans la réinvention et la satisfaction des besoins en constante évolution des personnes dans le monde entier.

En savoir plus

Customer Service

Close

Customer Service

Transformez le service client et l'assistance proactive en moteur de croissance

Les interactions impersonnelles et incohérentes poussent les entreprises à comprendre comment mieux aider leurs clients. Offrir des expériences fluides basées sur les données, intuitives et non réactives, est essentiel pour créer de nouvelles opportunités de croissance.

En savoir plus

Cybersécurité

Close

Cybersécurité

Réduire les risques futurs en renforçant la cybersécurité dès aujourd'hui

Intégrez la cybersécurité à votre stratégie et à votre écosystème pour protéger la valeur, aider à prévenir les menaces et instaurer la confiance au fur et à mesure de votre croissance.

En savoir plus

Données et intelligence artificielle

Close

Données et intelligence artificielle

Utilisez l'IA à bon escient

L'IA est plus accessible que jamais et transforme rapidement les entreprises et nos façons de vivre et de travailler. La façon dont vous exploitez son potentiel déterminera son impact et permettra à votre entreprise d'être compétitive et d'atteindre de nouveaux niveaux de performance.

En savoir plus

Ingénierie et fabrication numérique

Close

Ingénierie et fabrication numérique

Numérisez votre fabrication, réinventez vos méthodes de production

Réinventez les produits que vous fabriquez et la façon dont vous les fabriquez. Utilisez les données, le numérique et l'IA pour accroître la résilience et la productivité et améliorer la sécurité et la durabilité tout au long de la chaîne de valeur.

En savoir plus

Plateformes d'entreprise

Close

Plateformes d'entreprise

Du changement à la valeur plus rapidement

Adaptez-vous rapidement grâce à des plateformes et des applications intégrées qui offrent de nouvelles capacités sectorielles et fonctionnelles, tirent parti des données et de l'IA, et permettent à vos équipes de générer plus de valeur.

En savoir plus

Technologies émergentes

Close

Technologies émergentes

Façonner l'avenir

Dans un monde qui évolue rapidement, adoptez les technologies émergentes pour vous transformer et parvenir à plus d'efficacité, d'efficience et d'innovation de rupture.

En savoir plus

Finance et gestion des risques

Close

Finance et gestion des risques

Investir pour renforcer la résilience et réduire les risques de l'entreprise

Dans un contexte d'intensification des disruptions du marché et d'escalade de la volatilité des entreprises, les directeurs financiers (CFOs) et les directeurs des risques (CROs) sont de plus en plus sollicités. Ils doivent équilibrer de multiples transformations interconnectées tout en maintenant la performance, la rentabilité et la sécurité de l'entreprise.

En savoir plus

Infrastructure et Immobilisations

Close

Infrastructure et Immobilisations

Planifiez, gérez et exécutez les projets d'immobilisations

Combinez l'ingéniosité humaine, les données et l'IA pour réaliser de grands projets dans des délais et des limites budgétaires, tout en atteignant des objectifs d'investissement et de durabilité plus ambitieux.

En savoir plus

Apprentissage

Close

Apprentissage

Devenir créateur de talents

Bien que la technologie joue un rôle clé dans la réinvention des entreprises, ce sont vos collaborateurs qui en déterminent le succès. Comment pouvez-vous développer les compétences qu'ils souhaitent et dont vous avez besoin pour grandir plus rapidement ?

En savoir plus

Services gérés stratégiques

Close

Services gérés stratégiques

Changer encore plus, plus vite

Alors que les entreprises s'efforcent d'optimiser leurs coûts et d'accélérer leur croissance, les services managés à vocation stratégique peuvent les aider à mieux se préparer à réinventer les opérations et à générer une valeur globale à grande échelle.

En savoir plus

Marketing et expérience

Close

Marketing et expérience

Marketing pour un monde multidimensionnel

Les options se multiplient. Les demandes des consommateurs évoluent. Ce qui est tendance aujourd'hui ne le sera peut-être plus demain. La pertinence est essentielle à la croissance : créez des expériences client qui suivent le rythme du changement.

En savoir plus

Métavers

Close

Métavers

Faire de la magie dans le métavers

Les mondes physique et virtuel se confondent. Le métavers offre de nouvelles façons de se connecter, de créer et de consommer. Et c'est une nouvelle chance de créer des expériences totalement inclusives et responsables.

En savoir plus

Ventes et commerce

Close

Ventes et commerce

Le commerce au rythme de la vie

Le commerce s'est fondu dans la culture alors que les préférences changent d'un moment à l'autre. Le défi ? Rester dans la course. Restez pertinent en suivant le rythme et en transformant la complexité en commodité.

En savoir plus

Stratégie

Close

Stratégie

Être à la pointe de la prochaine décennie

Engagez-vous avec audace dans une réinvention permanente et rejoignez le nombre restreint mais croissant d'entreprises qui atteignent de nouveaux niveaux de croissance rentable pour leurs activités, tout en apportant une plus grande contribution à l'humanité.

En savoir plus

Chaîne D'approvisionnement

Close

Chaîne D'approvisionnement

Façonner le futur avec la Supply Chain

Anticipez et répondez à la demande des clients. Résilients de nature et capables de résister aux disruptions, les réseaux de Supply Chain favorisent l'efficacité, la durabilité et la croissance.

En savoir plus

Développement durable

Close

Développement durable

L'impératif de développement durable

Le développement durable englobe les questions environnementales, sociales et de gouvernance. Aujourd'hui, chaque organisation doit adopter le développement durable pour assurer sa compétitivité future.

En savoir plus

Talents et organisation

Close

Talents et organisation

Stimuler la croissance grâce aux personnes et à la technologie

Les entreprises florissantes sont à l'origine du changement à l'intersection de la technologie et des talents. La puissante combinaison des données et de l'IA avec une véritable expérience humaine ouvre la voie de nouvelles structures de travail, de nouveaux rôles et de nouveaux environnements qui permettent aux personnes et aux entreprises de prospérer.

En savoir plus

Transformation technologique

Close

Transformation technologique

Transformez votre technologie pour accélérer le changement

Réinventez votre noyau numérique avec la bonne stratégie, les talents et les pratiques modernes pour augmenter le retour sur investissement, stimuler l'efficacité et réorienter les dépenses vers des innovations qui stimulent la croissance.

En savoir plus

Plus de 350 partenariats pour accélérer le changement

SECTEURS

Une expertise inégalée dans l'industrie

Aéronautique et défense

Close

Aéronautique et défense

Naviguer contre les vents contraires

L'incertitude économique, les disruptions de la chaîne logistique, le manque de talents et l'évolution des attentes des consommateurs sont autant de défis auxquels l'industrie de l'aéronautique et de la défense est confrontée. Le moment est venu d'adopter un état d'esprit axé sur le numérique.

En savoir plus

Automobile

Close

Automobile

Aller au-delà du volant

L'industrie automobile traditionnelle est à la croisée des chemins. Nous évoluons désormais dans un écosystème de mobilité et nous nous dirigeons vers la prochaine itération de l'automobile. Pour aller de l'avant, il est temps d'adopter l'écosystème, de collaborer au-delà des frontières de l'industrie et de trouver de nouvelles façons d'innover et de s'associer pour réussir.

En savoir plus

Banque

Close

Banque

Construire la prochaine génération de banques

La technologie a changé le rapport des individus et des entreprises aux banques : les stratégies traditionnelles sont dépassées. C'est l'heure d'adopter des approches novatrices.

En savoir plus

Marchés de capitaux

Close

Marchés de capitaux

Capital investissement : Les opportunités sont partout

Un nombre croissant d'investisseurs particuliers. La transition vers des économies à faibles émissions de carbone. Des investissements dans les infrastructures sur des marchés en croissance. Pour ceux qui se réinventent, le changement constant est une opportunité permanente.

En savoir plus

Chimie

Close

Chimie

Adopter le changement comme une constante

Traditionnellement considérées comme une industrie mature et statique, les entreprises chimiques sont soumises à une pression croissante pour passer de la réactivité à la proactivité et accélérer l'innovation.

En savoir plus

Communications et Médias

Close

Communications et Médias

Être hyper-essentiel pour les hyper-connectés

Les personnes et les entreprises sont toujours connectées, qu'il s'agisse d'observer, de travailler ou de favoriser une nouvelle croissance innovante. Maintenez leur engagement et leur réussite en leur offrant les expériences et les capacités continues qu'ils attendent et dont ils ont besoin.

En savoir plus

Biens et services de consommation

Close

Biens et services de consommation

Les humains réinventent l'industrie des services et biens de consommation

À l'ère du commerce numérique, il est difficile de prédire ce que les consommateurs achèteront, et pourquoi, quand et où ils l'achèteront. Pour garder une longueur d'avance sur l'incertitude, pensez comme un consommateur et concentrez-vous sur l'établissement de relations solides.

En savoir plus

Énergie

Close

Énergie

Utiliser la crise pour alimenter le changement

La demande est en hausse. La concurrence est féroce. Les individus exigent des pratiques durables. Face aux pressions inflationnistes, aux disruptions des réseaux de la chaîne logistique et à l'importance accrue accordée à la sécurité, les entreprises du secteur énergétique doivent changer aujourd'hui pour être compétitives demain.

En savoir plus

Santé

Close

Santé

Humaniser la santé

Les individus attendent un accès facilité à leurs soins de santé et des expériences personnalisées. Les acteurs qui réinventent l'accès aux soins et créent des expériences engageantes resteront résilients tout en obtenant de meilleurs résultats.

En savoir plus

High-tech

Close

High-tech

Transformer le secteur qui transforme le monde

La pression est forte pour créer des produits et des services technologiques innovants, réimaginer la chaîne logistique et les réseaux de fabrication et identifier de nouvelles sources de talents. Ceux qui réinventent mèneront la danse.

En savoir plus

Industrie

Close

Industrie

Exceller en vitesse dans l'industrie

Une myriade de tendances, allant des changements technologiques à l'évolution des attentes des clients B2B, en passant par la conception de produits basés sur des logiciels, l'amélioration des services et bien d'autres choses encore, poussent les entreprises à se réinventer en permanence. Le moment est venu de redéfinir les modèles commerciaux industriels.

En savoir plus

Assurance

Close

Assurance

Le changement au service de la résilience

L'assurance protège. Dans un monde en évolution constante, les assureurs doivent numériser, connecter et personnaliser leurs services pour répondre aux besoins d'aujourd'hui.

En savoir plus

Sciences de la Vie

Close

Sciences de la Vie

Redéfinir le possible dans les sciences de la vie

Pour répondre à l'évolution des besoins des patients, à l'augmentation des coûts, à la demande de nouveaux traitements et à la nécessité d'accélérer l'innovation en matière de R&D, les entreprises du secteur des sciences de la vie doivent adopter une approche de transformation moderne.

En savoir plus

Ressources naturelles

Close

Ressources naturelles

Soyez le gardien des ressources naturelles de la planète

Alors que le monde s'oriente vers la décarbonisation, les entreprises des secteurs de l'exploitation minière, des métaux, des produits forestiers et des matériaux de construction sont de plus en plus contraintes de passer du statut de producteur de ressources à celui de gestionnaire de ces ressources.

En savoir plus

Services publics

Close

Services publics

Créer un impact significatif aujourd'hui et bâtir des collectivités plus fortes pour demain

Face à des ressources limitées, des technologies en constante accélération et une situation de crise permanente, les organismes de services publics qui s'engagent dans une transformation continue peuvent avoir un impact significatif sur les individus et les collectivités.

En savoir plus

Private Equity

Close

Private Equity

Réinventer la façon de créer de la valeur

La prochaine génération de leaders du capital-investissement utilisera un ensemble élargi de leviers de valeur pour atteindre rapidement les objectifs de base tout en atténuant les risques et en créant des moyens de croissance.

En savoir plus

Commerce de Détail

Close

Commerce de Détail

Réinitialiser de manière responsable

Le moment est venu de se réinitialiser de manière responsable, c'est-à-dire de mieux répondre aux besoins des clients, des employés et des communautés dans lesquelles ils vivent et travaillent. Le défi consiste à tirer parti des expériences de vente au détail numériques et physiques pour répondre aux nouvelles demandes, sans compromettre les résultats.

En savoir plus

Software & Platforms

Close

Software & Platforms

Une nouvelle aube pour l'industrie des logiciels et des plateformes

Le prochain chapitre de l'hypercroissance est arrivé. L'expansion de la technologie, la bataille pour attirer l'attention et les changements macroéconomiques ont tous conduit à un point d'inflexion de l'industrie, avec de nouvelles opportunités à l'horizon.

En savoir plus

Voyage

Close

Voyage

Découvrir de nouvelles destinations

Le secteur du voyage n'est pas épargné par les disruptions. Et dans le monde post-pandémique, les entreprises du secteur du voyage doivent constamment se réinventer pour faire face aux imprévus, tout en offrant des expériences cohérentes et de qualité.

En savoir plus

Eau – Gaz – Énergie

Close

Eau – Gaz – Énergie

Réinventer radicalement l'énergie pour une consommation nette zéro

Les services Utilities sont la pierre angulaire de la transition vers un monde neutre en carbone. L'atteinte des objectifs de carboneutralité exige des mesures transformatrices radicales créant une valeur durable.

En savoir plus

We are an Industry of One

Toggle awards card detail view

Nous sommes un leader dans The Forrester Wave™ : Workday Services, Q2, 2024

Dans le rapport 2024, Accenture a obtenu la note la plus élevée dans la catégorie Current Offering, et parmi les meilleures dans les catégories Strategy et Market Presence.

L'étude menée par Forrester a évalué 12 prestataires de services Workday selon 25 critères, dont Workday Human Capital Management, Workday Financial Management, Workday Extend et plateforme cloud, Workday Adaptive Planning et Workday Analytics and Reporting (Prism).

Toggle awards card detail view

Nous sommes un leader dans la PEAK Matrix d'Everest Group : Marketing Services Assessment 2024

Selon le rapport, « Accenture a fusionné la plupart de ses agences de marketing pour former Accenture Song, l'un des plus grands fournisseurs de services de marketing assistés par la technologie au monde. »

Pour cette étude, Everest Group a évalué 34 prestataires de services marketing. Accenture est le leader le plus performant sur les axes Vision and Capability et Market Impact.

Toggle awards card detail view

Nous sommes un leader de la première édition d'IDC MarketScape : Worldwide Life Sciences R&D Lab of the Future Technology Solutions and Consulting Services 2024 Vendor Assessment

Dans ce rapport, Accenture est positionné comme leader à la fois pour les « Strategies » et les « Capabilities ».

L'IDC MarketScape a évalué 13 fournisseurs qui proposent des services pour aider à mettre en œuvre une stratégie de laboratoire du futur (LotF) et à transformer et moderniser les laboratoires tout au long de la chaîne de valeur, de la conception de l'expérience à la fabrication.

Gestalte deine Karriere

Von Programmierer:innen, Strateg:innen bis hin zu SAP-Profis – bei uns warten zahlreiche Möglichkeiten auf dich, zu lernen, zu wachsen und etwas zu bewegen.

Strategy

Erfolg basiert auf der richtigen Strategie. Gestalte mit deinem Wissen und deinem strategischen Denken Seite an Seite mit unseren Kunden den digitalen Wandel, so dass sie auch in Zukunft einen Schritt voraus sind.

Mehr erfahren

Consulting

Branchenverständnis. Tiefgründige Einblicke. Grosse Ideen. Du begleitest Kunden dabei, für die digitale Zukunft gerüstet zu sein.

Mehr erfahren

Digital engineering & manufacturing

Mit Hilfe von Daten, Insights und neuen Technologien, arbeitest du Seite an Seite mit unseren Kunden, und hebst ihre Produkte aufs nächste Level. Dadurch können sie effizienter und nachhaltiger produzieren.

Mehr erfahren

Song

Schaffe digitale Erlebnisse, die die Relevanz unserer Kunden und das Leben der Menschen verbessern, indem du Branchen und Geschäftsmodelle neu denkst, vernetzte Plattformen baust und Marketingprogramme optimierst – unterstützt von Partnerschaften mit führenden Unternehmen wie SAP, Adobe, Salesforce und IBM.

Mehr erfahren

Technology

Durch den Einsatz neuer Technologien, entwickeln unsere Kunden gemeinsam mit dir ihre Prozesse und Angebote kontinuierlich weiter. Gemeinsam treibt ihr eine positive Veränderung der Geschäftswelt voran.

Mehr erfahren

Operations

Nutze Daten, Insights und Technologien, um die Arbeitsmodelle neu zu gestalten und Prozesse zu transformieren.

Mehr erfahren

Du hast bald deinen Schulabschluss in der Tasche und interessierst dich für Applikationsentwicklung, Digitalisierung und Tech-Trends? Dann ist eine IT-Lehre genau das Richtige für dich!

Nutze schon während deines Studiums die Zeit, um praktische Erfahrungen zu sammeln und deinen späteren Karriereweg optimal vorzubereiten. Du hast bereits ein abgeschlossenes Studium? Dann starte bei uns als Trainee durch oder steige direkt ein.

Berufseinsteiger:innen

Berufseinsteiger:innen

Du hast eine großartige Karriere vor dir. Arbeite mit neuesten Technologien und entwickle sie mit deinen Skills und deiner Leidenschaft weiter. Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft.

Berufserfahrene

Du denkst „outside the box“ und entwickelst gerne neue Lösungen? Komm in unser innovatives Team und transformiere Geschäftsprozesse weltweit.

Führungskräfte

Führungskräfte

Du erkennst Chancen, wo andere Herausforderungen sehen – und gestaltest Veränderung aktiv mit. Erfahre, wie du deine Innovationskraft und dein Fachwissen wirkungsvoll einbringst.

Du gehörst hierher

Jeder Mensch ist anders. Wir fördern ein inklusives und vielfältiges Arbeitsumfeld, in dem wir uns wertgeschätzt, gesehen und gehört fühlen – indem wir uns auf sechs Bereiche beim Thema „Wellbeing“ fokussieren.

Spinning off from Siemens AG left Siemens Energy with a fragmented finance landscape. The company unified core finances processes in the cloud—simplifying operations and cutting costs by nearly 50%.

Project STOP turns the tide on plastic pollution

Pollution starts long before waste hits the ocean. A digital waste system connects 30,000 households in Indonesia to collection services, keeping 79,000 tons of garbage from the sea.

Read more

Bristol Myers Squibb accelerates breakthrough therapies with AI

Drug trials are slow, complex, and expensive. Through GenAI, the pharmaceutical leader is expediting the process—cutting clinical data conformance time by 85% and tripling study output.

Read more

A Leader in Reinvention​

Our Chair and CEO, Julie Sweet, is No. 11 on Fortune’s Most Powerful People in Business. Every day, Julie and our people demonstrate why Accenture is our clients’ reinvention partner of choice.

A Great Place To Work®

We are very proud to have earned the No. 4 spot on the Great Place To Work® list of the World’s Best Workplaces™, our highest-ever ranking on this prestigious list.

This recognition is especially meaningful because it is based on feedback from our people worldwide.

Awards

Reinvent what your business could be

Our wide range of capabilities, ecosystem partnerships and unmatched industry expertise can help your business become the next best version of itself.

Capabilities

The capabilities to help you reinvent

Cloud

Cloud

Take the world by cloud

Every day, cloud computing becomes more integral in driving reinvention, and meeting the ever-changing needs of people around the world.

Customer Service

Customer Service

Turn customer service and proactive support into a growth engine

Impersonal and inconsistent interactions are leaving organizations scrambling to understand how to better support customers. Delivering seamless, data-driven experiences that feel intuitive, not reactive, is vital to unlocking new opportunities for growth.

Cybersecurity

Cybersecurity

De-risk tomorrow by boosting cybersecurity today

Infuse cybersecurity into your strategy and ecosystem to protect value, help prevent threat and build trust as you grow.

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Use AI with purpose

AI is more accessible than ever, and it’s rapidly transforming enterprises and the ways we live and work. The way you apply its potential will determine the impact and position your business to compete and achieve new levels of performance.

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digitize what you make, revolutionize how you make it

Reimagine the products you make and how you make them. Use data, digital and AI to increase resiliency and productivity and improve security and sustainability across the value chain.

Ecosystem Partners

Ecosystem Partners

From change to value faster

Reinvention doesn’t happen in a silo. Fast-track your journey with integrated applications and platforms that bring the latest industry- and function-specific capabilities, plus advanced data and AI offerings, to empower your people and business.

Emerging Technology

Emerging Technology

Shape the future

In a rapidly changing world, embrace emerging technology to transform and achieve greater efficiency, effectiveness, and breakthrough innovation.

Finance and Risk Management

Finance and Risk Management

Investing to build resilience and reduce enterprise risk

Amid intensifying market disruptions and escalating business volatility, there’s more pressure on Chief Financial Officers (CFOs) and Chief Risk Officers (CROs) to balance multiple interconnected transformations while sustaining company performance, profitability and safety.

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Plan, manage and execute capital projects efficiently

Combine human ingenuity with data and AI to deliver large-scale projects on time and within budget, while also achieving broader investment and sustainability objectives.

Learning

Learning

Become a talent creator

While technology plays a key role in business reinvention, it’s your people who determine its success. How can you build the skills they want, and you need, to grow faster?

Managed Services

Managed Services

Change more, faster

As organizations strive to optimize cost and accelerate growth, strategic managed services can help to better prepare them to reinvent operations and drive holistic value at scale.

Marketing and Experience

Marketing and Experience

Marketing for a multidimensional world

Options multiply. Consumer demands evolve. What’s trending today may not be tomorrow. Relevance is essential for growth—create customer experiences that keep up with change.

Metaverse

Metaverse

Make magic in the metaverse

The physical and virtual worlds are blending. The metaverse offers new ways to connect, create and consume. And it’s a fresh chance to make totally inclusive, responsible experiences.

Sales and Commerce

Sales and Commerce

Commerce at the speed of life

Commerce has blended into culture as preferences shift moment to moment. The challenge? Keeping up. Stay relevant by matching the pace and turning complexity into convenience.

Strategy

Strategy

Leading in the next decade

Boldly commit to continuous reinvention and join the small but growing number of companies reaching new levels of profitable growth for their businesses, while also providing greater contributions to humanity.

Supply Chain

Supply Chain

Lead the future with supply chain networks

Anticipate and respond to customer demand. Resilient by design and able to withstand disruptions, supply chain networks drive efficiency, sustainability and growth.

Sustainability

Sustainability

The sustainability imperative

Sustainability spans environmental, social and governance issues. Today every organization must embrace sustainability for future competitiveness.

Talent and Organization

Talent and Organization

Driving growth through people and technology

Thriving organizations are driving change at the intersection of technology and talent. The powerful combination of data and AI and real human experience unlocks new work structures, roles and environments which enable people and businesses to thrive.

Technology Transformation

Technology Transformation

Transform your technology to deliver change faster

Reinvent your digital core with the right strategy, talent and modern practices to increase ROI, drive efficiency and redirect spend to innovations that drive growth.

~250 partnerships to help accelerate change

View all partners

Industries

Unmatched industry expertise

Aerospace and Defense

Aerospace and Defense

Navigate headwinds

From economic uncertainty and supply chain disruptions to skill gaps and shifting consumer expectations, the Aerospace and Defense industry is being challenged. The time is now to embrace a digital-first mindset.

Automotive

Automotive

Get beyond the wheel

The traditional automotive industry has reached a crossroads. We are now operating in a mobility ecosystem, shifting into the next iteration of automotive. To move forward, it’s time to embrace the ecosystem, collaborate beyond industry lines, and find new ways of innovating and partnering for success.

Banking

Banking

Building the next generation of banks

Technology has changed the way people and businesses bank, and traditional strategies no longer work. Now is the time for bold new approaches to intensifying disruption.

Capital Markets

Capital Markets

Capital Markets: See opportunity everywhere

A growing number of retail investors. The transition to low-carbon economies. Infrastructure investments in growing markets. For those who reinvent, constant change is constant opportunity.

Chemicals

Chemicals

Embrace change as a constant

Traditionally seen as a mature, static industry, chemical companies are facing building pressure to move from reactive to proactive and speed innovation.

Communications and Media

Communications and Media

Be hyper-essential for the hyper-connected

People and businesses are always on, whether watching, working, or enabling innovative new growth. Keep them engaged and successful by delivering the continuous experiences and capabilities they expect and need.

Consumer Goods and Services

Consumer Goods and Services

Humans are reinventing the Consumer Goods and Services industry

In the age of digital commerce, it is hard to predict what consumers will buy – and why, when and where they buy it. To stay ahead of uncertainty, think like a consumer and focus on building strong relationships.

Energy

Energy

Use disruption to fuel change

Demand is up. Competition is fierce. People expect sustainability. With inflationary pressures, supply chain network disruptions, and an increased focus on security, energy companies need to change today to compete tomorrow.

Health

Health

Humanizing healthcare

People expect intuitive access to their healthcare and personalized experiences. Leaders that reinvent to create easy access and engaging experiences will stay resilient while delivering better outcomes.

High Tech

High Tech

Transforming the industry that transforms the world

The pressure is on to build innovative tech products and services, reimagine supply chain and manufacturing networks and identify new talent sources. Those who reinvent will lead.

Industrial

Industrial

Excelling at speed in Industrial

A myriad of trends from technology shifts to evolving B2B customer expectations, software-driven product purpose, enhanced services and more are driving companies to embrace continuous reinvention. The time is now to redefine industrial business models.

Insurance

Insurance

Change for resilience

Insurance is protection. As people and societies continuously change, carriers must digitize, connect and personalize to meet today’s more complex customer needs.

Life Science

Life Science

Redefining the possible in Life Sciences

To address the changing needs of patients, rising costs, demands for new treatments, and the need for accelerated R&D innovation, life sciences organizations must adopt a modern transformation approach.

Natural Resources

Natural Resources

Be a steward of the world’s natural resources

As the world looks towards decarbonization, mining, metals, forest products and building materials companies face increasing pressure to shift from being resource producers to resource stewards.

Public Service

Public Service

Create meaningful impact today and build stronger communities for tomorrow

Facing limited resources, increasingly rapid technology advances and a state of perma-crisis, public service organizations who embrace continuous change can have meaningful impact on outcomes for individuals and entire communities.

Private Equity

Private Equity

Reinvent the ways you create value

The next generation of private equity leaders will use an expanded set of value levers to achieve better outcomes.

Retail

Retail

Reset responsibly

Now is the time to responsibly reset, which means better serving the needs of customers, employees and the communities where they live and work. The challenge is to leverage both digital and physical retail experiences to meet new demands—without compromising results.

Software and Platforms

Software and Platforms

A new dawn for the Software & Platforms Industry

The next chapter of hypergrowth is here. Expanded tech, the battle for attention, and macroeconomic shifts have all led to an industry inflection point, with new opportunities on the horizon.

Travel

Travel

Discover new destinations

The travel industry is no stranger to disruption. And in the post-pandemic world, travel companies must continuously reinvent to outwit unforeseen circumstances, while providing cohesive, elevated experiences for customers.

Utilities

Utilities

Radically reinventing power for net zero

Utilities are the cornerstone in the transition to a carbon-neutral world. Achieving net-zero ambitions requires radical moves toward reinvention that will generate sustainable value for all.

See reinvention in action

Every day, we help our clients reinvent their businesses to reach their full potential. Using technology, data, AI and new ways of working. We push boundaries and shape the future of industries.

View client stories

We are an Industry of One

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in The Forrester Wave™: Workday Services, Q2 2024

In the 2024 report, Accenture received the highest score in the Current Offering category, and among the highest scores in the Strategy and Market Presence categories.

The research conducted by Forrester evaluated 12 Workday services providers across 25 criteria, including Workday Human Capital Management, Workday Financial Management, Workday Extend and cloud platform, Workday Adaptive Planning, and Workday Analytics and Reporting (Prism).

Explore more

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in Everest Group’s PEAK Matrix: Marketing Services Assessment 2024

Per the report, “Accenture merged most of its marketing agencies to form Accenture Song, one of the largest technology-powered marketing service providers in the world.”

For this research, Everest Group assessed 34 marketing services providers. Accenture is the highest Leader on the Vision and Capability axis and the highest leader on the Market Impact axis.

Explore more

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in inaugural IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Life Sciences R&D Lab of the Future Technology Solutions and Consulting Services 2024 Vendor Assessment

In the report, Accenture is positioned as a Leader for both “Strategies” and “Capabilities”.

The IDC MarketScape evaluated 13 vendors who provide services to help implement a Lab of the Future (LotF) strategy and transform and modernize labs across the value chain, from experiment design to manufacturing.
