Nos prix et récompenses

Études de cas

Ensemble, nous pouvons réinventer votre entreprise

Notre large éventail de capacités, nos partenariats avec les écosystèmes et notre expertise sectorielle peuvent aider votre entreprise à se perfectionner.

CAPACITÉS

Nos capacités pour vous aider à vous réinventer

Cloud

Close

Cloud

Prenez le monde en main grâce au cloud

Chaque jour, le cloud computing joue un rôle croissant dans la réinvention des entreprises et la satisfaction des besoins des individus, en constante évolution à travers le monde.

En savoir plus

Customer Service

Close

Customer Service

Réinventer le service client : un enjeu majeur de compétitivité

Comprendre les attentes des clients : un enjeu stratégique pour les entreprises. Découvrez trois actions clés pour harmoniser vos initiatives en technologie, données et IA générative avec les priorités d'efficacité, de réduction des coûts et de satisfaction client.

En savoir plus

Cybersécurité

Close

Cybersécurité

Réduire les risques futurs en renforçant la cybersécurité dès aujourd'hui

Intégrez la cybersécurité à votre stratégie et à votre écosystème pour protéger la valeur, aider à prévenir les menaces et instaurer la confiance au fur et à mesure de votre croissance.

En savoir plus

Data and Intelligence Artificielle

Close

Data and Intelligence Artificielle

Utilisez l'IA à bon escient

L'IA est plus accessible que jamais et transforme rapidement les entreprises et nos façons de vivre et de travailler. La façon dont vous exploitez son potentiel déterminera son impact et permettra à votre entreprise d'être compétitive et d'atteindre de nouveaux niveaux de performance.

En savoir plus

Ingénierie et Fabrication Digitales

Close

Ingénierie et Fabrication Digitales

Numérisez votre fabrication, réinventez vos méthodes de production

Réinventez les produits que vous fabriquez et la façon dont vous les fabriquez. Utilisez les données, le numérique et l'IA pour accroître la résilience et la productivité et améliorer la sécurité et la durabilité tout au long de la chaîne de valeur.

En savoir plus

Plateformes d'entreprise

Close

Plateformes d'entreprise

Du changement à la valeur plus rapidement

Adaptez-vous rapidement grâce à des plateformes et des applications intégrées qui offrent de nouvelles capacités sectorielles et fonctionnelles, tirent parti des données et de l'IA, et permettent à vos équipes de générer plus de valeur.

En savoir plus

Technologies émergentes

Close

Technologies émergentes

Façonner l'avenir

Dans un monde qui évolue rapidement, adoptez les technologies émergentes pour vous transformer et parvenir à plus d'efficacité, d'efficience et d'innovation de rupture.

En savoir plus

Finance et gestion des risques

Close

Finance et gestion des risques

Investir pour renforcer la résilience et réduire les risques de l'entreprise

Dans un contexte d'intensification des disruptions du marché et d'escalade de la volatilité des entreprises, les directeurs financiers (CFOs) et les directeurs des risques (CROs) sont de plus en plus sollicités. Ils doivent équilibrer de multiples transformations interconnectées tout en maintenant la performance, la rentabilité et la sécurité de l'entreprise.

En savoir plus

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Close

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Planifiez, gérez et déployez les projets d'immobilisations

Combinez l'ingéniosité humaine, les données et l'IA pour réaliser de grands projets dans des délais et des limites budgétaires, tout en atteignant des objectifs d'investissement et de durabilité plus ambitieux.

En savoir plus

Apprentissage

Close

Apprentissage

Devenir créateur de talents

Bien que la technologie joue un rôle clé dans la réinvention des entreprises, ce sont vos collaborateurs qui en déterminent le succès. Comment pouvez-vous développer les compétences qu'ils souhaitent et dont vous avez besoin pour grandir plus rapidement ?

En savoir plus

Services gérés stratégiques

Close

Services gérés stratégiques

Changer encore plus, plus vite

Alors que les entreprises s'efforcent d'optimiser leurs coûts et d'accélérer leur croissance, les services managés à vocation stratégique peuvent les aider à mieux se préparer à réinventer les opérations et à générer une valeur globale à grande échelle.

En savoir plus

Marketing et expérience

Close

Marketing et expérience

Marketing pour un monde multidimensionnel

Les options se multiplient. Les demandes des consommateurs évoluent. Ce qui est tendance aujourd'hui ne le sera peut-être plus demain. La pertinence est essentielle à la croissance : créez des expériences client qui suivent le rythme du changement.

En savoir plus

Métavers

Close

Métavers

Faire de la magie dans le métavers

Les mondes physique et virtuel se confondent. Le métavers offre de nouvelles façons de se connecter, de créer et de consommer. Et c'est une nouvelle chance de créer des expériences totalement inclusives et responsables.

En savoir plus

Ventes et commerce

Close

Ventes et commerce

Le commerce au rythme de la vie

Le commerce s'est fondu dans la culture alors que les préférences changent d'un moment à l'autre. Le défi ? Rester dans la course. Restez pertinent en suivant le rythme et en transformant la complexité en commodité.

En savoir plus

Stratégie

Close

Stratégie

Être à la pointe de la prochaine décennie

Engagez-vous avec audace dans une réinvention permanente et rejoignez le nombre restreint mais croissant d'entreprises qui atteignent de nouveaux niveaux de croissance rentable pour leurs activités, tout en apportant une plus grande contribution à l'humanité.

En savoir plus

Supply Chain

Close

Supply Chain

Façonner le futur avec la Supply Chain

Anticipez et répondez à la demande des clients. Résilients de nature et capables de résister aux disruptions, les réseaux de Supply Chain favorisent l'efficacité, la durabilité et la croissance.

En savoir plus

Développement durable

Close

Développement durable

L'impératif de développement durable

Le développement durable englobe les questions environnementales, sociales et de gouvernance. Aujourd'hui, chaque organisation doit l'adopter pour assurer sa compétitivité future.

En savoir plus

Talents et organisation

Close

Talents et organisation

Stimuler la croissance grâce aux personnes et à la technologie

Les entreprises florissantes sont à l'origine du changement à l'intersection de la technologie et des talents. La puissante combinaison des données et de l'IA avec une véritable expérience humaine ouvre la voie de nouvelles structures de travail, de nouveaux rôles et de nouveaux environnements qui permettent aux personnes et aux entreprises de prospérer.

En savoir plus

Transformation technologique

Close

Transformation technologique

Transformez votre technologie pour accélérer le changement

Réinventez votre noyau numérique avec la bonne stratégie, les talents et les pratiques modernes pour augmenter le retour sur investissement, stimuler l'efficacité et réorienter les dépenses vers des innovations qui stimulent la croissance.

En savoir plus

Plus de 350 partenariats pour accélérer le changement

SECTEURS

Une expertise inégalée dans l'industrie

Aéronautique et défense

Close

Aéronautique et défense

Naviguer contre les vents contraires

L'incertitude économique, les disruptions de la chaîne logistique, le manque de talents et l'évolution des attentes des consommateurs sont autant de défis auxquels l'industrie de l'aéronautique et de la défense est confrontée. Le moment est venu d'adopter un état d'esprit axé sur le numérique.

En savoir plus

Automobile

Close

Automobile

Aller au-delà du volant

L'industrie automobile traditionnelle est à la croisée des chemins. Nous évoluons désormais dans un écosystème de mobilité et nous nous dirigeons vers la prochaine itération de l'automobile. Pour aller de l'avant, il est temps d'adopter l'écosystème, de collaborer au-delà des frontières de l'industrie et de trouver de nouvelles façons d'innover et de s'associer pour réussir.

En savoir plus

Banque

Close

Banque

Construire la prochaine génération de banques

La technologie a changé le rapport des individus et des entreprises aux banques : les stratégies traditionnelles sont dépassées. C'est l'heure d'adopter des approches novatrices.

En savoir plus

Capital investissement

Close

Capital investissement

Capital investissement : Les opportunités sont partout

Un nombre croissant d'investisseurs particuliers. La transition vers des économies à faibles émissions de carbone. Des investissements dans les infrastructures sur des marchés en croissance. Pour ceux qui se réinventent, le changement constant est une opportunité permanente.

En savoir plus

Chimie

Close

Chimie

Adopter le changement comme une constante

Traditionnellement considérées comme une industrie mature et statique, les entreprises chimiques sont soumises à une pression croissante pour passer de la réactivité à la proactivité et accélérer l'innovation.

En savoir plus

Communications et Médias

Close

Communications et Médias

Être hyper-essentiel pour les hyper-connectés

Les personnes et les entreprises sont toujours connectées, qu'il s'agisse d'observer, de travailler ou de favoriser une nouvelle croissance innovante. Maintenez leur engagement et leur réussite en leur offrant les expériences et les capacités continues qu'ils attendent et dont ils ont besoin.

En savoir plus

Biens et services de consommation

Close

Biens et services de consommation

Réinventer les biens et services à l'ère numérique

À l'ère du commerce numérique, il est difficile de prédire ce que les consommateurs achèteront, et pourquoi, quand et où ils l'achèteront. Pour garder une longueur d'avance sur l'incertitude, pensez comme un consommateur et concentrez-vous sur l'établissement de relations solides.

En savoir plus

Énergie

Close

Énergie

Faire de la crise un levier de transformation

La demande est en hausse, la concurrence est féroce, et les individus exigent des pratiques durables. Face aux pressions inflationnistes, aux disruptions des chaînes logistiques et à l'importance accrue accordée à la sécurité, les entreprises du secteur énergétique doivent se transformer dès aujourd'hui pour rester compétitives demain.

En savoir plus

Santé

Close

Santé

Humaniser la santé

Les individus attendent un accès facilité à leurs soins de santé et des expériences personnalisées. Les acteurs qui réinventent l'accès aux soins et créent des expériences engageantes resteront résilients tout en obtenant de meilleurs résultats.

En savoir plus

High-tech

Close

High-tech

Transformer le secteur qui transforme le monde

La pression est forte pour créer des produits et des services technologiques innovants, réimaginer la chaîne logistique et les réseaux de fabrication et identifier de nouvelles sources de talents. Ceux qui réinventent mèneront la danse.

En savoir plus

Industrie

Close

Industrie

Accélérer l’innovation dans l’industrie

À l'ère du commerce numérique, les entreprises industrielles sont confrontées à une multitude de défis : évolution rapide des technologies, attentes changeantes des clients B2B, adoption de modèles basés sur les services, amélioration continue des produits et services, et bien plus encore. Pour rester compétitives, elles doivent se réinventer en permanence. Le moment est venu de redéfinir les modèles commerciaux industriels pour répondre efficacement à ces enjeux.

En savoir plus

Assurance

Close

Assurance

Renforcer la résilience par le changement

L'assurance protège. Dans un monde en évolution constante, les assureurs doivent numériser, connecter et personnaliser leurs services pour répondre aux besoins d'aujourd'hui.

En savoir plus

Sciences de la Vie

Close

Sciences de la Vie

Redéfinir le possible dans les sciences de la vie

Pour répondre à l'évolution des besoins des patients, à l'augmentation des coûts, à la demande de nouveaux traitements et à la nécessité d'accélérer l'innovation en matière de R&D, les entreprises du secteur des sciences de la vie doivent adopter une approche de transformation moderne.

En savoir plus

Ressources naturelles

Close

Ressources naturelles

Assurer la gestion durable des ressources naturelles

Alors que le monde s'oriente vers la décarbonisation, les entreprises des secteurs de l'exploitation minière, des métaux, des produits forestiers et des matériaux de construction sont de plus en plus contraintes de passer du statut de producteur de ressources à celui de gestionnaires responsables.

En savoir plus

Service public

Close

Service public

Agir pour renforcer les collectivités de demain

Face à des ressources limitées, des technologies en constante accélération et une situation de crise permanente, les organismes de services publics qui s'engagent dans une transformation continue peuvent avoir un impact significatif sur les individus et les collectivités.

En savoir plus

Private Equity

Close

Private Equity

Réinventer la façon de créer de la valeur

La prochaine génération de leaders du capital-investissement utilisera un ensemble élargi de leviers de valeur pour atteindre rapidement les objectifs de base tout en atténuant les risques et en créant des moyens de croissance.

En savoir plus

Retail

Close

Retail

Réinventer le retail de manière responsable

Le moment est venu de se réinitialiser de manière responsable, c'est-à-dire de mieux répondre aux besoins des clients, des employés et des communautés dans lesquelles ils vivent et travaillent. Le défi consiste à tirer parti des expériences de retail numériques et physiques pour répondre aux nouvelles demandes, sans compromettre les résultats.

En savoir plus

Software & Platforms

Close

Software & Platforms

Réinventer l'industrie des logiciels et des plateformes

Le prochain chapitre de l'hypercroissance est arrivé. L'expansion de la technologie, la bataille pour attirer l'attention et les changements macroéconomiques ont tous conduit à un point d'inflexion de l'industrie, avec de nouvelles opportunités à l'horizon.

En savoir plus

Voyage

Close

Voyage

Découvrir de nouvelles destinations

Le secteur du voyage n'est pas épargné par les disruptions. Et dans le monde post-pandémique, les entreprises du secteur du voyage doivent constamment se réinventer pour faire face aux imprévus, tout en offrant des expériences cohérentes et de qualité.

En savoir plus

Utilities

Close

Utilities

Transformer le secteur de l'énergie pour atteindre la neutralité carbone

Les Utilities sont la pierre angulaire de la transition vers un monde neutre en carbone. L'atteinte des objectifs de carboneutralité exige des mesures transformatrices radicales créant une valeur durable.

En savoir plus

Nous sommes une entreprise Unique

Toggle awards card detail view

Nous sommes un leader dans The Forrester Wave™ : Workday Services, Q2, 2024

Dans le rapport 2024, Accenture a obtenu la note la plus élevée dans la catégorie Current Offering, et parmi les meilleures dans les catégories Strategy et Market Presence.

L'étude menée par Forrester a évalué 12 prestataires de services Workday selon 25 critères, dont Workday Human Capital Management, Workday Financial Management, Workday Extend et plateforme cloud, Workday Adaptive Planning et Workday Analytics and Reporting (Prism).

Toggle awards card detail view

Nous sommes un leader dans la PEAK Matrix d'Everest Group : Marketing Services Assessment 2024

Selon le rapport, « Accenture a fusionné la plupart de ses agences de marketing pour former Accenture Song, l'un des plus grands fournisseurs de services de marketing assistés par la technologie au monde. »

Pour cette étude, Everest Group a évalué 34 prestataires de services marketing. Accenture est le leader le plus performant sur les axes Vision and Capability et Market Impact.

Toggle awards card detail view

Nous sommes un leader de la première édition d'IDC MarketScape : Worldwide Life Sciences R&D Lab of the Future Technology Solutions and Consulting Services 2024 Vendor Assessment

Dans ce rapport, Accenture est positionné comme leader à la fois pour les « Strategies » et les « Capabilities ».

L'IDC MarketScape a évalué 13 fournisseurs qui proposent des services pour aider à mettre en œuvre une stratégie de laboratoire du futur (LotF) et à transformer et moderniser les laboratoires tout au long de la chaîne de valeur, de la conception de l'expérience à la fabrication.

BBVA est à la tête d'un nouvel avenir bancaire innovant

Découvrez la réinvention pionnière à l'échelle de l'entreprise qui a permis à la banque de devenir l'une des plus innovantes et des plus efficaces au monde.

BMW place l'IA générative au cœur de la conduite

Ensemble, BMW et Accenture ont développé une plateforme GenAI qui convertit les données à l'échelle de l'entreprise en informations en temps réel.

Moderniser les RH à l'échelle mondiale

Ensemble, Marriott et Accenture se lancent dans une transformation RH pour réinventer l'expérience des salariés.

Airbus : La fabrication alimentée par l'IA prend son envol

L'inspection automatisée atteint de nouveaux sommets pour le Centre d'innovation d'Airbus en Chine. En transformant les opérations et les processus d'inspection grâce à l'IA et à la vision par ordinateur, ils réimaginent la manière dont les avions sont assemblés.

En savoir plus

Microsoft : Apporter une vision globale aux opérations mondiales

Pour optimiser ses opérations mondiales, Microsoft a déployé sa tour de contrôle logistique Cloud Control qui sert de source unique et fiable pour plus de 500 décideurs à travers le monde et l'organisation.

En savoir plus

MQDC : Le bien-être dans le métavers

Avec un univers virtuel qui relie un espace de créativité en ligne aux propriétés physiques, le promoteur immobilier MQDC rapproche les mondes réel et numérique, et récompense les actions positives qui ont un impact sur le monde réel.

Capabilities

Awards

Reinvent what your business could be

Our wide range of capabilities, ecosystem partnerships and unmatched industry expertise can help your business become the next best version of itself.

Capabilities

The capabilities to help you reinvent

Cloud

Cloud

Take the world by cloud

Every day, cloud computing becomes more integral in driving reinvention, and meeting the ever-changing needs of people around the world.

Customer Service

Customer Service

Turn customer service and proactive support into a growth engine

Impersonal and inconsistent interactions are leaving organizations scrambling to understand how to better support customers. Delivering seamless, data-driven experiences that feel intuitive, not reactive, is vital to unlocking new opportunities for growth.

Cybersecurity

Cybersecurity

De-risk tomorrow by boosting cybersecurity today

Infuse cybersecurity into your strategy and ecosystem to protect value, help prevent threat and build trust as you grow.

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Use AI with purpose

AI is more accessible than ever, and it’s rapidly transforming enterprises and the ways we live and work. The way you apply its potential will determine the impact and position your business to compete and achieve new levels of performance.

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digitize what you make, revolutionize how you make it

Reimagine the products you make and how you make them. Use data, digital and AI to increase resiliency and productivity and improve security and sustainability across the value chain.

Ecosystem Partners

Ecosystem Partners

From change to value faster

Reinvention doesn’t happen in a silo. Fast-track your journey with integrated applications and platforms that bring the latest industry- and function-specific capabilities, plus advanced data and AI offerings, to empower your people and business.

Emerging Technology

Emerging Technology

Shape the future

In a rapidly changing world, embrace emerging technology to transform and achieve greater efficiency, effectiveness, and breakthrough innovation.

Finance and Risk Management

Finance and Risk Management

Investing to build resilience and reduce enterprise risk

Amid intensifying market disruptions and escalating business volatility, there’s more pressure on Chief Financial Officers (CFOs) and Chief Risk Officers (CROs) to balance multiple interconnected transformations while sustaining company performance, profitability and safety.

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Plan, manage and execute capital projects efficiently

Combine human ingenuity with data and AI to deliver large-scale projects on time and within budget, while also achieving broader investment and sustainability objectives.

Learning

Learning

Become a talent creator

While technology plays a key role in business reinvention, it’s your people who determine its success. How can you build the skills they want, and you need, to grow faster?

Managed Services

Managed Services

Change more, faster

As organizations strive to optimize cost and accelerate growth, strategic managed services can help to better prepare them to reinvent operations and drive holistic value at scale.

Marketing and Experience

Marketing and Experience

Marketing for a multidimensional world

Options multiply. Consumer demands evolve. What’s trending today may not be tomorrow. Relevance is essential for growth—create customer experiences that keep up with change.

Metaverse

Metaverse

Make magic in the metaverse

The physical and virtual worlds are blending. The metaverse offers new ways to connect, create and consume. And it’s a fresh chance to make totally inclusive, responsible experiences.

Sales and Commerce

Sales and Commerce

Commerce at the speed of life

Commerce has blended into culture as preferences shift moment to moment. The challenge? Keeping up. Stay relevant by matching the pace and turning complexity into convenience.

Strategy

Strategy

Leading in the next decade

Boldly commit to continuous reinvention and join the small but growing number of companies reaching new levels of profitable growth for their businesses, while also providing greater contributions to humanity.

Supply Chain

Supply Chain

Lead the future with supply chain networks

Anticipate and respond to customer demand. Resilient by design and able to withstand disruptions, supply chain networks drive efficiency, sustainability and growth.

Sustainability

Sustainability

The sustainability imperative

Sustainability spans environmental, social and governance issues. Today every organization must embrace sustainability for future competitiveness.

Talent and Organization

Talent and Organization

Driving growth through people and technology

Thriving organizations are driving change at the intersection of technology and talent. The powerful combination of data and AI and real human experience unlocks new work structures, roles and environments which enable people and businesses to thrive.

Technology Transformation

Technology Transformation

Transform your technology to deliver change faster

Reinvent your digital core with the right strategy, talent and modern practices to increase ROI, drive efficiency and redirect spend to innovations that drive growth.

~250 partnerships to help accelerate change

View all partners

Industries

Unmatched industry expertise

Aerospace and Defense

Aerospace and Defense

Navigate headwinds

From economic uncertainty and supply chain disruptions to skill gaps and shifting consumer expectations, the Aerospace and Defense industry is being challenged. The time is now to embrace a digital-first mindset.

Automotive

Automotive

Get beyond the wheel

The traditional automotive industry has reached a crossroads. We are now operating in a mobility ecosystem, shifting into the next iteration of automotive. To move forward, it’s time to embrace the ecosystem, collaborate beyond industry lines, and find new ways of innovating and partnering for success.

Banking

Banking

Building the next generation of banks

Technology has changed the way people and businesses bank, and traditional strategies no longer work. Now is the time for bold new approaches to intensifying disruption.

Capital Markets

Capital Markets

Capital Markets: See opportunity everywhere

A growing number of retail investors. The transition to low-carbon economies. Infrastructure investments in growing markets. For those who reinvent, constant change is constant opportunity.

Chemicals

Chemicals

Embrace change as a constant

Traditionally seen as a mature, static industry, chemical companies are facing building pressure to move from reactive to proactive and speed innovation.

Communications and Media

Communications and Media

Be hyper-essential for the hyper-connected

People and businesses are always on, whether watching, working, or enabling innovative new growth. Keep them engaged and successful by delivering the continuous experiences and capabilities they expect and need.

Consumer Goods and Services

Consumer Goods and Services

Humans are reinventing the Consumer Goods and Services industry

In the age of digital commerce, it is hard to predict what consumers will buy – and why, when and where they buy it. To stay ahead of uncertainty, think like a consumer and focus on building strong relationships.

Energy

Energy

Use disruption to fuel change

Demand is up. Competition is fierce. People expect sustainability. With inflationary pressures, supply chain network disruptions, and an increased focus on security, energy companies need to change today to compete tomorrow.

Health

Health

Humanizing healthcare

People expect intuitive access to their healthcare and personalized experiences. Leaders that reinvent to create easy access and engaging experiences will stay resilient while delivering better outcomes.

High Tech

High Tech

Transforming the industry that transforms the world

The pressure is on to build innovative tech products and services, reimagine supply chain and manufacturing networks and identify new talent sources. Those who reinvent will lead.

Industrial

Industrial

Excelling at speed in Industrial

A myriad of trends from technology shifts to evolving B2B customer expectations, software-driven product purpose, enhanced services and more are driving companies to embrace continuous reinvention. The time is now to redefine industrial business models.

Insurance

Insurance

Change for resilience

Insurance is protection. As people and societies continuously change, carriers must digitize, connect and personalize to meet today’s more complex customer needs.

Life Science

Life Science

Redefining the possible in Life Sciences

To address the changing needs of patients, rising costs, demands for new treatments, and the need for accelerated R&D innovation, life sciences organizations must adopt a modern transformation approach.

Natural Resources

Natural Resources

Be a steward of the world’s natural resources

As the world looks towards decarbonization, mining, metals, forest products and building materials companies face increasing pressure to shift from being resource producers to resource stewards.

Public Service

Public Service

Create meaningful impact today and build stronger communities for tomorrow

Facing limited resources, increasingly rapid technology advances and a state of perma-crisis, public service organizations who embrace continuous change can have meaningful impact on outcomes for individuals and entire communities.

Private Equity

Private Equity

Reinvent the ways you create value

The next generation of private equity leaders will use an expanded set of value levers to achieve better outcomes.

Retail

Retail

Reset responsibly

Now is the time to responsibly reset, which means better serving the needs of customers, employees and the communities where they live and work. The challenge is to leverage both digital and physical retail experiences to meet new demands—without compromising results.

Software and Platforms

Software and Platforms

A new dawn for the Software & Platforms Industry

The next chapter of hypergrowth is here. Expanded tech, the battle for attention, and macroeconomic shifts have all led to an industry inflection point, with new opportunities on the horizon.

Travel

Travel

Discover new destinations

The travel industry is no stranger to disruption. And in the post-pandemic world, travel companies must continuously reinvent to outwit unforeseen circumstances, while providing cohesive, elevated experiences for customers.

Utilities

Utilities

Radically reinventing power for net zero

Utilities are the cornerstone in the transition to a carbon-neutral world. Achieving net-zero ambitions requires radical moves toward reinvention that will generate sustainable value for all.

See reinvention in action

Every day, we help our clients reinvent their businesses to reach their full potential. Using technology, data, AI and new ways of working. We push boundaries and shape the future of industries.

View client stories

We are an Industry of One

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in The Forrester Wave™: Workday Services, Q2 2024

In the 2024 report, Accenture received the highest score in the Current Offering category, and among the highest scores in the Strategy and Market Presence categories.

The research conducted by Forrester evaluated 12 Workday services providers across 25 criteria, including Workday Human Capital Management, Workday Financial Management, Workday Extend and cloud platform, Workday Adaptive Planning, and Workday Analytics and Reporting (Prism).

We are a Leader in Everest Group’s PEAK Matrix: Marketing Services Assessment 2024

Per the report, “Accenture merged most of its marketing agencies to form Accenture Song, one of the largest technology-powered marketing service providers in the world.”

For this research, Everest Group assessed 34 marketing services providers. Accenture is the highest Leader on the Vision and Capability axis and the highest leader on the Market Impact axis.

Explore more

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in inaugural IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Life Sciences R&D Lab of the Future Technology Solutions and Consulting Services 2024 Vendor Assessment

In the report, Accenture is positioned as a Leader for both “Strategies” and “Capabilities”.

The IDC MarketScape evaluated 13 vendors who provide services to help implement a Lab of the Future (LotF) strategy and transform and modernize labs across the value chain, from experiment design to manufacturing.

Reinvent what your business could be

Our wide range of capabilities, ecosystem partnerships and unmatched industry expertise can help your business become the next best version of itself.

Capabilities

The capabilities to help you reinvent

Cloud

Cloud

Take the world by cloud

Every day, cloud computing becomes more integral in driving reinvention, and meeting the ever-changing needs of people around the world.

Customer Service

Customer Service

Turn customer service and proactive support into a growth engine

Impersonal and inconsistent interactions are leaving organizations scrambling to understand how to better support customers. Delivering seamless, data-driven experiences that feel intuitive, not reactive, is vital to unlocking new opportunities for growth.

Cybersecurity

Cybersecurity

De-risk tomorrow by boosting cybersecurity today

Infuse cybersecurity into your strategy and ecosystem to protect value, help prevent threat and build trust as you grow.

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Use AI with purpose

AI is more accessible than ever, and it’s rapidly transforming enterprises and the ways we live and work. The way you apply its potential will determine the impact and position your business to compete and achieve new levels of performance.

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digitize what you make, revolutionize how you make it

Reimagine the products you make and how you make them. Use data, digital and AI to increase resiliency and productivity and improve security and sustainability across the value chain.

Ecosystem Partners

Ecosystem Partners

From change to value faster

Reinvention doesn’t happen in a silo. Fast-track your journey with integrated applications and platforms that bring the latest industry- and function-specific capabilities, plus advanced data and AI offerings, to empower your people and business.

Emerging Technology

Emerging Technology

Shape the future

In a rapidly changing world, embrace emerging technology to transform and achieve greater efficiency, effectiveness, and breakthrough innovation.

Finance and Risk Management

Finance and Risk Management

Investing to build resilience and reduce enterprise risk

Amid intensifying market disruptions and escalating business volatility, there’s more pressure on Chief Financial Officers (CFOs) and Chief Risk Officers (CROs) to balance multiple interconnected transformations while sustaining company performance, profitability and safety.

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Plan, manage and execute capital projects efficiently

Combine human ingenuity with data and AI to deliver large-scale projects on time and within budget, while also achieving broader investment and sustainability objectives.

Learning

Learning

Become a talent creator

While technology plays a key role in business reinvention, it’s your people who determine its success. How can you build the skills they want, and you need, to grow faster?

Managed Services

Managed Services

Change more, faster

As organizations strive to optimize cost and accelerate growth, strategic managed services can help to better prepare them to reinvent operations and drive holistic value at scale.

Marketing and Experience

Marketing and Experience

Marketing for a multidimensional world

Options multiply. Consumer demands evolve. What’s trending today may not be tomorrow. Relevance is essential for growth—create customer experiences that keep up with change.

Metaverse

Metaverse

Make magic in the metaverse

The physical and virtual worlds are blending. The metaverse offers new ways to connect, create and consume. And it’s a fresh chance to make totally inclusive, responsible experiences.

Sales and Commerce

Sales and Commerce

Commerce at the speed of life

Commerce has blended into culture as preferences shift moment to moment. The challenge? Keeping up. Stay relevant by matching the pace and turning complexity into convenience.

Strategy

Strategy

Leading in the next decade

Boldly commit to continuous reinvention and join the small but growing number of companies reaching new levels of profitable growth for their businesses, while also providing greater contributions to humanity.

Supply Chain

Supply Chain

Lead the future with supply chain networks

Anticipate and respond to customer demand. Resilient by design and able to withstand disruptions, supply chain networks drive efficiency, sustainability and growth.

Sustainability

Sustainability

The sustainability imperative

Sustainability spans environmental, social and governance issues. Today every organization must embrace sustainability for future competitiveness.

Talent and Organization

Talent and Organization

Driving growth through people and technology

Thriving organizations are driving change at the intersection of technology and talent. The powerful combination of data and AI and real human experience unlocks new work structures, roles and environments which enable people and businesses to thrive.

Technology Transformation

Technology Transformation

Transform your technology to deliver change faster

Reinvent your digital core with the right strategy, talent and modern practices to increase ROI, drive efficiency and redirect spend to innovations that drive growth.

~250 partnerships to help accelerate change

View all partners

Industries

Unmatched industry expertise

Aerospace and Defense

Aerospace and Defense

Navigate headwinds

From economic uncertainty and supply chain disruptions to skill gaps and shifting consumer expectations, the Aerospace and Defense industry is being challenged. The time is now to embrace a digital-first mindset.

Automotive

Automotive

Get beyond the wheel

The traditional automotive industry has reached a crossroads. We are now operating in a mobility ecosystem, shifting into the next iteration of automotive. To move forward, it’s time to embrace the ecosystem, collaborate beyond industry lines, and find new ways of innovating and partnering for success.

Banking

Banking

Building the next generation of banks

Technology has changed the way people and businesses bank, and traditional strategies no longer work. Now is the time for bold new approaches to intensifying disruption.

Capital Markets

Capital Markets

Capital Markets: See opportunity everywhere

A growing number of retail investors. The transition to low-carbon economies. Infrastructure investments in growing markets. For those who reinvent, constant change is constant opportunity.

Chemicals

Chemicals

Embrace change as a constant

Traditionally seen as a mature, static industry, chemical companies are facing building pressure to move from reactive to proactive and speed innovation.

Communications and Media

Communications and Media

Be hyper-essential for the hyper-connected

People and businesses are always on, whether watching, working, or enabling innovative new growth. Keep them engaged and successful by delivering the continuous experiences and capabilities they expect and need.

Consumer Goods and Services

Consumer Goods and Services

Humans are reinventing the Consumer Goods and Services industry

In the age of digital commerce, it is hard to predict what consumers will buy – and why, when and where they buy it. To stay ahead of uncertainty, think like a consumer and focus on building strong relationships.

Energy

Energy

Use disruption to fuel change

Demand is up. Competition is fierce. People expect sustainability. With inflationary pressures, supply chain network disruptions, and an increased focus on security, energy companies need to change today to compete tomorrow.

Health

Health

Humanizing healthcare

People expect intuitive access to their healthcare and personalized experiences. Leaders that reinvent to create easy access and engaging experiences will stay resilient while delivering better outcomes.

High Tech

High Tech

Transforming the industry that transforms the world

The pressure is on to build innovative tech products and services, reimagine supply chain and manufacturing networks and identify new talent sources. Those who reinvent will lead.

Industrial

Industrial

Excelling at speed in Industrial

A myriad of trends from technology shifts to evolving B2B customer expectations, software-driven product purpose, enhanced services and more are driving companies to embrace continuous reinvention. The time is now to redefine industrial business models.

Insurance

Insurance

Change for resilience

Insurance is protection. As people and societies continuously change, carriers must digitize, connect and personalize to meet today’s more complex customer needs.

Life Science

Life Science

Redefining the possible in Life Sciences

To address the changing needs of patients, rising costs, demands for new treatments, and the need for accelerated R&D innovation, life sciences organizations must adopt a modern transformation approach.

Natural Resources

Natural Resources

Be a steward of the world’s natural resources

As the world looks towards decarbonization, mining, metals, forest products and building materials companies face increasing pressure to shift from being resource producers to resource stewards.

Public Service

Public Service

Create meaningful impact today and build stronger communities for tomorrow

Facing limited resources, increasingly rapid technology advances and a state of perma-crisis, public service organizations who embrace continuous change can have meaningful impact on outcomes for individuals and entire communities.

Private Equity

Private Equity

Reinvent the ways you create value

The next generation of private equity leaders will use an expanded set of value levers to achieve better outcomes.

Retail

Retail

Reset responsibly

Now is the time to responsibly reset, which means better serving the needs of customers, employees and the communities where they live and work. The challenge is to leverage both digital and physical retail experiences to meet new demands—without compromising results.

Software and Platforms

Software and Platforms

A new dawn for the Software & Platforms Industry

The next chapter of hypergrowth is here. Expanded tech, the battle for attention, and macroeconomic shifts have all led to an industry inflection point, with new opportunities on the horizon.

Travel

Travel

Discover new destinations

The travel industry is no stranger to disruption. And in the post-pandemic world, travel companies must continuously reinvent to outwit unforeseen circumstances, while providing cohesive, elevated experiences for customers.

Utilities

Utilities

Radically reinventing power for net zero

Utilities are the cornerstone in the transition to a carbon-neutral world. Achieving net-zero ambitions requires radical moves toward reinvention that will generate sustainable value for all.

See reinvention in action

Every day, we help our clients reinvent their businesses to reach their full potential. Using technology, data, AI and new ways of working. We push boundaries and shape the future of industries.

View client stories

We are an Industry of One

In the 2024 report, Accenture received the highest score in the Current Offering category, and among the highest scores in the Strategy and Market Presence categories.

The research conducted by Forrester evaluated 12 Workday services providers across 25 criteria, including Workday Human Capital Management, Workday Financial Management, Workday Extend and cloud platform, Workday Adaptive Planning, and Workday Analytics and Reporting (Prism).

Per the report, “Accenture merged most of its marketing agencies to form Accenture Song, one of the largest technology-powered marketing service providers in the world.”

For this research, Everest Group assessed 34 marketing services providers. Accenture is the highest Leader on the Vision and Capability axis and the highest leader on the Market Impact axis.

Explore more

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in inaugural IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Life Sciences R&D Lab of the Future Technology Solutions and Consulting Services 2024 Vendor Assessment

In the report, Accenture is positioned as a Leader for both “Strategies” and “Capabilities”.

The IDC MarketScape evaluated 13 vendors who provide services to help implement a Lab of the Future (LotF) strategy and transform and modernize labs across the value chain, from experiment design to manufacturing.

Finance and Risk Management

Finance and Risk Management

Investing to build resilience and reduce enterprise risk

Amid intensifying market disruptions and escalating business volatility, there’s more pressure on Chief Financial Officers (CFOs) and Chief Risk Officers (CROs) to balance multiple interconnected transformations while sustaining company performance, profitability and safety.

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Plan, manage and execute capital projects efficiently

Combine human ingenuity with data and AI to deliver large-scale projects on time and within budget, while also achieving broader investment and sustainability objectives.

Learning

Learning

Become a talent creator

While technology plays a key role in business reinvention, it’s your people who determine its success. How can you build the skills they want, and you need, to grow faster?

Managed Services

Managed Services

Change more, faster

As organizations strive to optimize cost and accelerate growth, strategic managed services can help to better prepare them to reinvent operations and drive holistic value at scale.

Marketing and Experience

Marketing and Experience

Marketing for a multidimensional world

Options multiply. Consumer demands evolve. What’s trending today may not be tomorrow. Relevance is essential for growth—create customer experiences that keep up with change.

Metaverse

Metaverse

Make magic in the metaverse

The physical and virtual worlds are blending. The metaverse offers new ways to connect, create and consume. And it’s a fresh chance to make totally inclusive, responsible experiences.

Sales and Commerce

Sales and Commerce

Commerce at the speed of life

Commerce has blended into culture as preferences shift moment to moment. The challenge? Keeping up. Stay relevant by matching the pace and turning complexity into convenience.

Strategy

Strategy

Leading in the next decade

Boldly commit to continuous reinvention and join the small but growing number of companies reaching new levels of profitable growth for their businesses, while also providing greater contributions to humanity.

Supply Chain

Supply Chain

Lead the future with supply chain networks

Anticipate and respond to customer demand. Resilient by design and able to withstand disruptions, supply chain networks drive efficiency, sustainability and growth.

Sustainability

Sustainability

The sustainability imperative

Sustainability spans environmental, social and governance issues. Today every organization must embrace sustainability for future competitiveness.

Talent and Organization

Talent and Organization

Driving growth through people and technology

Thriving organizations are driving change at the intersection of technology and talent. The powerful combination of data and AI and real human experience unlocks new work structures, roles and environments which enable people and businesses to thrive.

Technology Transformation

Technology Transformation

Transform your technology to deliver change faster

Reinvent your digital core with the right strategy, talent and modern practices to increase ROI, drive efficiency and redirect spend to innovations that drive growth.

~250 partnerships to help accelerate change

View all partners

Industries

Unmatched industry expertise

Aerospace and Defense

Aerospace and Defense

Navigate headwinds

From economic uncertainty and supply chain disruptions to skill gaps and shifting consumer expectations, the Aerospace and Defense industry is being challenged. The time is now to embrace a digital-first mindset.

Automotive

Automotive

Get beyond the wheel

The traditional automotive industry has reached a crossroads. We are now operating in a mobility ecosystem, shifting into the next iteration of automotive. To move forward, it’s time to embrace the ecosystem, collaborate beyond industry lines, and find new ways of innovating and partnering for success.

Banking

Banking

Building the next generation of banks

Technology has changed the way people and businesses bank, and traditional strategies no longer work. Now is the time for bold new approaches to intensifying disruption.

Capital Markets

Capital Markets

Capital Markets: See opportunity everywhere

A growing number of retail investors. The transition to low-carbon economies. Infrastructure investments in growing markets. For those who reinvent, constant change is constant opportunity.

Chemicals

Chemicals

Embrace change as a constant

Traditionally seen as a mature, static industry, chemical companies are facing building pressure to move from reactive to proactive and speed innovation.

Communications and Media

Communications and Media

Be hyper-essential for the hyper-connected

People and businesses are always on, whether watching, working, or enabling innovative new growth. Keep them engaged and successful by delivering the continuous experiences and capabilities they expect and need.

Consumer Goods and Services

Consumer Goods and Services

Humans are reinventing the Consumer Goods and Services industry

In the age of digital commerce, it is hard to predict what consumers will buy – and why, when and where they buy it. To stay ahead of uncertainty, think like a consumer and focus on building strong relationships.

Energy

Energy

Use disruption to fuel change

Demand is up. Competition is fierce. People expect sustainability. With inflationary pressures, supply chain network disruptions, and an increased focus on security, energy companies need to change today to compete tomorrow.

Health

Health

Humanizing healthcare

People expect intuitive access to their healthcare and personalized experiences. Leaders that reinvent to create easy access and engaging experiences will stay resilient while delivering better outcomes.

High Tech

High Tech

Transforming the industry that transforms the world

The pressure is on to build innovative tech products and services, reimagine supply chain and manufacturing networks and identify new talent sources. Those who reinvent will lead.

Industrial

Industrial

Excelling at speed in Industrial

A myriad of trends from technology shifts to evolving B2B customer expectations, software-driven product purpose, enhanced services and more are driving companies to embrace continuous reinvention. The time is now to redefine industrial business models.

Insurance

Insurance

Change for resilience

Insurance is protection. As people and societies continuously change, carriers must digitize, connect and personalize to meet today’s more complex customer needs.

Life Science

Life Science

Redefining the possible in Life Sciences

To address the changing needs of patients, rising costs, demands for new treatments, and the need for accelerated R&D innovation, life sciences organizations must adopt a modern transformation approach.

Natural Resources

Natural Resources

Be a steward of the world’s natural resources

As the world looks towards decarbonization, mining, metals, forest products and building materials companies face increasing pressure to shift from being resource producers to resource stewards.

Public Service

Public Service

Create meaningful impact today and build stronger communities for tomorrow

Facing limited resources, increasingly rapid technology advances and a state of perma-crisis, public service organizations who embrace continuous change can have meaningful impact on outcomes for individuals and entire communities.

Private Equity

Private Equity

Reinvent the ways you create value

The next generation of private equity leaders will use an expanded set of value levers to achieve better outcomes.

Retail

Retail

Reset responsibly

Now is the time to responsibly reset, which means better serving the needs of customers, employees and the communities where they live and work. The challenge is to leverage both digital and physical retail experiences to meet new demands—without compromising results.

Software and Platforms

Software and Platforms

A new dawn for the Software & Platforms Industry

The next chapter of hypergrowth is here. Expanded tech, the battle for attention, and macroeconomic shifts have all led to an industry inflection point, with new opportunities on the horizon.

Travel

Travel

Discover new destinations

The travel industry is no stranger to disruption. And in the post-pandemic world, travel companies must continuously reinvent to outwit unforeseen circumstances, while providing cohesive, elevated experiences for customers.

Utilities

Utilities

Radically reinventing power for net zero

Utilities are the cornerstone in the transition to a carbon-neutral world. Achieving net-zero ambitions requires radical moves toward reinvention that will generate sustainable value for all.

See reinvention in action

Every day, we help our clients reinvent their businesses to reach their full potential. Using technology, data, AI and new ways of working. We push boundaries and shape the future of industries.

View client stories

We are an Industry of One

Awards

Reinvent what your business could be

Our wide range of capabilities, ecosystem partnerships and unmatched industry expertise can help your business become the next best version of itself.

Capabilities

The capabilities to help you reinvent

Cloud

Cloud

Take the world by cloud

Every day, cloud computing becomes more integral in driving reinvention, and meeting the ever-changing needs of people around the world.

Customer Service

Customer Service

Turn customer service and proactive support into a growth engine

Impersonal and inconsistent interactions are leaving organizations scrambling to understand how to better support customers. Delivering seamless, data-driven experiences that feel intuitive, not reactive, is vital to unlocking new opportunities for growth.

Cybersecurity

Cybersecurity

De-risk tomorrow by boosting cybersecurity today

Infuse cybersecurity into your strategy and ecosystem to protect value, help prevent threat and build trust as you grow.

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Use AI with purpose

AI is more accessible than ever, and it’s rapidly transforming enterprises and the ways we live and work. The way you apply its potential will determine the impact and position your business to compete and achieve new levels of performance.

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digitize what you make, revolutionize how you make it

Reimagine the products you make and how you make them. Use data, digital and AI to increase resiliency and productivity and improve security and sustainability across the value chain.

Ecosystem Partners

Ecosystem Partners

From change to value faster

Reinvention doesn’t happen in a silo. Fast-track your journey with integrated applications and platforms that bring the latest industry- and function-specific capabilities, plus advanced data and AI offerings, to empower your people and business.

Emerging Technology

Emerging Technology

Shape the future

In a rapidly changing world, embrace emerging technology to transform and achieve greater efficiency, effectiveness, and breakthrough innovation.

Finance and Risk Management

Finance and Risk Management

Investing to build resilience and reduce enterprise risk

Amid intensifying market disruptions and escalating business volatility, there’s more pressure on Chief Financial Officers (CFOs) and Chief Risk Officers (CROs) to balance multiple interconnected transformations while sustaining company performance, profitability and safety.

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Plan, manage and execute capital projects efficiently

Combine human ingenuity with data and AI to deliver large-scale projects on time and within budget, while also achieving broader investment and sustainability objectives.

Learning

Learning

Become a talent creator

While technology plays a key role in business reinvention, it’s your people who determine its success. How can you build the skills they want, and you need, to grow faster?

Managed Services

Managed Services

Change more, faster

As organizations strive to optimize cost and accelerate growth, strategic managed services can help to better prepare them to reinvent operations and drive holistic value at scale.

Marketing and Experience

Marketing and Experience

Marketing for a multidimensional world

Options multiply. Consumer demands evolve. What’s trending today may not be tomorrow. Relevance is essential for growth—create customer experiences that keep up with change.

Metaverse

Metaverse

Make magic in the metaverse

The physical and virtual worlds are blending. The metaverse offers new ways to connect, create and consume. And it’s a fresh chance to make totally inclusive, responsible experiences.

Sales and Commerce

Sales and Commerce

Commerce at the speed of life

Commerce has blended into culture as preferences shift moment to moment. The challenge? Keeping up. Stay relevant by matching the pace and turning complexity into convenience.

Strategy

Strategy

Leading in the next decade

Boldly commit to continuous reinvention and join the small but growing number of companies reaching new levels of profitable growth for their businesses, while also providing greater contributions to humanity.

Supply Chain

Supply Chain

Lead the future with supply chain networks

Anticipate and respond to customer demand. Resilient by design and able to withstand disruptions, supply chain networks drive efficiency, sustainability and growth.

Sustainability

Sustainability

The sustainability imperative

Sustainability spans environmental, social and governance issues. Today every organization must embrace sustainability for future competitiveness.

Talent and Organization

Talent and Organization

Driving growth through people and technology

Thriving organizations are driving change at the intersection of technology and talent. The powerful combination of data and AI and real human experience unlocks new work structures, roles and environments which enable people and businesses to thrive.

Technology Transformation

Technology Transformation

Transform your technology to deliver change faster

Reinvent your digital core with the right strategy, talent and modern practices to increase ROI, drive efficiency and redirect spend to innovations that drive growth.

~250 partnerships to help accelerate change

View all partners

Industries

Unmatched industry expertise

Aerospace and Defense

Aerospace and Defense

Navigate headwinds

From economic uncertainty and supply chain disruptions to skill gaps and shifting consumer expectations, the Aerospace and Defense industry is being challenged. The time is now to embrace a digital-first mindset.

Automotive

Automotive

Get beyond the wheel

The traditional automotive industry has reached a crossroads. We are now operating in a mobility ecosystem, shifting into the next iteration of automotive. To move forward, it’s time to embrace the ecosystem, collaborate beyond industry lines, and find new ways of innovating and partnering for success.

Banking

Banking

Building the next generation of banks

Technology has changed the way people and businesses bank, and traditional strategies no longer work. Now is the time for bold new approaches to intensifying disruption.

Capital Markets

Capital Markets

Capital Markets: See opportunity everywhere

A growing number of retail investors. The transition to low-carbon economies. Infrastructure investments in growing markets. For those who reinvent, constant change is constant opportunity.

Chemicals

Chemicals

Embrace change as a constant

Traditionally seen as a mature, static industry, chemical companies are facing building pressure to move from reactive to proactive and speed innovation.

Communications and Media

Communications and Media

Be hyper-essential for the hyper-connected

People and businesses are always on, whether watching, working, or enabling innovative new growth. Keep them engaged and successful by delivering the continuous experiences and capabilities they expect and need.

Consumer Goods and Services

Consumer Goods and Services

Humans are reinventing the Consumer Goods and Services industry

In the age of digital commerce, it is hard to predict what consumers will buy – and why, when and where they buy it. To stay ahead of uncertainty, think like a consumer and focus on building strong relationships.

Energy

Energy

Use disruption to fuel change

Demand is up. Competition is fierce. People expect sustainability. With inflationary pressures, supply chain network disruptions, and an increased focus on security, energy companies need to change today to compete tomorrow.

Health

Health

Humanizing healthcare

People expect intuitive access to their healthcare and personalized experiences. Leaders that reinvent to create easy access and engaging experiences will stay resilient while delivering better outcomes.

High Tech

High Tech

Transforming the industry that transforms the world

The pressure is on to build innovative tech products and services, reimagine supply chain and manufacturing networks and identify new talent sources. Those who reinvent will lead.

Industrial

Industrial

Excelling at speed in Industrial

A myriad of trends from technology shifts to evolving B2B customer expectations, software-driven product purpose, enhanced services and more are driving companies to embrace continuous reinvention. The time is now to redefine industrial business models.

Insurance

Insurance

Change for resilience

Insurance is protection. As people and societies continuously change, carriers must digitize, connect and personalize to meet today’s more complex customer needs.

Life Science

Life Science

Redefining the possible in Life Sciences

To address the changing needs of patients, rising costs, demands for new treatments, and the need for accelerated R&D innovation, life sciences organizations must adopt a modern transformation approach.

Natural Resources

Natural Resources

Be a steward of the world’s natural resources

As the world looks towards decarbonization, mining, metals, forest products and building materials companies face increasing pressure to shift from being resource producers to resource stewards.

Public Service

Public Service

Create meaningful impact today and build stronger communities for tomorrow

Facing limited resources, increasingly rapid technology advances and a state of perma-crisis, public service organizations who embrace continuous change can have meaningful impact on outcomes for individuals and entire communities.

Private Equity

Private Equity

Reinvent the ways you create value

Retail

Reset responsibly

Software and Platforms

A new dawn for the Software & Platforms Industry

The next chapter of hypergrowth is here. Expanded tech, the battle for attention, and macroeconomic shifts have all led to an industry inflection point, with new opportunities on the horizon.

Travel

Travel

Discover new destinations

The travel industry is no stranger to disruption. And in the post-pandemic world, travel companies must continuously reinvent to outwit unforeseen circumstances, while providing cohesive, elevated experiences for customers.

Utilities

Radically reinventing power for net zero

Utilities are the cornerstone in the transition to a carbon-neutral world. Achieving net-zero ambitions requires radical moves toward reinvention that will generate sustainable value for all.

See reinvention in action

Every day, we help our clients reinvent their businesses to reach their full potential. Using technology, data, AI and new ways of working. We push boundaries and shape the future of industries.

Reinvent what your business could be

Our wide range of capabilities, ecosystem partnerships and unmatched industry expertise can help your business become the next best version of itself.

Capabilities

The capabilities to help you reinvent

Cloud

Cloud

Take the world by cloud

Every day, cloud computing becomes more integral in driving reinvention, and meeting the ever-changing needs of people around the world.

Customer Service

Customer Service

Turn customer service and proactive support into a growth engine

Impersonal and inconsistent interactions are leaving organizations scrambling to understand how to better support customers. Delivering seamless, data-driven experiences that feel intuitive, not reactive, is vital to unlocking new opportunities for growth.

Cybersecurity

Cybersecurity

De-risk tomorrow by boosting cybersecurity today

Infuse cybersecurity into your strategy and ecosystem to protect value, help prevent threat and build trust as you grow.

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Use AI with purpose

AI is more accessible than ever, and it’s rapidly transforming enterprises and the ways we live and work. The way you apply its potential will determine the impact and position your business to compete and achieve new levels of performance.

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digitize what you make, revolutionize how you make it

Reimagine the products you make and how you make them. Use data, digital and AI to increase resiliency and productivity and improve security and sustainability across the value chain.

Ecosystem Partners

Ecosystem Partners

From change to value faster

Reinvention doesn’t happen in a silo. Fast-track your journey with integrated applications and platforms that bring the latest industry- and function-specific capabilities, plus advanced data and AI offerings, to empower your people and business.

Emerging Technology

Emerging Technology

Shape the future

In a rapidly changing world, embrace emerging technology to transform and achieve greater efficiency, effectiveness, and breakthrough innovation.

Finance and Risk Management

Finance and Risk Management

Investing to build resilience and reduce enterprise risk

Amid intensifying market disruptions and escalating business volatility, there’s more pressure on Chief Financial Officers (CFOs) and Chief Risk Officers (CROs) to balance multiple interconnected transformations while sustaining company performance, profitability and safety.

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Plan, manage and execute capital projects efficiently

Combine human ingenuity with data and AI to deliver large-scale projects on time and within budget, while also achieving broader investment and sustainability objectives.

Learning

Learning

Become a talent creator

While technology plays a key role in business reinvention, it’s your people who determine its success. How can you build the skills they want, and you need, to grow faster?

Managed Services

Managed Services

Change more, faster

As organizations strive to optimize cost and accelerate growth, strategic managed services can help to better prepare them to reinvent operations and drive holistic value at scale.

Marketing and Experience

Marketing and Experience

Marketing for a multidimensional world

Options multiply. Consumer demands evolve. What’s trending today may not be tomorrow. Relevance is essential for growth—create customer experiences that keep up with change.

Metaverse

Metaverse

Make magic in the metaverse

The physical and virtual worlds are blending. The metaverse offers new ways to connect, create and consume. And it’s a fresh chance to make totally inclusive, responsible experiences.

Sales and Commerce

Sales and Commerce

Commerce at the speed of life

Commerce has blended into culture as preferences shift moment to moment. The challenge? Keeping up. Stay relevant by matching the pace and turning complexity into convenience.

Strategy

Strategy

Leading in the next decade

Boldly commit to continuous reinvention and join the small but growing number of companies reaching new levels of profitable growth for their businesses, while also providing greater contributions to humanity.

Supply Chain

Supply Chain

Lead the future with supply chain networks

Anticipate and respond to customer demand. Resilient by design and able to withstand disruptions, supply chain networks drive efficiency, sustainability and growth.

Sustainability

Sustainability

The sustainability imperative

Sustainability spans environmental, social and governance issues. Today every organization must embrace sustainability for future competitiveness.

Talent and Organization

Talent and Organization

Driving growth through people and technology

Thriving organizations are driving change at the intersection of technology and talent. The powerful combination of data and AI and real human experience unlocks new work structures, roles and environments which enable people and businesses to thrive.

Technology Transformation

Technology Transformation

Transform your technology to deliver change faster

Reinvent your digital core with the right strategy, talent and modern practices to increase ROI, drive efficiency and redirect spend to innovations that drive growth.

~250 partnerships to help accelerate change

View all partners

Industries

Unmatched industry expertise

Aerospace and Defense

Aerospace and Defense

Navigate headwinds

From economic uncertainty and supply chain disruptions to skill gaps and shifting consumer expectations, the Aerospace and Defense industry is being challenged. The time is now to embrace a digital-first mindset.

Automotive

Automotive

Get beyond the wheel

The traditional automotive industry has reached a crossroads. We are now operating in a mobility ecosystem, shifting into the next iteration of automotive. To move forward, it’s time to embrace the ecosystem, collaborate beyond industry lines, and find new ways of innovating and partnering for success.

Banking

Banking

Building the next generation of banks

Technology has changed the way people and businesses bank, and traditional strategies no longer work. Now is the time for bold new approaches to intensifying disruption.

Capital Markets

Capital Markets

Capital Markets: See opportunity everywhere

A growing number of retail investors. The transition to low-carbon economies. Infrastructure investments in growing markets. For those who reinvent, constant change is constant opportunity.

Chemicals

Chemicals

Embrace change as a constant

Traditionally seen as a mature, static industry, chemical companies are facing building pressure to move from reactive to proactive and speed innovation.

Communications and Media

Communications and Media

Be hyper-essential for the hyper-connected

People and businesses are always on, whether watching, working, or enabling innovative new growth. Keep them engaged and successful by delivering the continuous experiences and capabilities they expect and need.

Consumer Goods and Services

Consumer Goods and Services

Humans are reinventing the Consumer Goods and Services industry

In the age of digital commerce, it is hard to predict what consumers will buy – and why, when and where they buy it. To stay ahead of uncertainty, think like a consumer and focus on building strong relationships.

Energy

Energy

Use disruption to fuel change

Demand is up. Competition is fierce. People expect sustainability. With inflationary pressures, supply chain network disruptions, and an increased focus on security, energy companies need to change today to compete tomorrow.

Health

Health

Humanizing healthcare

People expect intuitive access to their healthcare and personalized experiences. Leaders that reinvent to create easy access and engaging experiences will stay resilient while delivering better outcomes.

High Tech

High Tech

Transforming the industry that transforms the world

The pressure is on to build innovative tech products and services, reimagine supply chain and manufacturing networks and identify new talent sources. Those who reinvent will lead.

Industrial

Industrial

Excelling at speed in Industrial

A myriad of trends from technology shifts to evolving B2B customer expectations, software-driven product purpose, enhanced services and more are driving companies to embrace continuous reinvention. The time is now to redefine industrial business models.

Insurance

Insurance

Change for resilience

Insurance is protection. As people and societies continuously change, carriers must digitize, connect and personalize to meet today’s more complex customer needs.

Life Science

Life Science

Redefining the possible in Life Sciences

To address the changing needs of patients, rising costs, demands for new treatments, and the need for accelerated R&D innovation, life sciences organizations must adopt a modern transformation approach.

Natural Resources

Natural Resources

Be a steward of the world’s natural resources

As the world looks towards decarbonization, mining, metals, forest products and building materials companies face increasing pressure to shift from being resource producers to resource stewards.

Public Service

Public Service

Create meaningful impact today and build stronger communities for tomorrow

Facing limited resources, increasingly rapid technology advances and a state of perma-crisis, public service organizations who embrace continuous change can have meaningful impact on outcomes for individuals and entire communities.

Private Equity

Private Equity

Reinvent the ways you create value

The next generation of private equity leaders will use an expanded set of value levers to achieve better outcomes.

Retail

Retail

Reset responsibly

Now is the time to responsibly reset, which means better serving the needs of customers, employees and the communities where they live and work. The challenge is to leverage both digital and physical retail experiences to meet new demands—without compromising results.

Software and Platforms

Software and Platforms

A new dawn for the Software & Platforms Industry

The next chapter of hypergrowth is here. Expanded tech, the battle for attention, and macroeconomic shifts have all led to an industry inflection point, with new opportunities on the horizon.

Travel

Travel

Discover new destinations

The travel industry is no stranger to disruption. And in the post-pandemic world, travel companies must continuously reinvent to outwit unforeseen circumstances, while providing cohesive, elevated experiences for customers.

Utilities

Utilities

Radically reinventing power for net zero

Utilities are the cornerstone in the transition to a carbon-neutral world. Achieving net-zero ambitions requires radical moves toward reinvention that will generate sustainable value for all.

See reinvention in action

Every day, we help our clients reinvent their businesses to reach their full potential. Using technology, data, AI and new ways of working. We push boundaries and shape the future of industries.

View client stories

We are an Industry of One

In the 2024 report, Accenture received the highest score in the Current Offering category, and among the highest scores in the Strategy and Market Presence categories.

The research conducted by Forrester evaluated 12 Workday services providers across 25 criteria, including Workday Human Capital Management, Workday Financial Management, Workday Extend and cloud platform, Workday Adaptive Planning, and Workday Analytics and Reporting (Prism).

For this research, Everest Group assessed 34 marketing services providers. Accenture is the highest Leader on the Vision and Capability axis and the highest leader on the Market Impact axis.

Explore more

We are a Leader in inaugural IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Life Sciences R&D Lab of the Future Technology Solutions and Consulting Services 2024 Vendor Assessment

In the report, Accenture is positioned as a Leader for both “Strategies” and “Capabilities”.

The IDC MarketScape evaluated 13 vendors who provide services to help implement a Lab of the Future (LotF) strategy and transform and modernize labs across the value chain, from experiment design to manufacturing.
