Case studies

Awards

Reinvent what your business could be

Our wide range of capabilities, ecosystem partnerships and unmatched industry expertise can help your business become the next best version of itself.

Capabilities

The capabilities to help you reinvent

Cloud

Cloud

Take the world by cloud

Every day, cloud computing becomes more integral in driving reinvention, and meeting the ever-changing needs of people around the world.

Customer Service

Customer Service

Turn customer service and proactive support into a growth engine

Impersonal and inconsistent interactions are leaving organizations scrambling to understand how to better support customers. Delivering seamless, data-driven experiences that feel intuitive, not reactive, is vital to unlocking new opportunities for growth.

Cybersecurity

Cybersecurity

De-risk tomorrow by boosting cybersecurity today

Infuse cybersecurity into your strategy and ecosystem to protect value, help prevent threat and build trust as you grow.

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Use AI with purpose

AI is more accessible than ever, and it’s rapidly transforming enterprises and the ways we live and work. The way you apply its potential will determine the impact and position your business to compete and achieve new levels of performance.

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digitize what you make, revolutionize how you make it

Reimagine the products you make and how you make them. Use data, digital and AI to increase resiliency and productivity and improve security and sustainability across the value chain.

Ecosystem Partners

Ecosystem Partners

From change to value faster

Reinvention doesn’t happen in a silo. Fast-track your journey with integrated applications and platforms that bring the latest industry- and function-specific capabilities, plus advanced data and AI offerings, to empower your people and business.

Emerging Technology

Emerging Technology

Shape the future

In a rapidly changing world, embrace emerging technology to transform and achieve greater efficiency, effectiveness, and breakthrough innovation.

Finance and Risk Management

Finance and Risk Management

Investing to build resilience and reduce enterprise risk

Amid intensifying market disruptions and escalating business volatility, there’s more pressure on Chief Financial Officers (CFOs) and Chief Risk Officers (CROs) to balance multiple interconnected transformations while sustaining company performance, profitability and safety.

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Plan, manage and execute capital projects efficiently

Combine human ingenuity with data and AI to deliver large-scale projects on time and within budget, while also achieving broader investment and sustainability objectives.

Learning

Learning

Become a talent creator

While technology plays a key role in business reinvention, it’s your people who determine its success. How can you build the skills they want, and you need, to grow faster?

Managed Services

Managed Services

Change more, faster

As organizations strive to optimize cost and accelerate growth, strategic managed services can help to better prepare them to reinvent operations and drive holistic value at scale.

Marketing and Experience

Marketing and Experience

Marketing for a multidimensional world

Options multiply. Consumer demands evolve. What’s trending today may not be tomorrow. Relevance is essential for growth—create customer experiences that keep up with change.

Metaverse

Metaverse

Make magic in the metaverse

The physical and virtual worlds are blending. The metaverse offers new ways to connect, create and consume. And it’s a fresh chance to make totally inclusive, responsible experiences.

Sales and Commerce

Sales and Commerce

Commerce at the speed of life

Commerce has blended into culture as preferences shift moment to moment. The challenge? Keeping up. Stay relevant by matching the pace and turning complexity into convenience.

Strategy

Strategy

Leading in the next decade

Boldly commit to continuous reinvention and join the small but growing number of companies reaching new levels of profitable growth for their businesses, while also providing greater contributions to humanity.

Supply Chain

Supply Chain

Lead the future with supply chain networks

Anticipate and respond to customer demand. Resilient by design and able to withstand disruptions, supply chain networks drive efficiency, sustainability and growth.

Sustainability

Sustainability

The sustainability imperative

Sustainability spans environmental, social and governance issues. Today every organization must embrace sustainability for future competitiveness.

Talent and Organization

Talent and Organization

Driving growth through people and technology

Thriving organizations are driving change at the intersection of technology and talent. The powerful combination of data and AI and real human experience unlocks new work structures, roles and environments which enable people and businesses to thrive.

Technology Transformation

Technology Transformation

Transform your technology to deliver change faster

Reinvent your digital core with the right strategy, talent and modern practices to increase ROI, drive efficiency and redirect spend to innovations that drive growth.

~250 partnerships to help accelerate change

View all partners

Industries

Unmatched industry expertise

Aerospace and Defense

Aerospace and Defense

Navigate headwinds

From economic uncertainty and supply chain disruptions to skill gaps and shifting consumer expectations, the Aerospace and Defense industry is being challenged. The time is now to embrace a digital-first mindset.

Automotive

Automotive

Get beyond the wheel

The traditional automotive industry has reached a crossroads. We are now operating in a mobility ecosystem, shifting into the next iteration of automotive. To move forward, it’s time to embrace the ecosystem, collaborate beyond industry lines, and find new ways of innovating and partnering for success.

Banking

Banking

Building the next generation of banks

Technology has changed the way people and businesses bank, and traditional strategies no longer work. Now is the time for bold new approaches to intensifying disruption.

Capital Markets

Capital Markets

Capital Markets: See opportunity everywhere

A growing number of retail investors. The transition to low-carbon economies. Infrastructure investments in growing markets. For those who reinvent, constant change is constant opportunity.

Chemicals

Chemicals

Embrace change as a constant

Traditionally seen as a mature, static industry, chemical companies are facing building pressure to move from reactive to proactive and speed innovation.

Communications and Media

Communications and Media

Be hyper-essential for the hyper-connected

People and businesses are always on, whether watching, working, or enabling innovative new growth. Keep them engaged and successful by delivering the continuous experiences and capabilities they expect and need.

Consumer Goods and Services

Consumer Goods and Services

Humans are reinventing the Consumer Goods and Services industry

In the age of digital commerce, it is hard to predict what consumers will buy – and why, when and where they buy it. To stay ahead of uncertainty, think like a consumer and focus on building strong relationships.

Energy

Energy

Use disruption to fuel change

Demand is up. Competition is fierce. People expect sustainability. With inflationary pressures, supply chain network disruptions, and an increased focus on security, energy companies need to change today to compete tomorrow.

Health

Health

Humanizing healthcare

People expect intuitive access to their healthcare and personalized experiences. Leaders that reinvent to create easy access and engaging experiences will stay resilient while delivering better outcomes.

High Tech

High Tech

Transforming the industry that transforms the world

The pressure is on to build innovative tech products and services, reimagine supply chain and manufacturing networks and identify new talent sources. Those who reinvent will lead.

Industrial

Industrial

Excelling at speed in Industrial

A myriad of trends from technology shifts to evolving B2B customer expectations, software-driven product purpose, enhanced services and more are driving companies to embrace continuous reinvention. The time is now to redefine industrial business models.

Insurance

Insurance

Change for resilience

Insurance is protection. As people and societies continuously change, carriers must digitize, connect and personalize to meet today’s more complex customer needs.

Life Science

Life Science

Redefining the possible in Life Sciences

To address the changing needs of patients, rising costs, demands for new treatments, and the need for accelerated R&D innovation, life sciences organizations must adopt a modern transformation approach.

Natural Resources

Natural Resources

Be a steward of the world’s natural resources

As the world looks towards decarbonization, mining, metals, forest products and building materials companies face increasing pressure to shift from being resource producers to resource stewards.

Public Service

Public Service

Create meaningful impact today and build stronger communities for tomorrow

Facing limited resources, increasingly rapid technology advances and a state of perma-crisis, public service organizations who embrace continuous change can have meaningful impact on outcomes for individuals and entire communities.

Private Equity

Private Equity

Reinvent the ways you create value

The next generation of private equity leaders will use an expanded set of value levers to achieve better outcomes.

Retail

Retail

Reset responsibly

Now is the time to responsibly reset, which means better serving the needs of customers, employees and the communities where they live and work. The challenge is to leverage both digital and physical retail experiences to meet new demands—without compromising results.

Software and Platforms

Software and Platforms

A new dawn for the Software & Platforms Industry

The next chapter of hypergrowth is here. Expanded tech, the battle for attention, and macroeconomic shifts have all led to an industry inflection point, with new opportunities on the horizon.

Travel

Travel

Discover new destinations

The travel industry is no stranger to disruption. And in the post-pandemic world, travel companies must continuously reinvent to outwit unforeseen circumstances, while providing cohesive, elevated experiences for customers.

Utilities

Utilities

Radically reinventing power for net zero

Utilities are the cornerstone in the transition to a carbon-neutral world. Achieving net-zero ambitions requires radical moves toward reinvention that will generate sustainable value for all.

See reinvention in action

Every day, we help our clients reinvent their businesses to reach their full potential. Using technology, data, AI and new ways of working. We push boundaries and shape the future of industries.

View client stories

We are an Industry of One

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in The Forrester Wave™: Workday Services, Q2 2024

In the 2024 report, Accenture received the highest score in the Current Offering category, and among the highest scores in the Strategy and Market Presence categories.

The research conducted by Forrester evaluated 12 Workday services providers across 25 criteria, including Workday Human Capital Management, Workday Financial Management, Workday Extend and cloud platform, Workday Adaptive Planning, and Workday Analytics and Reporting (Prism).

Explore more

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in Everest Group’s PEAK Matrix: Marketing Services Assessment 2024

Per the report, “Accenture merged most of its marketing agencies to form Accenture Song, one of the largest technology-powered marketing service providers in the world.”

For this research, Everest Group assessed 34 marketing services providers. Accenture is the highest Leader on the Vision and Capability axis and the highest leader on the Market Impact axis.

Explore more

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in inaugural IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Life Sciences R&D Lab of the Future Technology Solutions and Consulting Services 2024 Vendor Assessment

In the report, Accenture is positioned as a Leader for both “Strategies” and “Capabilities”.

The IDC MarketScape evaluated 13 vendors who provide services to help implement a Lab of the Future (LotF) strategy and transform and modernize labs across the value chain, from experiment design to manufacturing.

Reinvent what your business could be

Our wide range of capabilities, ecosystem partnerships and unmatched industry expertise can help your business become the next best version of itself.

Capabilities

The capabilities to help you reinvent

Cloud

Cloud

Take the world by cloud

Every day, cloud computing becomes more integral in driving reinvention, and meeting the ever-changing needs of people around the world.

Customer Service

Customer Service

Turn customer service and proactive support into a growth engine

Impersonal and inconsistent interactions are leaving organizations scrambling to understand how to better support customers. Delivering seamless, data-driven experiences that feel intuitive, not reactive, is vital to unlocking new opportunities for growth.

Cybersecurity

Cybersecurity

De-risk tomorrow by boosting cybersecurity today

Infuse cybersecurity into your strategy and ecosystem to protect value, help prevent threat and build trust as you grow.

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Use AI with purpose

AI is more accessible than ever, and it’s rapidly transforming enterprises and the ways we live and work. The way you apply its potential will determine the impact and position your business to compete and achieve new levels of performance.

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digitize what you make, revolutionize how you make it

Reimagine the products you make and how you make them. Use data, digital and AI to increase resiliency and productivity and improve security and sustainability across the value chain.

Ecosystem Partners

Ecosystem Partners

From change to value faster

Reinvention doesn’t happen in a silo. Fast-track your journey with integrated applications and platforms that bring the latest industry- and function-specific capabilities, plus advanced data and AI offerings, to empower your people and business.

Emerging Technology

Emerging Technology

Shape the future

In a rapidly changing world, embrace emerging technology to transform and achieve greater efficiency, effectiveness, and breakthrough innovation.

Finance and Risk Management

Finance and Risk Management

Investing to build resilience and reduce enterprise risk

Amid intensifying market disruptions and escalating business volatility, there’s more pressure on Chief Financial Officers (CFOs) and Chief Risk Officers (CROs) to balance multiple interconnected transformations while sustaining company performance, profitability and safety.

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Plan, manage and execute capital projects efficiently

Combine human ingenuity with data and AI to deliver large-scale projects on time and within budget, while also achieving broader investment and sustainability objectives.

Learning

Learning

Become a talent creator

While technology plays a key role in business reinvention, it’s your people who determine its success. How can you build the skills they want, and you need, to grow faster?

Managed Services

Managed Services

Change more, faster

As organizations strive to optimize cost and accelerate growth, strategic managed services can help to better prepare them to reinvent operations and drive holistic value at scale.

Marketing and Experience

Marketing and Experience

Marketing for a multidimensional world

Options multiply. Consumer demands evolve. What’s trending today may not be tomorrow. Relevance is essential for growth—create customer experiences that keep up with change.

Metaverse

Metaverse

Make magic in the metaverse

The physical and virtual worlds are blending. The metaverse offers new ways to connect, create and consume. And it’s a fresh chance to make totally inclusive, responsible experiences.

Sales and Commerce

Sales and Commerce

Commerce at the speed of life

Commerce has blended into culture as preferences shift moment to moment. The challenge? Keeping up. Stay relevant by matching the pace and turning complexity into convenience.

Strategy

Strategy

Leading in the next decade

Boldly commit to continuous reinvention and join the small but growing number of companies reaching new levels of profitable growth for their businesses, while also providing greater contributions to humanity.

Supply Chain

Supply Chain

Lead the future with supply chain networks

Anticipate and respond to customer demand. Resilient by design and able to withstand disruptions, supply chain networks drive efficiency, sustainability and growth.

Sustainability

Sustainability

The sustainability imperative

Sustainability spans environmental, social and governance issues. Today every organization must embrace sustainability for future competitiveness.

Talent and Organization

Talent and Organization

Driving growth through people and technology

Thriving organizations are driving change at the intersection of technology and talent. The powerful combination of data and AI and real human experience unlocks new work structures, roles and environments which enable people and businesses to thrive.

Technology Transformation

Technology Transformation

Transform your technology to deliver change faster

Reinvent your digital core with the right strategy, talent and modern practices to increase ROI, drive efficiency and redirect spend to innovations that drive growth.

~250 partnerships to help accelerate change

View all partners

Industries

Unmatched industry expertise

Aerospace and Defense

Aerospace and Defense

Navigate headwinds

From economic uncertainty and supply chain disruptions to skill gaps and shifting consumer expectations, the Aerospace and Defense industry is being challenged. The time is now to embrace a digital-first mindset.

Automotive

Automotive

Get beyond the wheel

The traditional automotive industry has reached a crossroads. We are now operating in a mobility ecosystem, shifting into the next iteration of automotive. To move forward, it’s time to embrace the ecosystem, collaborate beyond industry lines, and find new ways of innovating and partnering for success.

Banking

Banking

Building the next generation of banks

Technology has changed the way people and businesses bank, and traditional strategies no longer work. Now is the time for bold new approaches to intensifying disruption.

Capital Markets

Capital Markets

Capital Markets: See opportunity everywhere

A growing number of retail investors. The transition to low-carbon economies. Infrastructure investments in growing markets. For those who reinvent, constant change is constant opportunity.

Chemicals

Chemicals

Embrace change as a constant

Traditionally seen as a mature, static industry, chemical companies are facing building pressure to move from reactive to proactive and speed innovation.

Communications and Media

Communications and Media

Be hyper-essential for the hyper-connected

People and businesses are always on, whether watching, working, or enabling innovative new growth. Keep them engaged and successful by delivering the continuous experiences and capabilities they expect and need.

Consumer Goods and Services

Consumer Goods and Services

Humans are reinventing the Consumer Goods and Services industry

In the age of digital commerce, it is hard to predict what consumers will buy – and why, when and where they buy it. To stay ahead of uncertainty, think like a consumer and focus on building strong relationships.

Energy

Energy

Use disruption to fuel change

Demand is up. Competition is fierce. People expect sustainability. With inflationary pressures, supply chain network disruptions, and an increased focus on security, energy companies need to change today to compete tomorrow.

Health

Health

Humanizing healthcare

People expect intuitive access to their healthcare and personalized experiences. Leaders that reinvent to create easy access and engaging experiences will stay resilient while delivering better outcomes.

High Tech

High Tech

Transforming the industry that transforms the world

The pressure is on to build innovative tech products and services, reimagine supply chain and manufacturing networks and identify new talent sources. Those who reinvent will lead.

Industrial

Industrial

Excelling at speed in Industrial

A myriad of trends from technology shifts to evolving B2B customer expectations, software-driven product purpose, enhanced services and more are driving companies to embrace continuous reinvention. The time is now to redefine industrial business models.

Insurance

Insurance

Change for resilience

Insurance is protection. As people and societies continuously change, carriers must digitize, connect and personalize to meet today’s more complex customer needs.

Life Science

Life Science

Redefining the possible in Life Sciences

To address the changing needs of patients, rising costs, demands for new treatments, and the need for accelerated R&D innovation, life sciences organizations must adopt a modern transformation approach.

Natural Resources

Natural Resources

Be a steward of the world’s natural resources

As the world looks towards decarbonization, mining, metals, forest products and building materials companies face increasing pressure to shift from being resource producers to resource stewards.

Public Service

Public Service

Create meaningful impact today and build stronger communities for tomorrow

Facing limited resources, increasingly rapid technology advances and a state of perma-crisis, public service organizations who embrace continuous change can have meaningful impact on outcomes for individuals and entire communities.

Private Equity

Private Equity

Reinvent the ways you create value

The next generation of private equity leaders will use an expanded set of value levers to achieve better outcomes.

Retail

Retail

Reset responsibly

Now is the time to responsibly reset, which means better serving the needs of customers, employees and the communities where they live and work. The challenge is to leverage both digital and physical retail experiences to meet new demands—without compromising results.

Software and Platforms

Software and Platforms

A new dawn for the Software & Platforms Industry

The next chapter of hypergrowth is here. Expanded tech, the battle for attention, and macroeconomic shifts have all led to an industry inflection point, with new opportunities on the horizon.

Travel

Travel

Discover new destinations

The travel industry is no stranger to disruption. And in the post-pandemic world, travel companies must continuously reinvent to outwit unforeseen circumstances, while providing cohesive, elevated experiences for customers.

Utilities

Utilities

Radically reinventing power for net zero

Utilities are the cornerstone in the transition to a carbon-neutral world. Achieving net-zero ambitions requires radical moves toward reinvention that will generate sustainable value for all.

See reinvention in action

Every day, we help our clients reinvent their businesses to reach their full potential. Using technology, data, AI and new ways of working. We push boundaries and shape the future of industries.

View client stories

Awards

Reinvent what your business could be

Our wide range of capabilities, ecosystem partnerships and unmatched industry expertise can help your business become the next best version of itself.

Capabilities

The capabilities to help you reinvent

Cloud

Cloud

Take the world by cloud

Every day, cloud computing becomes more integral in driving reinvention, and meeting the ever-changing needs of people around the world.

Customer Service

Customer Service

Turn customer service and proactive support into a growth engine

Impersonal and inconsistent interactions are leaving organizations scrambling to understand how to better support customers. Delivering seamless, data-driven experiences that feel intuitive, not reactive, is vital to unlocking new opportunities for growth.

Cybersecurity

Cybersecurity

De-risk tomorrow by boosting cybersecurity today

Infuse cybersecurity into your strategy and ecosystem to protect value, help prevent threat and build trust as you grow.

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Use AI with purpose

AI is more accessible than ever, and it’s rapidly transforming enterprises and the ways we live and work. The way you apply its potential will determine the impact and position your business to compete and achieve new levels of performance.

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digitize what you make, revolutionize how you make it

Reimagine the products you make and how you make them. Use data, digital and AI to increase resiliency and productivity and improve security and sustainability across the value chain.

Ecosystem Partners

Ecosystem Partners

From change to value faster

Reinvention doesn’t happen in a silo. Fast-track your journey with integrated applications and platforms that bring the latest industry- and function-specific capabilities, plus advanced data and AI offerings, to empower your people and business.

Emerging Technology

Emerging Technology

Shape the future

In a rapidly changing world, embrace emerging technology to transform and achieve greater efficiency, effectiveness, and breakthrough innovation.

Finance and Risk Management

Finance and Risk Management

Investing to build resilience and reduce enterprise risk

Amid intensifying market disruptions and escalating business volatility, there’s more pressure on Chief Financial Officers (CFOs) and Chief Risk Officers (CROs) to balance multiple interconnected transformations while sustaining company performance, profitability and safety.

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Plan, manage and execute capital projects efficiently

Combine human ingenuity with data and AI to deliver large-scale projects on time and within budget, while also achieving broader investment and sustainability objectives.

Learning

Learning

Become a talent creator

While technology plays a key role in business reinvention, it’s your people who determine its success. How can you build the skills they want, and you need, to grow faster?

Managed Services

Managed Services

Change more, faster

As organizations strive to optimize cost and accelerate growth, strategic managed services can help to better prepare them to reinvent operations and drive holistic value at scale.

Marketing and Experience

Marketing and Experience

Marketing for a multidimensional world

Options multiply. Consumer demands evolve. What’s trending today may not be tomorrow. Relevance is essential for growth—create customer experiences that keep up with change.

Metaverse

Metaverse

Make magic in the metaverse

The physical and virtual worlds are blending. The metaverse offers new ways to connect, create and consume. And it’s a fresh chance to make totally inclusive, responsible experiences.

Sales and Commerce

Sales and Commerce

Commerce at the speed of life

Commerce has blended into culture as preferences shift moment to moment. The challenge? Keeping up. Stay relevant by matching the pace and turning complexity into convenience.

Strategy

Strategy

Leading in the next decade

Boldly commit to continuous reinvention and join the small but growing number of companies reaching new levels of profitable growth for their businesses, while also providing greater contributions to humanity.

Supply Chain

Supply Chain

Lead the future with supply chain networks

Anticipate and respond to customer demand. Resilient by design and able to withstand disruptions, supply chain networks drive efficiency, sustainability and growth.

Sustainability

Sustainability

The sustainability imperative

Sustainability spans environmental, social and governance issues. Today every organization must embrace sustainability for future competitiveness.

Talent and Organization

Talent and Organization

Driving growth through people and technology

Thriving organizations are driving change at the intersection of technology and talent. The powerful combination of data and AI and real human experience unlocks new work structures, roles and environments which enable people and businesses to thrive.

Technology Transformation

Technology Transformation

Transform your technology to deliver change faster

Reinvent your digital core with the right strategy, talent and modern practices to increase ROI, drive efficiency and redirect spend to innovations that drive growth.

~250 partnerships to help accelerate change

View all partners

Industries

Unmatched industry expertise

Aerospace and Defense

Aerospace and Defense

Navigate headwinds

From economic uncertainty and supply chain disruptions to skill gaps and shifting consumer expectations, the Aerospace and Defense industry is being challenged. The time is now to embrace a digital-first mindset.

Automotive

Automotive

Get beyond the wheel

The traditional automotive industry has reached a crossroads. We are now operating in a mobility ecosystem, shifting into the next iteration of automotive. To move forward, it’s time to embrace the ecosystem, collaborate beyond industry lines, and find new ways of innovating and partnering for success.

Banking

Banking

Building the next generation of banks

Technology has changed the way people and businesses bank, and traditional strategies no longer work. Now is the time for bold new approaches to intensifying disruption.

Capital Markets

Capital Markets

Capital Markets: See opportunity everywhere

A growing number of retail investors. The transition to low-carbon economies. Infrastructure investments in growing markets. For those who reinvent, constant change is constant opportunity.

Chemicals

Chemicals

Embrace change as a constant

Traditionally seen as a mature, static industry, chemical companies are facing building pressure to move from reactive to proactive and speed innovation.

Communications and Media

Communications and Media

Be hyper-essential for the hyper-connected

People and businesses are always on, whether watching, working, or enabling innovative new growth. Keep them engaged and successful by delivering the continuous experiences and capabilities they expect and need.

Consumer Goods and Services

Consumer Goods and Services

Humans are reinventing the Consumer Goods and Services industry

In the age of digital commerce, it is hard to predict what consumers will buy – and why, when and where they buy it. To stay ahead of uncertainty, think like a consumer and focus on building strong relationships.

Energy

Energy

Use disruption to fuel change

Demand is up. Competition is fierce. People expect sustainability. With inflationary pressures, supply chain network disruptions, and an increased focus on security, energy companies need to change today to compete tomorrow.

Health

Health

Humanizing healthcare

People expect intuitive access to their healthcare and personalized experiences. Leaders that reinvent to create easy access and engaging experiences will stay resilient while delivering better outcomes.

High Tech

High Tech

Transforming the industry that transforms the world

The pressure is on to build innovative tech products and services, reimagine supply chain and manufacturing networks and identify new talent sources. Those who reinvent will lead.

Industrial

Industrial

Excelling at speed in Industrial

A myriad of trends from technology shifts to evolving B2B customer expectations, software-driven product purpose, enhanced services and more are driving companies to embrace continuous reinvention. The time is now to redefine industrial business models.

Insurance

Insurance

Change for resilience

Insurance is protection. As people and societies continuously change, carriers must digitize, connect and personalize to meet today’s more complex customer needs.

Life Science

Life Science

Redefining the possible in Life Sciences

To address the changing needs of patients, rising costs, demands for new treatments, and the need for accelerated R&D innovation, life sciences organizations must adopt a modern transformation approach.

Natural Resources

Natural Resources

Be a steward of the world’s natural resources

As the world looks towards decarbonization, mining, metals, forest products and building materials companies face increasing pressure to shift from being resource producers to resource stewards.

Public Service

Public Service

Create meaningful impact today and build stronger communities for tomorrow

Facing limited resources, increasingly rapid technology advances and a state of perma-crisis, public service organizations who embrace continuous change can have meaningful impact on outcomes for individuals and entire communities.

Private Equity

Private Equity

Reinvent the ways you create value

The next generation of private equity leaders will use an expanded set of value levers to achieve better outcomes.

Retail

Retail

Reset responsibly

Now is the time to responsibly reset, which means better serving the needs of customers, employees and the communities where they live and work. The challenge is to leverage both digital and physical retail experiences to meet new demands—without compromising results.

Software and Platforms

Software and Platforms

A new dawn for the Software & Platforms Industry

The next chapter of hypergrowth is here. Expanded tech, the battle for attention, and macroeconomic shifts have all led to an industry inflection point, with new opportunities on the horizon.

Travel

Travel

Discover new destinations

The travel industry is no stranger to disruption. And in the post-pandemic world, travel companies must continuously reinvent to outwit unforeseen circumstances, while providing cohesive, elevated experiences for customers.

Utilities

Utilities

Radically reinventing power for net zero

Utilities are the cornerstone in the transition to a carbon-neutral world. Achieving net-zero ambitions requires radical moves toward reinvention that will generate sustainable value for all.

See reinvention in action

Every day, we help our clients reinvent their businesses to reach their full potential. Using technology, data, AI and new ways of working. We push boundaries and shape the future of industries.

View client stories

We are an Industry of One

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in The Forrester Wave™: Workday Services, Q2 2024

In the 2024 report, Accenture received the highest score in the Current Offering category, and among the highest scores in the Strategy and Market Presence categories.

The research conducted by Forrester evaluated 12 Workday services providers across 25 criteria, including Workday Human Capital Management, Workday Financial Management, Workday Extend and cloud platform, Workday Adaptive Planning, and Workday Analytics and Reporting (Prism).

Explore more

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in Everest Group’s PEAK Matrix: Marketing Services Assessment 2024

Per the report, “Accenture merged most of its marketing agencies to form Accenture Song, one of the largest technology-powered marketing service providers in the world.”

For this research, Everest Group assessed 34 marketing services providers. Accenture is the highest Leader on the Vision and Capability axis and the highest leader on the Market Impact axis.

Explore more

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in inaugural IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Life Sciences R&D Lab of the Future Technology Solutions and Consulting Services 2024 Vendor Assessment

In the report, Accenture is positioned as a Leader for both “Strategies” and “Capabilities”.

The IDC MarketScape evaluated 13 vendors who provide services to help implement a Lab of the Future (LotF) strategy and transform and modernize labs across the value chain, from experiment design to manufacturing.

Juntos podemos reinventar tu empresa

Nuestra amplia gama de capacidades, asociaciones con el ecosistema y experiencia inigualable en la industria pueden ayudar a que tu empresa se convierta en la próxima mejor versión de sí misma.

Capacidades

Las capacidades que te ayudarán a reinventarte

Nube

Nube

Conquista el mundo con la nube

Cada día, la computación en la nube es más integral para impulsar la reinvención y satisfacer las necesidades siempre cambiantes de las personas en todo el mundo.

Servicio al cliente

Servicio al cliente

Convierte el servicio al cliente y el soporte proactivo en un motor de crecimiento

Las interacciones impersonales e inconsistentes están haciendo que las organizaciones se encuentren desesperadas por entender cómo pueden apoyar mejor a los clientes. Ofrecer experiencias perfectas e impulsadas por datos que se sientan intuitivas y no reactivas es vital para descubrir nuevas oportunidades de crecimiento.

Ciberseguridad

Ciberseguridad

Elimina los riesgos del mañana potenciando la ciberseguridad hoy

Incorpora la ciberseguridad a tu estrategia y ecosistema para proteger el valor, ayudar a prevenir las amenazas y generar confianza a medida que creces.

Datos e inteligencia artificial

Datos e inteligencia artificial

Utiliza la IA con un propósito

La IA es más accesible que nunca y está transformando rápidamente las empresas y la forma en que vivimos y trabajamos. La forma en que apliques su potencial determinará el impacto y posicionará a tu empresa para competir y alcanzar nuevos niveles de rendimiento.

Ingeniería y fabricación digitales

Ingeniería y fabricación digitales

Digitaliza lo que haces y revoluciona tu forma de hacerlo

Reinventa los productos que fabricas y cómo los fabricas. Utiliza los datos, la tecnología digital y la IA para aumentar la resiliencia y la productividad, y mejorar la seguridad y la sostenibilidad en toda la cadena de valor.

Plataformas empresariales

Plataformas empresariales

Del cambio al valor más rápido

Adáptate a la velocidad con plataformas y aplicaciones integradas que aportan nuevas capacidades sectoriales y funcionales, aprovechan los datos y la IA, y empoderan a tu personal para ofrecer más valor.

Tecnología emergente

Tecnología emergente

Da forma al futuro

En un mundo que evoluciona rápidamente, adopta la tecnología emergente para transformar y lograr una mayor eficiencia, eficacia e innovación revolucionaria.

Finanzas y gestión de riesgos

Finanzas y gestión de riesgos

Invertir para crear resiliencia y reducir el riesgo empresarial

En medio de la intensificación de las perturbaciones del mercado y la escalada de la volatilidad empresarial, hay más presión sobre los directores de finanzas (CFO) y los directores de riesgos (CRO) para equilibrar múltiples transformaciones interconectadas y, al mismo tiempo, mantener el rendimiento, la rentabilidad y la seguridad de la empresa.

Proyectos de capital e infraestructura

Proyectos de capital e infraestructura

Planificar, administrar y ejecutar proyectos de capital de manera eficiente

Combina el ingenio humano con los datos y la IA para lograr proyectos a gran escala a tiempo y dentro del presupuesto, y, al mismo tiempo, lograr objetivos de inversión y sostenibilidad más generales.

Aprendizaje

Aprendizaje

Conviértete en un creador de talentos

Si bien la tecnología desempeña un papel clave en la reinvención de la empresa, es tu personal quien determina su éxito. ¿Cómo puedes desarrollar las habilidades que quieren y necesitan para crecer más rápido?

Servicios gestionados estratégicos

Servicios gestionados estratégicos

Cambia más, más rápido

A medida que las organizaciones se esfuerzan por optimizar los costos y acelerar el crecimiento, los servicios gestionados estratégicos pueden ayudar a prepararlas mejor para reinventar las operaciones e impulsar el valor integral a gran escala.

Marketing y experiencia

Marketing y experiencia

Marketing para un mundo multidimensional

Las opciones se multiplican. Las demandas de los consumidores evolucionan. Lo que está de moda hoy puede que no lo esté mañana. La relevancia es esencial para el crecimiento: crea experiencias de cliente que estén al día de los cambios.

Metaverso

Metaverso

Haz magia en el metaverso

Los mundos físico y virtual se están mezclando. El metaverso ofrece nuevas formas de conectar, crear y consumir. Es una nueva oportunidad para crear experiencias completamente inclusivas y responsables.

Ventas y comercio

Ventas y comercio

Comercio al ritmo de la vida

El comercio se ha fusionado con la cultura a medida que las preferencias cambian de un momento a otro. ¿El reto? Seguir el ritmo. Sigue siendo relevante adaptándote al ritmo y convirtiendo la complejidad en comodidad.

Estrategia

Estrategia

Liderazgo en la próxima década

Comprométete firmemente con la reinvención continua y únete al pequeño pero creciente número de empresas que alcanzan nuevos niveles de crecimiento rentable para sus negocios, a la vez que realizan mayores contribuciones a la humanidad.

Cadena de suministro

Cadena de suministro

Lidera el futuro con redes de cadena de suministro

Anticípate y responde a la demanda de los clientes. Las redes de cadena de suministro son resilientes por su diseño y capaces de soportar las interrupciones, lo que impulsa la eficiencia, la sostenibilidad y el crecimiento.

Sostenibilidad

Sostenibilidad

El imperativo de la sostenibilidad

La sostenibilidad abarca cuestiones medioambientales, sociales y de gobernanza. Hoy en día, todas las organizaciones deben adoptar la sostenibilidad para lograr una competitividad futura.

Talento y organización

Talento y organización

Impulsar el crecimiento a través de las personas y la tecnología

Las organizaciones prósperas están impulsando el cambio en la intersección de la tecnología y el talento. La potente combinación de datos e IA y experiencia humana real abre nuevas estructuras de trabajo, funciones y entornos que permiten que las personas y las empresas prosperen.

Transformación tecnológica

Transformación tecnológica

Transforma tu tecnología para entregar cambios más rápidamente

Reinventa tu núcleo digital con la estrategia, el talento y las prácticas modernas adecuadas para aumentar el retorno de la inversión, impulsar la eficiencia y redirigir el gasto a innovaciones que impulsen el crecimiento.

Más de 350 asociaciones para ayudar a acelerar el cambio

Ver todos los socios

INDUSTRIAS

Experiencia inigualable en la industria

Aeroespacial y defensa

Aeroespacial y defensa

Navega contra el viento

Desde la incertidumbre económica y las interrupciones de la cadena de suministro hasta las carencias de cualificación y las variables expectativas de los consumidores, la industria aeroespacial y de defensa enfrenta desafíos. Ha llegado el momento de adoptar una mentalidad que dé prioridad a lo digital.

Industria automotriz

Industria automotriz

Ve más allá del volante

La industria automotriz tradicional ha llegado a una encrucijada. Ahora estamos operando en un ecosistema de movilidad y avanzamos hacia la próxima iteración de la industria automotriz. Para avanzar, es hora de adoptar el ecosistema, colaborar más allá de las fronteras de la industria y encontrar nuevas formas de innovar y asociarse para lograr el éxito.

Banca

Banca

Crear la próxima generación de banca

La tecnología ha cambiado la forma en la que las personas y las empresas hacen transacciones financieras, y las estrategias tradicionales ya no son eficaces. Ahora es el momento de adoptar nuevos enfoques audaces para intensificar la disrupción.

Mercado de capitales

Mercado de capitales

Mercado de capitales: ve oportunidades en todas partes

Un número cada vez mayor de inversores minoristas. La transición a economías con bajas emisiones de carbono. Inversiones en infraestructuras en mercados en crecimiento. Para quienes se reinventan, el cambio constante es una oportunidad constante.

Productos químicos

Productos químicos

Adopta el cambio como una constante

Tradicionalmente, las empresas químicas se ven como una industria madura y estática, por lo que se enfrentan a una presión creciente para pasar de ser reactivas a ser proactivas y acelerar la innovación.

Comunicaciones y medios

Comunicaciones y medios

Sé un elemento esencial para los hiperconectados

Las personas y las empresas están siempre activas, ya sea viendo, trabajando o permitiendo un nuevo crecimiento innovador. Mantenlos comprometidos y con éxito ofreciéndoles las experiencias y capacidades continuas que esperan y necesitan.

Bienes de consumo y servicios

Bienes de consumo y servicios

Los humanos reinventan la industria de bienes de consumo y servicios

En la era del comercio digital, es difícil predecir qué comprarán los consumidores y por qué, cuándo y dónde lo comprarán. Para adelantarse a la incertidumbre, hay que pensar como consumidor y centrarse en establecer relaciones sólidas.

Energía

Energía

Utiliza la disrupción para impulsar el cambio

La demanda aumenta. La competencia es feroz. La gente espera sostenibilidad. Con las presiones inflacionistas, las interrupciones en la red de cadena de suministro y una mayor atención a la seguridad, las empresas energéticas necesitan cambiar hoy para competir mañana.

Salud

Salud

Humanizar la atención médica

La gente espera un acceso intuitivo a su atención médica y experiencias personalizadas. Los líderes que se reinventan para crear un acceso sencillo y experiencias atractivas seguirán siendo resilientes y, al mismo tiempo, ofrecerán mejores resultados.

Alta tecnología

Alta tecnología

Transforma la industria que transforma el mundo

La presión está en crear productos y servicios tecnológicos innovadores reinventar la cadena de suministro y las redes de fabricación e identificar nuevas fuentes de talento. Los que se reinventen serán los líderes.

Sector industrial

Sector industrial

Excelencia a gran velocidad en el sector industrial

Un sinfín de tendencias, desde los cambios tecnológicos hasta la evolución de las expectativas de los clientes B2B, pasando por el objetivo de los productos basados en software y la mejora de los servicios, entre otras, están impulsando a las empresas a reinventarse continuamente. Ha llegado el momento de redefinir los modelos de negocio industriales.

Seguros

Seguros

Cambia para resistir

El seguro es sinónimo de protección. A medida que las personas y las sociedades cambian continuamente, las aseguradoras deben digitalizar, conectar y personalizar para satisfacer las necesidades más complejas de los clientes de hoy en día.

Ciencias biológicas

Ciencias biológicas

Redefinición de lo posible en las ciencias biológicas

Para abordar las necesidades en constante cambio de los pacientes, el aumento de los costos, la demanda de nuevos tratamientos y la necesidad de acelerar la innovación en I+D, las organizaciones de ciencias biológicas deben adoptar un enfoque de transformación moderno.

Recursos naturales

Recursos naturales

Sé un administrador de los recursos naturales del mundo

A medida que el mundo avanza hacia la descarbonización, las empresas mineras, metalúrgicas, de productos forestales y de materiales de construcción se enfrentan a una presión cada vez mayor para pasar de ser productoras de recursos a administradoras de estos.

Servicio público

Servicio público

Crea un impacto significativo hoy y construye comunidades más fuertes para el futuro

Las organizaciones de servicio público que se enfrentan a recursos limitados, avances tecnológicos cada vez más rápidos y un estado de permacrisis pueden tener un impacto significativo en los resultados para las personas y comunidades enteras.

Capital privado

Capital privado

Reinventa las formas en las que crea valor

La próxima generación de líderes del capital privado utilizará un conjunto ampliado de impulsores del valor para alcanzar lo básico con rapidez, al tiempo que mitigará los riesgos y creará formas de crecer.

Comercio minorista

Comercio minorista

Reorganízate de forma responsable

Ahora es el momento de reorganizarse de forma responsable, lo que significa atender mejor las necesidades de los clientes, los empleados y las comunidades en las que viven y trabajan. El reto consiste en aprovechar las experiencias de venta directa tanto digitales como físicas para satisfacer las nuevas demandas, sin afectar a los resultados.

Software y plataformas

Software y plataformas

Un nuevo amanecer para la industria del software y las plataformas

El siguiente capítulo del hipercrecimiento está aquí. La ampliación de la tecnología, la batalla por la atención y los cambios macroeconómicos han llevado a un punto de inflexión en la industria, con nuevas oportunidades en el horizonte.

Viajes

Viajes

Descubre nuevos destinos

La industria de los viajes no es ajena a las interrupciones. Y en el mundo pospandemia, las empresas de viajes deben reinventarse continuamente para superar las circunstancias imprevistas, al tiempo que ofrecen experiencias coherentes y sublimes a los clientes.

Servicios públicos

Servicios públicos

Reinventamos radicalmente la energía para lograr cero emisiones netas

Las empresas de servicios públicos son la piedra angular de la transición hacia un mundo libre de emisiones de carbono. Alcanzar la ambición de cero emisiones requiere medidas radicales de reinvención que generen valor sostenible para todos.

Ver la reinvención en acción

Cada día ayudamos a nuestros clientes a reinventar sus negocios para alcanzar su máximo potencial. Usamos tecnología, datos, IA y nuevas formas de trabajar. Rompemos límites y damos forma al futuro de las industrias.

Ver historias de clientes

Somos una Industria Única

Toggle awards card detail view

Somos líderes en The Forrester Wave™: Workday Services, segundo trimestre de 2024

En el informe de 2024, Accenture recibió la puntuación más alta en la categoría de Ofertas actuales y entre las puntuaciones más altas en las categorías de Estrategia y Presencia en el mercado.

El estudio realizado por Forrester evaluó a 12 proveedores de servicios de Workday en 25 criterios, incluidos Workday Human Capital Management, Workday Financial Management, Workday exteNd y la plataforma en la nube, Workday Adaptive Planning y Workday Analytics and Reporting (Prism).

Conocé más

Toggle awards card detail view

Somos líderes en la evaluación PEAK Matrix: de servicios de marketing 2024 de Everest Group

Según el informe, “Accenture fusionó la mayoría de sus agencias de marketing para formar Accenture Song, uno de los mayores proveedores de servicios de marketing basados en tecnología del mundo”.

Para esta investigación, Everest Group evaluó a 34 proveedores de servicios de marketing. Accenture es el líder más alto en el eje de visión y capacidad y el líder más alto en el eje de impacto en el mercado.

Conocé más

Toggle awards card detail view

Somos líderes en la primera edición de IDC MarketScape: evaluación de proveedores mundiales de soluciones y servicios de consultoría tecnológica de laboratorio del futuro de I+D de ciencias biológicas 2024

En el informe, Accenture se posiciona como líder tanto en “estrategias” como en “capacidades”.

IDC MarketScape evaluó a 13 proveedores que prestan servicios para ayudar a implementar una estrategia de laboratorio del futuro (LotF) y transformar y modernizar los laboratorios en toda la cadena de valor, desde el diseño experimental hasta la fabricación

Awards

Reinvent what your business could be

Our wide range of capabilities, ecosystem partnerships and unmatched industry expertise can help your business become the next best version of itself.

Capabilities

The capabilities to help you reinvent

Cloud

Cloud

Take the world by cloud

Every day, cloud computing becomes more integral in driving reinvention, and meeting the ever-changing needs of people around the world.

Customer Service

Customer Service

Turn customer service and proactive support into a growth engine

Impersonal and inconsistent interactions are leaving organizations scrambling to understand how to better support customers. Delivering seamless, data-driven experiences that feel intuitive, not reactive, is vital to unlocking new opportunities for growth.

Cybersecurity

Cybersecurity

De-risk tomorrow by boosting cybersecurity today

Infuse cybersecurity into your strategy and ecosystem to protect value, help prevent threat and build trust as you grow.

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Use AI with purpose

AI is more accessible than ever, and it’s rapidly transforming enterprises and the ways we live and work. The way you apply its potential will determine the impact and position your business to compete and achieve new levels of performance.

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digitize what you make, revolutionize how you make it

Reimagine the products you make and how you make them. Use data, digital and AI to increase resiliency and productivity and improve security and sustainability across the value chain.

Ecosystem Partners

Ecosystem Partners

From change to value faster

Reinvention doesn’t happen in a silo. Fast-track your journey with integrated applications and platforms that bring the latest industry- and function-specific capabilities, plus advanced data and AI offerings, to empower your people and business.

Emerging Technology

Emerging Technology

Shape the future

In a rapidly changing world, embrace emerging technology to transform and achieve greater efficiency, effectiveness, and breakthrough innovation.

Finance and Risk Management

Finance and Risk Management

Investing to build resilience and reduce enterprise risk

Amid intensifying market disruptions and escalating business volatility, there’s more pressure on Chief Financial Officers (CFOs) and Chief Risk Officers (CROs) to balance multiple interconnected transformations while sustaining company performance, profitability and safety.

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Plan, manage and execute capital projects efficiently

Combine human ingenuity with data and AI to deliver large-scale projects on time and within budget, while also achieving broader investment and sustainability objectives.

Learning

Learning

Become a talent creator

While technology plays a key role in business reinvention, it’s your people who determine its success. How can you build the skills they want, and you need, to grow faster?

Managed Services

Managed Services

Change more, faster

As organizations strive to optimize cost and accelerate growth, strategic managed services can help to better prepare them to reinvent operations and drive holistic value at scale.

Marketing and Experience

Marketing and Experience

Marketing for a multidimensional world

Options multiply. Consumer demands evolve. What’s trending today may not be tomorrow. Relevance is essential for growth—create customer experiences that keep up with change.

Metaverse

Metaverse

Make magic in the metaverse

The physical and virtual worlds are blending. The metaverse offers new ways to connect, create and consume. And it’s a fresh chance to make totally inclusive, responsible experiences.

Sales and Commerce

Sales and Commerce

Commerce at the speed of life

Commerce has blended into culture as preferences shift moment to moment. The challenge? Keeping up. Stay relevant by matching the pace and turning complexity into convenience.

Strategy

Strategy

Leading in the next decade

Boldly commit to continuous reinvention and join the small but growing number of companies reaching new levels of profitable growth for their businesses, while also providing greater contributions to humanity.

Supply Chain

Supply Chain

Lead the future with supply chain networks

Anticipate and respond to customer demand. Resilient by design and able to withstand disruptions, supply chain networks drive efficiency, sustainability and growth.

Sustainability

Sustainability

The sustainability imperative

Sustainability spans environmental, social and governance issues. Today every organization must embrace sustainability for future competitiveness.

Talent and Organization

Talent and Organization

Driving growth through people and technology

Thriving organizations are driving change at the intersection of technology and talent. The powerful combination of data and AI and real human experience unlocks new work structures, roles and environments which enable people and businesses to thrive.

Technology Transformation

Technology Transformation

Transform your technology to deliver change faster

Reinvent your digital core with the right strategy, talent and modern practices to increase ROI, drive efficiency and redirect spend to innovations that drive growth.

~250 partnerships to help accelerate change

View all partners

Industries

Unmatched industry expertise

Aerospace and Defense

Aerospace and Defense

Navigate headwinds

From economic uncertainty and supply chain disruptions to skill gaps and shifting consumer expectations, the Aerospace and Defense industry is being challenged. The time is now to embrace a digital-first mindset.

Automotive

Automotive

Get beyond the wheel

The traditional automotive industry has reached a crossroads. We are now operating in a mobility ecosystem, shifting into the next iteration of automotive. To move forward, it’s time to embrace the ecosystem, collaborate beyond industry lines, and find new ways of innovating and partnering for success.

Banking

Banking

Building the next generation of banks

Technology has changed the way people and businesses bank, and traditional strategies no longer work. Now is the time for bold new approaches to intensifying disruption.

Capital Markets

Capital Markets

Capital Markets: See opportunity everywhere

A growing number of retail investors. The transition to low-carbon economies. Infrastructure investments in growing markets. For those who reinvent, constant change is constant opportunity.

Chemicals

Chemicals

Embrace change as a constant

Traditionally seen as a mature, static industry, chemical companies are facing building pressure to move from reactive to proactive and speed innovation.

Communications and Media

Communications and Media

Be hyper-essential for the hyper-connected

People and businesses are always on, whether watching, working, or enabling innovative new growth. Keep them engaged and successful by delivering the continuous experiences and capabilities they expect and need.

Consumer Goods and Services

Consumer Goods and Services

Humans are reinventing the Consumer Goods and Services industry

In the age of digital commerce, it is hard to predict what consumers will buy – and why, when and where they buy it. To stay ahead of uncertainty, think like a consumer and focus on building strong relationships.

Energy

Energy

Use disruption to fuel change

Demand is up. Competition is fierce. People expect sustainability. With inflationary pressures, supply chain network disruptions, and an increased focus on security, energy companies need to change today to compete tomorrow.

Health

Health

Humanizing healthcare

People expect intuitive access to their healthcare and personalized experiences. Leaders that reinvent to create easy access and engaging experiences will stay resilient while delivering better outcomes.

High Tech

High Tech

Transforming the industry that transforms the world

The pressure is on to build innovative tech products and services, reimagine supply chain and manufacturing networks and identify new talent sources. Those who reinvent will lead.

Industrial

Industrial

Excelling at speed in Industrial

A myriad of trends from technology shifts to evolving B2B customer expectations, software-driven product purpose, enhanced services and more are driving companies to embrace continuous reinvention. The time is now to redefine industrial business models.

Insurance

Insurance

Change for resilience

Insurance is protection. As people and societies continuously change, carriers must digitize, connect and personalize to meet today’s more complex customer needs.

Life Science

Life Science

Redefining the possible in Life Sciences

To address the changing needs of patients, rising costs, demands for new treatments, and the need for accelerated R&D innovation, life sciences organizations must adopt a modern transformation approach.

Natural Resources

Natural Resources

Be a steward of the world’s natural resources

As the world looks towards decarbonization, mining, metals, forest products and building materials companies face increasing pressure to shift from being resource producers to resource stewards.

Public Service

Public Service

Create meaningful impact today and build stronger communities for tomorrow

Facing limited resources, increasingly rapid technology advances and a state of perma-crisis, public service organizations who embrace continuous change can have meaningful impact on outcomes for individuals and entire communities.

Private Equity

Private Equity

Reinvent the ways you create value

The next generation of private equity leaders will use an expanded set of value levers to achieve better outcomes.

Retail

Retail

Reset responsibly

Now is the time to responsibly reset, which means better serving the needs of customers, employees and the communities where they live and work. The challenge is to leverage both digital and physical retail experiences to meet new demands—without compromising results.

Software and Platforms

Software and Platforms

A new dawn for the Software & Platforms Industry

The next chapter of hypergrowth is here. Expanded tech, the battle for attention, and macroeconomic shifts have all led to an industry inflection point, with new opportunities on the horizon.

Travel

Travel

Discover new destinations

The travel industry is no stranger to disruption. And in the post-pandemic world, travel companies must continuously reinvent to outwit unforeseen circumstances, while providing cohesive, elevated experiences for customers.

Utilities

Utilities

Radically reinventing power for net zero

Utilities are the cornerstone in the transition to a carbon-neutral world. Achieving net-zero ambitions requires radical moves toward reinvention that will generate sustainable value for all.

See reinvention in action

Every day, we help our clients reinvent their businesses to reach their full potential. Using technology, data, AI and new ways of working. We push boundaries and shape the future of industries.

View client stories

We are an Industry of One

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in The Forrester Wave™: Workday Services, Q2 2024

In the 2024 report, Accenture received the highest score in the Current Offering category, and among the highest scores in the Strategy and Market Presence categories.

The research conducted by Forrester evaluated 12 Workday services providers across 25 criteria, including Workday Human Capital Management, Workday Financial Management, Workday Extend and cloud platform, Workday Adaptive Planning, and Workday Analytics and Reporting (Prism).

Explore more

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in Everest Group’s PEAK Matrix: Marketing Services Assessment 2024

Per the report, “Accenture merged most of its marketing agencies to form Accenture Song, one of the largest technology-powered marketing service providers in the world.”

For this research, Everest Group assessed 34 marketing services providers. Accenture is the highest Leader on the Vision and Capability axis and the highest leader on the Market Impact axis.

Explore more

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in inaugural IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Life Sciences R&D Lab of the Future Technology Solutions and Consulting Services 2024 Vendor Assessment

In the report, Accenture is positioned as a Leader for both “Strategies” and “Capabilities”.

The IDC MarketScape evaluated 13 vendors who provide services to help implement a Lab of the Future (LotF) strategy and transform and modernize labs across the value chain, from experiment design to manufacturing.

Innovation at Accenture

Innovation at Accenture isn’t just about big ideas—it’s a mindset hardwired into everything we do. We harness cutting-edge technologies, evolving skills, and smarter processes to create real, lasting value where it matters most.

In a world where technology and economic shifts move faster than ever, our innovation is built for both the urgency of now and the opportunities of what’s next.

Across our global organization, we connect emerging tech, bold thinking, and new ways of working—enabling our clients to move at speed and to reinvent with confidence.

And at the heart of it all? Our people. Driven to challenge convention, we uncover both everyday efficiencies and major breakthroughs that deliver measurable impact for our clients—day after day.

Accenture's Innovation Lifecycle

Organizations that excel at innovation learn from their people and identify, harvest, amplify, industrialize, and distribute these innovations to scale their potential and value.

And that’s the way we’ve designed our innovation lifecycle. We call it, the 5 I’s of Innovation – Ignite, Incubate, Intensify, Industrialize, Immerse.

Play Video

Pause Video

Ignite with Think Tank

Accenture’s Think Tank translates emerging insights, ideas, and technologies into innovation focus areas. It investigates disruptions, bridges game-changing technologies with adaptation needs, and delivers actionable concepts grounded in business and client value.

Incubate with Labs

Our Labs test new concepts through applied R&D, piloting disruptive technologies in areas like cloud, quantum, robotics, and AI. This builds deep insight into what works and the risks—helping us move fast, stay agile, and invest in the extraordinary.

Intensify with Centers of Excellence

Accenture’s Centers of Excellence turn proven concepts into scalable capabilities, rapidly bringing innovations to market and driving growth. They develop talent, scale accelerators, and partner with start-ups, all while staying agile through continuous real-world feedback.

Industrialize with Service Delivery

Service Delivery integrates new capabilities into daily operations, capturing insights and improvements. Our teams rapidly scale proven solutions, amplifying innovation across service lines to equip everyone to deliver value when it matters most.

Immerse with Connected Innovation Centers

Our Connected Innovation Centers offer immersive experiences that showcase today’s innovations and what’s coming next. Fully connected and globally accessible, they provide the latest insights, solutions, and demos through collaborative spaces, classrooms, and ecosystem spotlights—all designed to bring the best of innovation into our clients' businesses.

Accenture Ventures

Our Venture Capital and Corporate Venture Capital network is vast and global

Accenture Ventures is at the forefront of shaping the future of technology, managing a $250M fund with 70+ active venture investments. Targeting 50,000 global startups, Accenture Ventures provides strategic market access to Fortune Global 500 clients. Our Corporate Venture Capital Advisory Practice and Project Spotlight empower innovative tech companies and our enterprise clients to scale and lead their industries through curated co-innovation and tailored strategies. Discover how our ecosystem of visionary founders, market intelligence, and enterprise expertise is redefining the tech landscape.

We forge coalitions, with deep roots across Europe and are uniquely positioned to drive reinvention. Put simply, we enable Europe’s companies on their path to becoming reinvention leaders.

Creating positive change

European Foundations, Accountable Governance

Close

We are deeply rooted in Europe, with strong local leadership and governance that ensure accountability and alignment with regulatory standards. As the largest provider of digital transformation services in the region, we offer the broadest set of capabilities and support leading enterprises as well as the European operations of global organizations.

We partner with governments across Europe to enhance citizen services, defense, border control, healthcare, justice, and policing.

We contribute to the resilience of European critical infrastructures through our cybersecurity practice, comprising more than 4,300 professionals.

We collaborate with Europe’s leading and emerging technology champions, accelerating the growth of major European-headquartered tech players (SAP, Siemens, Schneider Electric, Dassault Systems), LLM providers (iGenius, HCP, Aleph Alpha, Multiverse Compute), and sovereign technology providers (OVHcloud, S3NS, Schwartz Digits, StackIT, PSN, Aruba).

Our values are deeply aligned with European principles, guiding our commitment to responsible technology use, the highest ethical standards, and strict compliance with global and local laws.

We use data and technology responsibly, applying responsible tech and AI practices by design.

Compliance and Security Measures: We implement specific protocols and advanced security measures to meet and exceed European regulatory requirements.

We embed environmental sustainability into how we operate our business, holding ourselves accountable to measurable objectives.

We help clients achieve their ESG goals by embedding sustainability into their strategy, operations, and value chains.

Community Skilling: We are equipping around 790,000 people in Europe in FY 2024 with the skills to succeed. We also pledge to support the hiring and skilling of 16,000 refugee job seekers and work with NGOs and local partners to leverage technology to drive social impact.

Corporate Citizenship

Empowering the world, one community at a time

We invest in our communities to help them thrive, and we continue making substantial impacts in the places around the world where we work and live.

We do this through collaborating with our clients, ecosystem and nonprofit partners and also empowering our approximately 786,000 people to make a difference.

In contributing to progress against a broad spectrum of social and environmental challenges, we prioritize helping historically underserved people improve their livelihoods and empowering the next generation to build a sustainable future.

Skills to succeed

Decent work is key to sustainable development. We are committed to supporting and empowering people in communities around the world as they prepare for and navigate their career journeys. Our involvement ranges from funding NGO partner initiatives to pro-bono consulting, to our people volunteering as mentors.

In fiscal 2024, together with our partners, we reached approximately 5 million people globally, including more than 86,000 through our
Skills to Succeed Academy
.

UNICEF’s Generation Unlimited’s passport to earning

We partner with UNICEF’s Generation Unlimited and others to help young people in India, Brazil and other countries in the Global South gain future-relevant skills. Since its launch in December 2021, through July 2024, the program has skilled more than 2 million young learners in India alone.

Junior Achievement (JA) Worldwide

In fiscal 2024, we partnered with JA Worldwide to help more than 1.2 million young people across 19 countries gain the skills, experience, and confidence to prepare for future jobs or entrepreneurship opportunities. Building on our strong partnership with JA Worldwide, this year we collaborated alongside Microsoft and Avanade to bring AI and sustainability learning to young people around the world, and to leverage AI and data to drive efficiencies, scale and impact.

BecomingX Ukraine

Created in collaboration with BecomingX and others, the BecomingX Ukraine online learning platform provides career advice, digital skills and personal development courses to help Ukrainians realize their potential, gain meaningful employment and start their own businesses.

Sky's the Limit

This program connects aspiring entrepreneurs with volunteer mentors for one-on-one support. With 80% of Sky’s the Limit’s entrepreneurs identifying as people of color, and 90% reporting low income, the program aims to help create a more inclusive future of work. In fiscal 2023, we matched approximately 400 entrepreneurs with Accenture mentors.

Learn more

Nanays (mothers) in IT

A transformative program designed by Accenture in the Philippines, it offers mothers an opportunity cultivate skills for thriving careers in IT. Tailored to accommodate mothers' unique needs and schedules through online courses and mentorship opportunities, with a focus on bridging the gender gap in IT, the program not only equips women with technical expertise but also instills confidence for a rewarding career in tech.

Learn more

People and planet: Future sustainability leaders, today

To help inspire and empower young people to address pressing social and environmental challenges, we have scaled our action-oriented community impact program, Sustainability Education & Action, to equip them with the mindsets, skills, and tools to effectively contribute to a more sustainable future.

Sustainability innovation challenge for young innovators

Through our partnership with UNICEF Generation Unlimited's imaGen Ventures, we engage young people in addressing social and environmental challenges. In fiscal 2024, we supported approximately 20,000 innovators from diverse and historically underrepresented backgrounds around the globe through a sustainability innovation challenge. The 10 winning teams received grants to accelerate their impact, along with mentorship from Accenture people offering expertise in areas such as AI and the circular economy.

Learn more

Sustainability hour

In collaboration with World’s Largest Lesson (an initiative of Project Everyone), we developed Sustainability Hour. Available in more than 30 languages, this volunteering offering enables our people—and employees of other organizations—to host interactive hour-long sessions that inspire children to become change-makers for the Global Goals (UN SDGs).

Learn more

Accenture and World Scouting partnership

Accenture and World Scouting are partnering to enhance educational opportunities for Scouts globally, equipping them with the leadership, sustainability, and digital skills needed to succeed in today’s fast-paced world and build a more sustainable future. Accenture is supporting the rollout of the new Impact Innovator Challenge badge, equipping young people with innovation and creative problem-solving skills for life.

Learn more

World Economic Forum – Global Shapers

As a founding member of the World Economic Forum's Global Shapers Innovation Prize, we helped launch this initiative, alongside the Global Alliance for YOUth, to support young leaders under 30 in creating innovative projects that help address the needs of their communities. The 15 winning projects were recognized at the Global Shapers Summit and received funding and mentorship to deliver the next stage of impact to their communities.

Learn more

People with purpose

More than approximately 786,000 people work at Accenture, operating in more than 200 cities and 52 countries. Around the world, we’re working together to drive positive change at meaningful scale through volunteering, eco action, social innovation and giving, supporting both social and environmental causes.

Our annual Season of Impact brings our people together in scaling our collective efforts for people and planet, with more than 81,000 people participating in fiscal 2024.

Giving time to society and our planet

We are committed to addressing local needs and fostering sustainable communities, offering a variety of ways for our people to volunteer for social and environmental causes.
