Bezpieczeństwo

Partnerzy

Branże

Nagrody

Studia przypadków

Razem możemy odmienić Twój biznes

Nasz szeroki wachlarz kompetencji, partnerstwo w ramach ekosystemu i niezrównana wiedza branżowa mogą pomóc Twojej firmie stać się kolejną najlepszą wersją samej siebie.

MOŻLIWOŚCI

Kompetencje, które pomogą Ci się zmienić

Chmura

Close

Chmura

Podbij świat przez chmurę

Każdego dnia chmura obliczeniowa staje się coraz bardziej integralną częścią stymulowania innowacji i zaspokajania stale zmieniających się potrzeb ludzi na całym świecie.

Dowiedz się więcej

Customer Service

Close

Customer Service

Rozwiń firmę dzięki lepszej obsłudze klienta

Coraz więcej klientów spotyka się z bezosobową i niespójną obsługą, co skłania firmy do szukania lepszych sposobów wsparcia. Kluczem do rozwoju jest tworzenie prostych, spójnych i przewidujących potrzeby klientów doświadczeń – zamiast jedynie reagować na problemy. Wykorzystując dane i nowoczesne narzędzia, obsługa klienta może stać się realną siłą napędową wzrostu.

Dowiedz się więcej

Cyberbezpieczeństwo

Close

Cyberbezpieczeństwo

Zmniejsz ryzyko jutra, zwiększając cyberbezpieczeństwo już dziś

Włącz cyberbezpieczeństwo do swojej strategii i ekosystemu, aby chronić wartość, zapobiegać zagrożeniom i budować zaufanie w miarę rozwoju.

Dowiedz się więcej

Sztuczna inteligenja

Close

Sztuczna inteligenja

Wykorzystaj sztuczną inteligencję do realizacji celów

Sztuczna inteligencja jest bardziej dostępna niż kiedykolwiek i szybko przekształca przedsiębiorstwa oraz sposób, w jaki żyjemy i pracujemy. Sposób, w jaki wykorzystasz jej potencjał, określi wpływ i przygotuje Twoją firmę do konkurowania i osiągania nowych poziomów wydajności.

Dowiedz się więcej

Inżynieria cyfrowa i produkcja

Close

Inżynieria cyfrowa i produkcja

Digitalizuj to, co produkujesz, zrewolucjonizuj to, jak to robisz

Przekształć produkty i sposób ich wytwarzania Korzystaj z danych, technologii cyfrowych i AI, aby zwiększyć odporność i produktywność oraz poprawić bezpieczeństwo i zrównoważony rozwój w całym łańcuchu wartości.

Dowiedz się więcej

Platformy dla przedsiębiorstw

Close

Platformy dla przedsiębiorstw

Szybciej od zmiany do wartości

Szybko dostosowuj się dzięki zintegrowanym platformom i aplikacjom, które zapewniają nowe możliwości branżowe i funkcjonalne, wykorzystują dane i sztuczną inteligencję oraz umożliwiają pracownikom dostarczanie większej wartości.

Dowiedz się więcej

Nowe technologie

Close

Nowe technologie

Kształtuj przyszłość

W szybko zmieniającym się świecie, wykorzystaj nowe technologie do transformacji i osiągnięcia większej wydajności, efektywności i przełomowych innowacji.

Dowiedz się więcej

Finanse i zarządzanie ryzykiem

Close

Finanse i zarządzanie ryzykiem

Inwestowanie w budowanie odporności i zmniejszanie ryzyka przedsiębiorstwa

W obliczu nasilających się zakłóceń rynkowych i rosnącej zmienności biznesowej, dyrektorzy finansowi (CFO) i dyrektorzy ds. ryzyka (CRO) znajdują się pod większą presją, aby zrównoważyć wiele wzajemnie powiązanych transformacji przy jednoczesnym utrzymaniu wydajności, rentowności i bezpieczeństwa firmy.

Dowiedz się więcej

Infrastruktura i projekty kapitałowe

Close

Infrastruktura i projekty kapitałowe

Projekty kapitałowe: efektywne planowanie, zarządzanie i realizacja

Połączenie ludzkiej pomysłowości z danymi i AI pozwala skutecznie realizować projekty na dużą skalę – terminowo, efektywnie kosztowo i w zgodzie z celami inwestycyjnymi i zrównoważonego rozwoju.

Dowiedz się więcej

Usługi edukacyjne

Close

Usługi edukacyjne

Zostań twórcą talentów

Podczas gdy technologia odgrywa kluczową rolę w rewolucji biznesowej, to ludzie decydują o jej sukcesie. Jak zbudować umiejętności pożądane przez pracowników i potrzebne firmie do szybszego rozwoju?

Dowiedz się więcej

Usługi zarządzane

Close

Usługi zarządzane

Zmień więcej, szybciej

Ponieważ organizacje dążą do optymalizacji kosztów i przyspieszenia wzrostu, strategiczne usługi zarządzane mogą pomóc w lepszym przygotowaniu ich do ponownego opracowania operacji i generowania holistycznej wartości na dużą skalę.

Dowiedz się więcej

Marketing i doświadczenie

Close

Marketing i doświadczenie

Marketing dla wielowymiarowego świata

Opcje się mnożą. Wymagania konsumentów ewoluują. To, co dziś jest popularne, jutro może już nie być. Adekwatność ma kluczowe znaczenie dla rozwoju — twórz obsługę klienta, która nadąża za zmianami.

Dowiedz się więcej

Metaversum

Close

Metaversum

Magia w metaversum

Świat fizyczny i wirtualny przenikają się. Metaversum oferuje nowe sposoby łączenia się, tworzenia i konsumpcji. Jest to nowa szansa na wytworzenie całkowicie integracyjnych, odpowiedzialnych doświadczeń.

Dowiedz się więcej

Sprzedaż i handel

Close

Sprzedaż i handel

Handel w tempie życia

Handel wtopił się w kulturę, ponieważ preferencje zmieniają się z dnia na dzień. Wyzwanie? Nadążyć. Pozostań na bieżąco, dostosowując tempo i zamieniając złożoność w wygodę.

Dowiedz się więcej

Strategia

Close

Strategia

Wiodąca pozycja w następnej dekadzie

Odważnie zaangażuj się w ciągłą rewolucję i dołącz do niewielkiej, ale rosnącej liczby firm osiągających nowe poziomy rentownego wzrostu dla swoich firm, jednocześnie zapewniając większe korzyści dla ludzkości.

Dowiedz się więcej

Zarządzanie łańcuchem dostaw

Close

Zarządzanie łańcuchem dostaw

Prowadź ku przyszłości z sieciami łańcucha dostaw

Przewiduj i reaguj na potrzeby klientów. Odporne na zakłócenia sieci łańcucha dostaw stymulują wydajność, zrównoważony rozwój i wzrost.

Dowiedz się więcej

Zrównoważony rozwój

Close

Zrównoważony rozwój

Imperatyw zrównoważonego rozwoju

Zrównoważony rozwój obejmuje kwestie środowiskowe, społeczne i związane z zarządzaniem. Dziś każda organizacja musi przyjąć zrównoważony rozwój, aby zapewnić sobie konkurencyjność w przyszłości.

Dowiedz się więcej

Zarządzanie zmianą

Close

Zarządzanie zmianą

Rozwój dzięki pracownikom i technologii

Dobrze prosperujące organizacje wprowadzają zmiany na styku technologii i talentów. Potężne połączenie danych i sztucznej inteligencji oraz prawdziwego ludzkiego doświadczenia odblokowuje nowe struktury pracy, role i środowiska, które umożliwiają ludziom i firmom rozwój.

Dowiedz się więcej

Transformacja technologiczna

Close

Transformacja technologiczna

Przekształć swoją technologię, aby szybciej wprowadzać zmiany

Przekształć swój cyfrowy rdzeń dzięki odpowiedniej strategii, talentom i nowoczesnym praktykom, aby zwiększyć zwrot z inwestycji i wydajność oraz przekierować wydatki na innowacje, które stymulują wzrost.

Dowiedz się więcej

Ponad 350 partnerów, którzy pomagają przyspieszyć zmiany

BRANŻE

Niezrównana wiedza branżowa

Przemysł lotniczy i obronny (defense)

Close

Przemysł lotniczy i obronny (defense)

Radź sobie wśród niesprzyjających wiatrów

Od niepewności gospodarczej i zakłóceń w łańcuchu dostaw po braki w umiejętnościach i zmieniające się oczekiwania konsumentów, przemysł lotniczy i obronny stoi przed wieloma wyzwaniami. Nadszedł czas, aby przyjąć cyfrowy sposób myślenia.

Dowiedz się więcej

Motoryzacja

Close

Motoryzacja

Wyjrzyj za horyzont

Tradycyjny przemysł motoryzacyjny znalazł się na rozdrożu. Działamy teraz w ekosystemie mobilności, przechodząc do następnej iteracji motoryzacji. Aby iść naprzód, nadszedł czas, aby zaakceptować ekosystem, współpracować poza granicami branży i znaleźć nowe sposoby innowacji i partnerstwa na rzecz sukcesu.

Dowiedz się więcej

Bankowość

Close

Bankowość

Tworzenie banków nowej generacji

Technologia zmieniła sposób korzystania z bankowości przez ludzi i firmy, a tradycyjne strategie już nie działają. Czas na nowe, odważne podejście do nasilających się zakłóceń.

Dowiedz się więcej

Rynki kapitałowe

Close

Rynki kapitałowe

Rynki kapitałowe: Dostrzegaj możliwości wszędzie

Rosnąca liczba inwestorów detalicznych. Przejście na gospodarkę niskoemisyjną. Inwestycje infrastrukturalne na rozwijających się rynkach. Dla tych, którzy odkrywają na nowo, ciągła zmiana to nieustanna szansa.

Dowiedz się więcej

Branża chemiczna

Close

Branża chemiczna

Przyjmij zmianę jako stałą

Firmy chemiczne, tradycyjnie postrzegane jako dojrzała, statyczna branża, stoją w obliczu rosnącej presji, aby przejść od reaktywności do proaktywności i przyspieszyć innowacje.

Dowiedz się więcej

Komunikacja i media

Close

Komunikacja i media

Bądź hiper-istotny dla hiper-połączonych

Ludzie i firmy są zawsze aktywni, niezależnie od tego, czy obserwują, pracują, czy umożliwiają innowacyjny rozwój. Zadbaj o ich zaangażowanie i sukces, dostarczając im ciągłych doświadczeń i możliwości, których oczekują i potrzebują.

Dowiedz się więcej

Towary i usługi konsumpcyjne

Close

Towary i usługi konsumpcyjne

Ludzie przekształcają branżę towarów i usług konsumenckich

W erze handlu cyfrowego trudno jest przewidzieć, co kupią konsumenci oraz dlaczego, kiedy i gdzie to kupią. Aby wyprzedzić niepewność, myśl jak konsument i skup się na budowaniu silnych relacji.

Dowiedz się więcej

Energetyka

Close

Energetyka

Wykorzystaj zakłócenia do stymulowania zmian

Popyt rośnie. Konkurencja jest zacięta. Ludzie oczekują zrównoważonego rozwoju. W obliczu presji inflacyjnej, zakłóceń w sieci łańcucha dostaw i zwiększonego nacisku na bezpieczeństwo, firmy energetyczne muszą zmienić się dziś, aby sprostać konkurencji jutro.

Dowiedz się więcej

Zdrowie publiczne

Close

Zdrowie publiczne

Humanizacja opieki zdrowotnej

Ludzie oczekują intuicyjnego dostępu do opieki zdrowotnej i spersonalizowanych doświadczeń. Liderzy, którzy przekształcają się, aby zapewnić łatwy dostęp i angażujące doświadczenia, pozostaną odporni, zapewniając lepsze wyniki.

Dowiedz się więcej

Zaawansowane technologie

Close

Zaawansowane technologie

Przekształcanie branży, która przekształca świat

Nacisk kładzie się na innowacyjne produkty i usługi technologiczne, przekształcanie łańcucha dostaw i sieci produkcyjnych oraz nowe źródła talentów. Nowe rozwiązania definiują liderów.

Dowiedz się więcej

Przemysł

Close

Przemysł

Doskonała prędkość w przemyśle

Niezliczone trendy, od zmian technologicznych po ewoluujące oczekiwania klientów B2B, cel produktu oparty na oprogramowaniu, ulepszone usługi i wiele innych, skłaniają firmy do ciągłej rewolucji. Nadszedł czas, aby na nowo zdefiniować przemysłowe modele biznesowe.

Dowiedz się więcej

Ubezpieczenia

Close

Ubezpieczenia

Zmiana na rzecz odporności

Ubezpieczenie to ochrona. Ludzie i społeczeństwa stale się zmieniają, a operatorzy muszą digitalizować, łączyć się i personalizować, aby sprostać potrzebom klientów.

Dowiedz się więcej

Nauki przyrodnicze

Close

Nauki przyrodnicze

Redefiniowanie możliwości w naukach przyrodniczych

Aby sprostać zmieniającym się potrzebom pacjentów, rosnącym kosztom, zapotrzebowaniu na nowe metody leczenia i potrzebie przyspieszenia innowacji w zakresie badań i rozwoju, organizacje zajmujące się naukami przyrodniczymi muszą przyjąć nowoczesne podejście do transformacji.

Dowiedz się więcej

Surowce naturalne

Close

Surowce naturalne

Bądź opiekunem naturalnych zasobów świata

W miarę jak świat zmierza w kierunku dekarbonizacji, firmy z branży wydobywczej, metalurgicznej, produktów leśnych i materiałów budowlanych stają w obliczu rosnącej presji, aby przejść od bycia producentem zasobów, do opiekunów zasobów.

Dowiedz się więcej

Służba publiczna

Close

Służba publiczna

Twórz znaczący wpływ już dziś i buduj silniejsze społeczności przyszłości

W obliczu ograniczonych zasobów, coraz szybszego postępu technologicznego i stanu permakryzysu, organizacje świadczące usługi publiczne, które podejmują ciągłe zmiany, mogą mieć wpływ na wyniki dla jednostek i całych społeczności.

Dowiedz się więcej

Kapitał prywatny

Close

Kapitał prywatny

Przekształć sposoby tworzenia wartości

Następna generacja liderów kapitału prywatnego wykorzysta rozszerzony zestaw dźwigni wartości, aby szybko osiągnąć podstawy, jednocześnie ograniczając ryzyko i tworząc sposoby na rozwój.

Dowiedz się więcej

Handel detaliczny

Close

Handel detaliczny

Odpowiedzialny reset

Nadszedł czas na odpowiedzialny reset, co oznacza lepsze zaspokajanie potrzeb klientów, pracowników i społeczności, w których żyją i pracują. Wyzwaniem jest wykorzystanie zarówno cyfrowych, jak i fizycznych doświadczeń detalicznych, aby sprostać nowym wymaganiom bez uszczerbku dla wyników.

Dowiedz się więcej

Oprogramowanie i platformy

Close

Oprogramowanie i platformy

Nowy początek dla branży oprogramowania i platform

Nadszedł kolejny rozdział hiper-wzrostu. Rozszerzona technologia, walka o uwagę i zmiany makroekonomiczne doprowadziły do punktu zwrotnego w branży, z nowymi możliwościami na horyzoncie.

Dowiedz się więcej

Turystyka

Close

Turystyka

Odkryj nowe cele podróży

W branży turystycznej nie brakuje perturbacji. Po pandemii biura podróży wciąż szukają rozwiązań, aby pokonać przeszkody, zapewniając klientom jednolitą, lepszą obsługę.

Dowiedz się więcej

Usługi komunalne

Close

Usługi komunalne

Radykalna transformacja energetyki w celu osiągnięcia zera netto

Przedsiębiorstwa użyteczności publicznej są niezbędne w przejściu na zerową emisję CO2. Wymaga to radykalnych kroków, które pozwolą wygenerować zrównoważoną wartość dla wszystkich.

Dowiedz się więcej

W raporcie z 2024 r. Accenture uzyskało najwyższy wynik w kategorii „Aktualna oferta” oraz jeden z najwyższych wyników w kategoriach „Strategia” i „Obecność na rynku”.

W badaniu przeprowadzonym przez Forrester oceniono 12 dostawców usług Workday w oparciu o 25 kryteriów, w tym zarządzanie kapitałem ludzkim Workday, zarządzanie finansami Workday, Workday Extend i platformę chmurową, planowanie adaptacyjne Workday oraz analitykę i raportowanie Workday (Prism).

Toggle awards card detail view

Jesteśmy liderem w rankingu PEAK Matrix firmy Everest Group: Marketing Services Assessment 2024

Jak czytamy w raporcie, „Firma Accenture połączyła większość swoich agencji marketingowych, tworząc Accenture Song, jednego z największych na świecie dostawców usług marketingowych opartych na technologii”.

Na potrzeby tego badania Everest Group oceniła 34 dostawców usług marketingowych. Accenture jest najwyższym Liderem na osi Wizja i Zdolności oraz najwyższym Liderem na osi Wpływ na Rynek.

Toggle awards card detail view

Jesteśmy liderem w inauguracyjnym badaniu IDC MarketScape: Ocena dostawców Worldwide Life Sciences R&D Lab of the Future Technology Solutions and Consulting Services 2024

W raporcie Accenture zajmuje pozycję lidera zarówno pod względem „Strategii”, jak i „Zdolności”.

IDC MarketScape oceniło 13 dostawców, którzy świadczą usługi pomagające wdrożyć strategię Lab of the Future (LotF) oraz przekształcić i zmodernizować laboratoria w całym łańcuchu wartości, od projektowania eksperymentów po produkcję

Wewnątrz pionierskiej, obejmującej całe przedsiębiorstwo transformacji, która pomogła bankowi stać się jednym z najbardziej innowacyjnych i wydajnych na świecie.

BMW oddaje kierownicę w ręce generatywnej AI

BMW i Accenture wspólnie opracowały platformę generatywnej sztucznej inteligencji, która przekształca dane w skali przedsiębiorstwa w spostrzeżenia w czasie rzeczywistym.

Modernizacja HR w skali globalnej

Marriott i Accenture wspólnie rozpoczynają transformację HR, aby zmienić doświadczenia pracowników.

Airbus: Stratuje produkcja oparta na sztucznej inteligencji

Zautomatyzowana inspekcja wznosi się na nowe wyżyny w chińskim centrum innowacji firmy Airbus. Przekształcając procesy operacyjne i kontrolne za pomocą sztucznej inteligencji i wizji komputerowej, firma przekształca sposób montażu samolotów.

Aby usprawnić globalne operacje, firma Microsoft uruchomiła wieżę kontroli łańcucha dostaw Cloud Control, która działa jako pojedyncze źródło informacji dla ponad 500 decydentów w całej organizacji rozsianej po całym świecie.

Dzięki wirtualnemu wszechświatowi, który łączy internetową krainę kreatywności z fizycznymi nieruchomościami, deweloper nieruchomości MQDC łączy świat rzeczywisty i cyfrowy i nagradza pozytywne działania za rzeczywisty wpływ.

Capacidades

Parceiros

Indústrias

Prémios

Casos de estudo

Juntos, podemos reinventar o seu negócio

A nossa vasta gama de capacidades, parcerias de ecossistema e incomparáveis conhecimentos da indústria podem ajudar a sua organização a tornar-se a melhor versão de si mesma.

CAPACIDADES

As capacidades para ajudar a reinventar

Cloud

Cloud

No topo da cloud

A cada dia que passa, a cloud computing torna-se cada vez mais fundamental para o estímulo da reinvenção e a satisfação das necessidades em constante mudança de pessoas em todo o mundo.

Customer Service

Customer Service

Transforme o serviço ao cliente e o apoio proativo em motores de crescimento

Interações impessoais e inconsistentes estão a levar muitas organizações a repensar a forma como apoiam os seus clientes. Para gerar novas oportunidades de crescimento, é essencial oferecer experiências contínuas, personalizadas e orientadas por dados, que sejam percecionadas como intuitivas, e não apenas reativas.

Cibersegurança

Cibersegurança

Reduza os riscos amanhã impulsionando a cibersegurança hoje

Introduza a cibersegurança na sua estratégia e ecossistema para proteger o valor, ajudar a prevenir ameaças e desenvolver confiança ao ritmo do seu crescimento.

Dados e Inteligência Artificial

Dados e Inteligência Artificial

Utilize a IA com propósito

A IA é mais acessível do que nunca e está a transformar rapidamente as empresas e as formas como vivemos e trabalhamos. A forma como aplica o seu potencial irá determinar o impacto e posicionar o seu negócio para competir e atingir novos níveis de desempenho.

Serviços de Engenharia e Manufatura Digitais

Serviços de Engenharia e Manufatura Digitais

Digitalize o que faz, revolucione a forma como o faz

Reinvente os produtos que faz e como os faz. Utilize dados, recursos digitais e a IA para aumentar a resiliência e a produtividade e melhorar a segurança e a sustentabilidade em toda a cadeia de valor.

Plataformas empresariais

Plataformas empresariais

Da mudança ao valor, mais depressa

Adapte-se rapidamente com plataformas e aplicações integradas que trazem novos recursos industriais e funcionais, tiram partido dos dados e da IA e capacitam os seus colaboradores para oferecer mais valor.

Tecnologias emergentes

Tecnologias emergentes

Defina o futuro

Num mundo em rápida mudança, adote a tecnologia emergente para transformar e alcançar uma maior eficiência, eficácia e inovação revolucionária.

Gestão Financeira e do Risco

Gestão Financeira e do Risco

Investir para criar resiliência e reduzir o risco empresarial

Com a intensificação das disrupções do mercado e o aumento da volatilidade dos negócios, há mais pressão sobre os CFO e CRO para equilibrarem diversas transformações interligadas, mantendo o desempenho, a rentabilidade e a segurança da organização.

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Planeie, dirija e execute projetos de capital com eficiência

Alie a criatividade humana aos dados e à IA para apresentar projetos de grande escala dentro do tempo e orçamento e atinja objetivos de investimento e sustentabilidade mais amplos.

Aprendizagem

Aprendizagem

Torne-se um criador de talentos

Embora a tecnologia desempenhe um papel fundamental na reinvenção empresarial, é a sua equipa que determina o sucesso. Como pode desenvolver as competências que eles querem, e de que precisa, para crescer mais depressa?

Serviços Geridos Estratégicos

Serviços Geridos Estratégicos

Mudar mais, mais depressa

Com as organizações a esforçarem-se para otimizar os custos e acelerar o crescimento, os serviços geridos estratégicos podem ajudar a prepará-las melhor para reinventarem operações e gerarem valor holístico à escala.

Marketing e Experiência

Marketing e Experiência

Marketing para um mundo multidimensional

As opções multiplicam-se. As exigências dos consumidores evoluem. O que é uma tendência hoje pode não o ser amanhã. A relevância é essencial para o crescimento: crie experiências para os clientes que acompanham as mudanças.

Metaverso

Metaverso

Faça magia no metaverso

Options multiply. Consumer demands evolve. What’s trending today may not be tomorrow. Relevance is essential for growth—create customer experiences that keep up with change.

Vendas e Comércio

Vendas e Comércio

Comércio à velocidade da vida

O comércio fundiu-se na cultura, com a mudança constante das preferências. O desafio? Acompanhar o ritmo. Mantenha a relevância e transforme a complexidade em conveniência.

Strategy

Strategy

Liderar na próxima década

Empenhe-se na reinvenção contínua e junte-se ao pequeno mas crescente número de organizações que atingem novos níveis de crescimento rentável para os seus negócios e contribuem mais para a humanidade.

Cadeia de Abastecimento

Cadeia de Abastecimento

Lidere o futuro com as redes da cadeia de abastecimento

Antecipe e responda à procura dos clientes. Resilientes desde a conceção e capazes de suportar as perturbações, as redes da cadeia de abastecimento impulsionam a eficiência, a sustentabilidade e o crescimento.

Sustentabilidade

Sustentabilidade

O imperativo da sustentabilidade

A sustentabilidade abrange questões ambientais, sociais e de governança. Atualmente, todas as organizações devem abraçar a sustentabilidade a pensar na competitividade no futuro.

Talento e Organização

Talento e Organização

Impulsionar o crescimento através das pessoas e da tecnologia

As organizações prósperas impulsionam a mudança no cruzamento de tecnologia e talentos. A poderosa combinação de dados e IA e a experiência humana real possibilitam novas estruturas de trabalho, funções e ambientes que permitem a prosperidade de pessoas e organizações.

Transformação Tecnológica

Transformação Tecnológica

Transforme a tecnologia para concretizar mudanças mais rápidas

Reinvente o seu digital core com a estratégia, talento e práticas modernas adequados para aumentar o ROI, impulsionar a eficiência e redirecionar os gastos para inovações que impulsionam o crescimento.

Mais de 350 parcerias para ajudar a acelerar a mudança

Ver todos os parceiros

INDÚSTRIAS

Experiência industrial inigualável

Aeroespacial e Defesa

Aeroespacial e Defesa

Supere as dificuldades

Desde a incerteza económica e as disrupções na cadeia de abastecimento às lacunas de competências e à mudança nas expetativas dos consumidores, a indústria Aeroespacial e da Defesa enfrenta os mais diversos desafios. Está na altura de adotar uma mentalidade que dá prioridade ao digital.

Automóvel

Automóvel

Vá mais longe

A indústria automóvel tradicional chegou a uma encruzilhada. Vivemos num ecossistema de mobilidade que está a mudar para a próxima encarnação da indústria automóvel. Para avançar, é necessário aceitar o ecossistema, colaborar para além das linhas da indústria e encontrar novas formas de inovar e estabelecer parcerias para o sucesso.

Banca

Banca

Construir a próxima geração de bancos

A tecnologia mudou a relação das pessoas e organizações com os bancos. As estratégias tradicionais já não funcionam. São precisas novas abordagens a perturbações cada vez mais intensas.

Mercados de Capitais

Mercados de Capitais

Mercados de Capitais: oportunidades em todo o lado

Um número crescente de investidores não profissionais. A transição para economias de baixo carbono. Investimentos em infraestruturas em mercados em crescimento. Para aqueles que reinventam, a mudança constante é uma oportunidade constante.

Química

Química

Aceite a mudança como uma constante

Tradicionalmente vistas como uma indústria estática e profundamente desenvolvida, as organizações químicas enfrentam pressões cada vez maiores no sentido de passarem da inovação reativa para a inovação proativa e acelerada.

Comunicações e Media

Comunicações e Media

Mostre-se essencial para quem está sempre ligado

As pessoas e as organizações estão sempre ligadas, quer estejam a ver, a trabalhar ou a possibilitar um novo crescimento inovador. Mantenha-as interessadas e bem-sucedidas proporcionando as experiências e capacidades contínuas que esperam e de que precisam.

Bens de Consumo e Serviços

Bens de Consumo e Serviços

As pessoas estão a reinventar o setor de bens e serviços de consumo

Na era do comércio digital, é difícil prever o que os consumidores vão comprar, e porquê, quando e onde vão comprar. Para se manter à frente da incerteza, pense como um consumidor e concentre-se em estabelecer relações fortes.

Energia

Energia

Tire partido das perturbações para fomentar a mudança

A procura está em alta. A competição é feroz. As pessoas esperam sustentabilidade. Com pressões inflacionistas, perturbações na rede da cadeia de abastecimento e um maior foco na segurança, as organizações energéticas precisam de mudar hoje para competir amanhã.

Saúde

Saúde

Humanizar healthcare

As pessoas esperam um acesso intuitivo aos cuidados de saúde e experiências personalizadas. Os líderes que reinventam para criar acesso fácil e experiências envolventes irão manter-se resilientes e apresentar melhores resultados.

Alta Tecnologia

Alta Tecnologia

Transformar a indústria que transforma o mundo

Exige-se a criação de produtos e serviços inovadores o reimaginar das redes de abastecimento e de fabrico e a identificação de novas fontes de talentos. Quem reinventar irá liderar.

Industrial

Industrial

Excelência a alta velocidade na indústria

Uma miríade de tendências (de mudanças tecnológicas a expetativas de clientes B2B em evolução, finalidade de produtos orientada por software, serviços melhorados e muito mais) está a levar as empresas a adotar a reinvenção contínua. Está na altura de redefinir os modelos do negócio industrial.

Seguros

Seguros

mudar a pensar na resiliência

Os seguros são proteção. Com as pessoas e as sociedades a mudarem continuamente, as seguradoras têm de digitalizar, ligar e personalizar para satisfazer necessidades mais complexas.

Ciências da Vida

Ciências da Vida

Redefinir o possível nas Life Sciences

Para satisfazer as necessidades em mudança dos pacientes, o aumento dos custos, a procura por novos tratamentos e a necessidade de inovação acelerada em I&D, as organizações de Life Sciences devem adotar uma abordagem moderna à transformação.

Recursos Naturais

Recursos Naturais

Proteja os recursos naturais do mundo

Com o mundo a transitar para a descarbonização, as organizações mineiras, de metais, de silvicultura e de materiais de construção deparam-se com uma pressão crescente para passar de produtores de recursos a administradores de recursos.

Administração Pública

Administração Pública

Crie um impacto significativo hoje e desenvolva comunidades mais fortes para o futuro

Com recursos limitados, avanços tecnológicos rápidos e um estado de crise permanente, as organizações de serviço público que adotam a mudança contínua podem ter um impacto significativo nos resultados para pessoas e comunidades.

Capital Privado

Capital Privado

Reinvente as formas de criar valor

A próxima geração de líderes de capital privado irá usar um conjunto alargado de alavancas de valor para alcançar rapidamente os elementos básicos, mitigando ainda os riscos e criando formas de crescimento.

Retalho

Retalho

Repense com responsabilidade

Está na altura de repensar o retalho de forma responsável, isto é, satisfazer melhor as necessidades dos clientes, dos colaboradores e das comunidades onde vivem e trabalham. O desafio está em tirar partido das experiências de comércio digital e físico para satisfazer novas exigências, sem comprometer os resultados.

Software e Plataformas

Software e Plataformas

Uma nova era para a indústria do software e platforms

O próximo capítulo de hipercrescimento já começou. A tecnologia expandida, a batalha pela atenção e as mudanças macroeconómicas conduziram a uma fase de mudança da indústria, com novas oportunidades no horizonte.

Turismo

Turismo

Descubra novos destinos

A indústria do turismo não é alheia a perturbações. No pós-pandemia, as agências de viagens têm de se reinventar para superar circunstâncias imprevistas, oferecendo experiências melhores e mais coesas aos clientes.

Utilities

Utilities

Reinventar os serviços públicos para as zero emissões

Os serviços públicos são a pedra angular da transição para a neutralidade carbónica. Alcançar as zero emissões líquidas exige passos radicais para gerar valor sustentável para todos.

We are an Industry of One

Toggle awards card detail view

Somos líderes no The Forrester Wave™: Workday Services, 2T 2024

No relatório de 2024, a Accenture recebeu a pontuação mais elevada na categoria de oferta atual e situou-se entre as pontuações mais altas nas categorias de presença no mercado e estratégia.

O estudo realizado pela Forrester avaliou 12 prestadores de serviços Workday em 25 critérios, incluindo gestão de capital humano Workday, gestão financeira Workday, Workday Extend e plataforma na cloud, planeamento adaptável Workday e análise e relatórios Workday (Prism).

Explorar mais

Somos líder no Peak Matrix: Marketing Services Assessment 2024 do Everest Group

Segundo o relatório, "a Accenture fundiu a maioria das suas agências de marketing para formar a Accenture Song, um dos maiores prestadores de serviços de marketing com tecnologia do mundo."

Neste estudo, o Everest Group avaliou 34 prestadores de serviços de marketing. A Accenture é o líder mais bem posicionado no eixo de visão e capacidade e o líder mais bem posicionado no eixo de impacto no mercado.

Somos líderes no primeiro IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Life Sciences R&D Lab of the Future Technology Solutions and Consulting Services 2024 Vendor Assessment

No relatório, a Accenture está posicionada como líder em "estratégias" e "capacidades".

O IDC MarketScape avaliou 13 fornecedores que prestam serviços para ajudar a implementar uma estratégia de laboratório do futuro (LotF) e transformar e modernizar laboratórios em toda a cadeia de valor, desde a conceção das experiências ao fabrico

Capabilities

Case studies

Awards

Reinvent what your business could be

Our wide range of capabilities, ecosystem partnerships and unmatched industry expertise can help your business become the next best version of itself.

Capabilities

The capabilities to help you reinvent

Cloud

Cloud

Take the world by cloud

Every day, cloud computing becomes more integral in driving reinvention, and meeting the ever-changing needs of people around the world.

Customer Service

Customer Service

Turn customer service and proactive support into a growth engine

Impersonal and inconsistent interactions are leaving organizations scrambling to understand how to better support customers. Delivering seamless, data-driven experiences that feel intuitive, not reactive, is vital to unlocking new opportunities for growth.

Cybersecurity

Cybersecurity

De-risk tomorrow by boosting cybersecurity today

Infuse cybersecurity into your strategy and ecosystem to protect value, help prevent threat and build trust as you grow.

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Use AI with purpose

AI is more accessible than ever, and it’s rapidly transforming enterprises and the ways we live and work. The way you apply its potential will determine the impact and position your business to compete and achieve new levels of performance.

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digitize what you make, revolutionize how you make it

Reimagine the products you make and how you make them. Use data, digital and AI to increase resiliency and productivity and improve security and sustainability across the value chain.

Ecosystem Partners

Ecosystem Partners

From change to value faster

Reinvention doesn’t happen in a silo. Fast-track your journey with integrated applications and platforms that bring the latest industry- and function-specific capabilities, plus advanced data and AI offerings, to empower your people and business.

Emerging Technology

Emerging Technology

Shape the future

In a rapidly changing world, embrace emerging technology to transform and achieve greater efficiency, effectiveness, and breakthrough innovation.

Finance and Risk Management

Finance and Risk Management

Investing to build resilience and reduce enterprise risk

Amid intensifying market disruptions and escalating business volatility, there’s more pressure on Chief Financial Officers (CFOs) and Chief Risk Officers (CROs) to balance multiple interconnected transformations while sustaining company performance, profitability and safety.

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Plan, manage and execute capital projects efficiently

Combine human ingenuity with data and AI to deliver large-scale projects on time and within budget, while also achieving broader investment and sustainability objectives.

Learning

Learning

Become a talent creator

While technology plays a key role in business reinvention, it’s your people who determine its success. How can you build the skills they want, and you need, to grow faster?

Managed Services

Managed Services

Change more, faster

As organizations strive to optimize cost and accelerate growth, strategic managed services can help to better prepare them to reinvent operations and drive holistic value at scale.

Marketing and Experience

Marketing and Experience

Marketing for a multidimensional world

Options multiply. Consumer demands evolve. What’s trending today may not be tomorrow. Relevance is essential for growth—create customer experiences that keep up with change.

Metaverse

Metaverse

Make magic in the metaverse

The physical and virtual worlds are blending. The metaverse offers new ways to connect, create and consume. And it’s a fresh chance to make totally inclusive, responsible experiences.

Sales and Commerce

Sales and Commerce

Commerce at the speed of life

Commerce has blended into culture as preferences shift moment to moment. The challenge? Keeping up. Stay relevant by matching the pace and turning complexity into convenience.

Strategy

Strategy

Leading in the next decade

Boldly commit to continuous reinvention and join the small but growing number of companies reaching new levels of profitable growth for their businesses, while also providing greater contributions to humanity.

Supply Chain

Supply Chain

Lead the future with supply chain networks

Anticipate and respond to customer demand. Resilient by design and able to withstand disruptions, supply chain networks drive efficiency, sustainability and growth.

Sustainability

Sustainability

The sustainability imperative

Sustainability spans environmental, social and governance issues. Today every organization must embrace sustainability for future competitiveness.

Talent and Organization

Talent and Organization

Driving growth through people and technology

Thriving organizations are driving change at the intersection of technology and talent. The powerful combination of data and AI and real human experience unlocks new work structures, roles and environments which enable people and businesses to thrive.

Technology Transformation

Technology Transformation

Transform your technology to deliver change faster

Reinvent your digital core with the right strategy, talent and modern practices to increase ROI, drive efficiency and redirect spend to innovations that drive growth.

~250 partnerships to help accelerate change

View all partners

Industries

Unmatched industry expertise

Aerospace and Defense

Aerospace and Defense

Navigate headwinds

From economic uncertainty and supply chain disruptions to skill gaps and shifting consumer expectations, the Aerospace and Defense industry is being challenged. The time is now to embrace a digital-first mindset.

Automotive

Automotive

Get beyond the wheel

The traditional automotive industry has reached a crossroads. We are now operating in a mobility ecosystem, shifting into the next iteration of automotive. To move forward, it’s time to embrace the ecosystem, collaborate beyond industry lines, and find new ways of innovating and partnering for success.

Banking

Banking

Building the next generation of banks

Technology has changed the way people and businesses bank, and traditional strategies no longer work. Now is the time for bold new approaches to intensifying disruption.

Capital Markets

Capital Markets

Capital Markets: See opportunity everywhere

A growing number of retail investors. The transition to low-carbon economies. Infrastructure investments in growing markets. For those who reinvent, constant change is constant opportunity.

Chemicals

Chemicals

Embrace change as a constant

Traditionally seen as a mature, static industry, chemical companies are facing building pressure to move from reactive to proactive and speed innovation.

Communications and Media

Communications and Media

Be hyper-essential for the hyper-connected

People and businesses are always on, whether watching, working, or enabling innovative new growth. Keep them engaged and successful by delivering the continuous experiences and capabilities they expect and need.

Consumer Goods and Services

Consumer Goods and Services

Humans are reinventing the Consumer Goods and Services industry

In the age of digital commerce, it is hard to predict what consumers will buy – and why, when and where they buy it. To stay ahead of uncertainty, think like a consumer and focus on building strong relationships.

Energy

Energy

Use disruption to fuel change

Demand is up. Competition is fierce. People expect sustainability. With inflationary pressures, supply chain network disruptions, and an increased focus on security, energy companies need to change today to compete tomorrow.

Health

Health

Humanizing healthcare

People expect intuitive access to their healthcare and personalized experiences. Leaders that reinvent to create easy access and engaging experiences will stay resilient while delivering better outcomes.

High Tech

High Tech

Transforming the industry that transforms the world

The pressure is on to build innovative tech products and services, reimagine supply chain and manufacturing networks and identify new talent sources. Those who reinvent will lead.

Industrial

Industrial

Excelling at speed in Industrial

A myriad of trends from technology shifts to evolving B2B customer expectations, software-driven product purpose, enhanced services and more are driving companies to embrace continuous reinvention. The time is now to redefine industrial business models.

Insurance

Insurance

Change for resilience

Insurance is protection. As people and societies continuously change, carriers must digitize, connect and personalize to meet today’s more complex customer needs.

Life Science

Life Science

Redefining the possible in Life Sciences

To address the changing needs of patients, rising costs, demands for new treatments, and the need for accelerated R&D innovation, life sciences organizations must adopt a modern transformation approach.

Natural Resources

Natural Resources

Be a steward of the world’s natural resources

As the world looks towards decarbonization, mining, metals, forest products and building materials companies face increasing pressure to shift from being resource producers to resource stewards.

Public Service

Public Service

Create meaningful impact today and build stronger communities for tomorrow

Facing limited resources, increasingly rapid technology advances and a state of perma-crisis, public service organizations who embrace continuous change can have meaningful impact on outcomes for individuals and entire communities.

Private Equity

Private Equity

Reinvent the ways you create value

The next generation of private equity leaders will use an expanded set of value levers to achieve better outcomes.

Retail

Retail

Reset responsibly

Now is the time to responsibly reset, which means better serving the needs of customers, employees and the communities where they live and work. The challenge is to leverage both digital and physical retail experiences to meet new demands—without compromising results.

Software and Platforms

Software and Platforms

A new dawn for the Software & Platforms Industry

The next chapter of hypergrowth is here. Expanded tech, the battle for attention, and macroeconomic shifts have all led to an industry inflection point, with new opportunities on the horizon.

Travel

Travel

Discover new destinations

The travel industry is no stranger to disruption. And in the post-pandemic world, travel companies must continuously reinvent to outwit unforeseen circumstances, while providing cohesive, elevated experiences for customers.

Utilities

Utilities

Radically reinventing power for net zero

Utilities are the cornerstone in the transition to a carbon-neutral world. Achieving net-zero ambitions requires radical moves toward reinvention that will generate sustainable value for all.

See reinvention in action

Every day, we help our clients reinvent their businesses to reach their full potential. Using technology, data, AI and new ways of working. We push boundaries and shape the future of industries.

View client stories

We are an Industry of One

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in The Forrester Wave™: Workday Services, Q2 2024

In the 2024 report, Accenture received the highest score in the Current Offering category, and among the highest scores in the Strategy and Market Presence categories.

The research conducted by Forrester evaluated 12 Workday services providers across 25 criteria, including Workday Human Capital Management, Workday Financial Management, Workday Extend and cloud platform, Workday Adaptive Planning, and Workday Analytics and Reporting (Prism).

Explore more

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in Everest Group’s PEAK Matrix: Marketing Services Assessment 2024

Per the report, “Accenture merged most of its marketing agencies to form Accenture Song, one of the largest technology-powered marketing service providers in the world.”

For this research, Everest Group assessed 34 marketing services providers. Accenture is the highest Leader on the Vision and Capability axis and the highest leader on the Market Impact axis.

Explore more

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in inaugural IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Life Sciences R&D Lab of the Future Technology Solutions and Consulting Services 2024 Vendor Assessment

In the report, Accenture is positioned as a Leader for both “Strategies” and “Capabilities”.

The IDC MarketScape evaluated 13 vendors who provide services to help implement a Lab of the Future (LotF) strategy and transform and modernize labs across the value chain, from experiment design to manufacturing.

Reinvent what your business could be

Our wide range of capabilities, ecosystem partnerships and unmatched industry expertise can help your business become the next best version of itself.

Capabilities

The capabilities to help you reinvent

Cloud

Cloud

Take the world by cloud

Every day, cloud computing becomes more integral in driving reinvention, and meeting the ever-changing needs of people around the world.

Customer Service

Customer Service

Turn customer service and proactive support into a growth engine

Impersonal and inconsistent interactions are leaving organizations scrambling to understand how to better support customers. Delivering seamless, data-driven experiences that feel intuitive, not reactive, is vital to unlocking new opportunities for growth.

Cybersecurity

Cybersecurity

De-risk tomorrow by boosting cybersecurity today

Infuse cybersecurity into your strategy and ecosystem to protect value, help prevent threat and build trust as you grow.

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Use AI with purpose

AI is more accessible than ever, and it’s rapidly transforming enterprises and the ways we live and work. The way you apply its potential will determine the impact and position your business to compete and achieve new levels of performance.

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digitize what you make, revolutionize how you make it

Reimagine the products you make and how you make them. Use data, digital and AI to increase resiliency and productivity and improve security and sustainability across the value chain.

Ecosystem Partners

Ecosystem Partners

From change to value faster

Reinvention doesn’t happen in a silo. Fast-track your journey with integrated applications and platforms that bring the latest industry- and function-specific capabilities, plus advanced data and AI offerings, to empower your people and business.

Emerging Technology

Emerging Technology

Shape the future

In a rapidly changing world, embrace emerging technology to transform and achieve greater efficiency, effectiveness, and breakthrough innovation.

Finance and Risk Management

Finance and Risk Management

Investing to build resilience and reduce enterprise risk

Amid intensifying market disruptions and escalating business volatility, there’s more pressure on Chief Financial Officers (CFOs) and Chief Risk Officers (CROs) to balance multiple interconnected transformations while sustaining company performance, profitability and safety.

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Plan, manage and execute capital projects efficiently

Combine human ingenuity with data and AI to deliver large-scale projects on time and within budget, while also achieving broader investment and sustainability objectives.

Learning

Learning

Become a talent creator

While technology plays a key role in business reinvention, it’s your people who determine its success. How can you build the skills they want, and you need, to grow faster?

Managed Services

Managed Services

Change more, faster

As organizations strive to optimize cost and accelerate growth, strategic managed services can help to better prepare them to reinvent operations and drive holistic value at scale.

Marketing and Experience

Marketing and Experience

Marketing for a multidimensional world

Options multiply. Consumer demands evolve. What’s trending today may not be tomorrow. Relevance is essential for growth—create customer experiences that keep up with change.

Metaverse

Metaverse

Make magic in the metaverse

The physical and virtual worlds are blending. The metaverse offers new ways to connect, create and consume. And it’s a fresh chance to make totally inclusive, responsible experiences.

Sales and Commerce

Sales and Commerce

Commerce at the speed of life

Commerce has blended into culture as preferences shift moment to moment. The challenge? Keeping up. Stay relevant by matching the pace and turning complexity into convenience.

Strategy

Strategy

Leading in the next decade

Boldly commit to continuous reinvention and join the small but growing number of companies reaching new levels of profitable growth for their businesses, while also providing greater contributions to humanity.

Supply Chain

Supply Chain

Lead the future with supply chain networks

Anticipate and respond to customer demand. Resilient by design and able to withstand disruptions, supply chain networks drive efficiency, sustainability and growth.

Sustainability

Sustainability

The sustainability imperative

Sustainability spans environmental, social and governance issues. Today every organization must embrace sustainability for future competitiveness.

Talent and Organization

Talent and Organization

Driving growth through people and technology

Thriving organizations are driving change at the intersection of technology and talent. The powerful combination of data and AI and real human experience unlocks new work structures, roles and environments which enable people and businesses to thrive.

Technology Transformation

Technology Transformation

Transform your technology to deliver change faster

Reinvent your digital core with the right strategy, talent and modern practices to increase ROI, drive efficiency and redirect spend to innovations that drive growth.

~250 partnerships to help accelerate change

View all partners

Industries

Unmatched industry expertise

Aerospace and Defense

Aerospace and Defense

Navigate headwinds

From economic uncertainty and supply chain disruptions to skill gaps and shifting consumer expectations, the Aerospace and Defense industry is being challenged. The time is now to embrace a digital-first mindset.

Automotive

Automotive

Get beyond the wheel

The traditional automotive industry has reached a crossroads. We are now operating in a mobility ecosystem, shifting into the next iteration of automotive. To move forward, it’s time to embrace the ecosystem, collaborate beyond industry lines, and find new ways of innovating and partnering for success.

Banking

Banking

Building the next generation of banks

Technology has changed the way people and businesses bank, and traditional strategies no longer work. Now is the time for bold new approaches to intensifying disruption.

Capital Markets

Capital Markets

Capital Markets: See opportunity everywhere

A growing number of retail investors. The transition to low-carbon economies. Infrastructure investments in growing markets. For those who reinvent, constant change is constant opportunity.

Chemicals

Chemicals

Embrace change as a constant

Traditionally seen as a mature, static industry, chemical companies are facing building pressure to move from reactive to proactive and speed innovation.

Communications and Media

Communications and Media

Be hyper-essential for the hyper-connected

People and businesses are always on, whether watching, working, or enabling innovative new growth. Keep them engaged and successful by delivering the continuous experiences and capabilities they expect and need.

Consumer Goods and Services

Consumer Goods and Services

Humans are reinventing the Consumer Goods and Services industry

In the age of digital commerce, it is hard to predict what consumers will buy – and why, when and where they buy it. To stay ahead of uncertainty, think like a consumer and focus on building strong relationships.

Energy

Energy

Use disruption to fuel change

Demand is up. Competition is fierce. People expect sustainability. With inflationary pressures, supply chain network disruptions, and an increased focus on security, energy companies need to change today to compete tomorrow.

Health

Health

Humanizing healthcare

People expect intuitive access to their healthcare and personalized experiences. Leaders that reinvent to create easy access and engaging experiences will stay resilient while delivering better outcomes.

High Tech

High Tech

Transforming the industry that transforms the world

The pressure is on to build innovative tech products and services, reimagine supply chain and manufacturing networks and identify new talent sources. Those who reinvent will lead.

Industrial

Industrial

Excelling at speed in Industrial

A myriad of trends from technology shifts to evolving B2B customer expectations, software-driven product purpose, enhanced services and more are driving companies to embrace continuous reinvention. The time is now to redefine industrial business models.

Insurance

Insurance

Change for resilience

Insurance is protection. As people and societies continuously change, carriers must digitize, connect and personalize to meet today’s more complex customer needs.

Life Science

Life Science

Redefining the possible in Life Sciences

To address the changing needs of patients, rising costs, demands for new treatments, and the need for accelerated R&D innovation, life sciences organizations must adopt a modern transformation approach.

Natural Resources

Natural Resources

Be a steward of the world’s natural resources

As the world looks towards decarbonization, mining, metals, forest products and building materials companies face increasing pressure to shift from being resource producers to resource stewards.

Public Service

Public Service

Create meaningful impact today and build stronger communities for tomorrow

Facing limited resources, increasingly rapid technology advances and a state of perma-crisis, public service organizations who embrace continuous change can have meaningful impact on outcomes for individuals and entire communities.

Private Equity

Private Equity

Reinvent the ways you create value

The next generation of private equity leaders will use an expanded set of value levers to achieve better outcomes.

Retail

Retail

Reset responsibly

Now is the time to responsibly reset, which means better serving the needs of customers, employees and the communities where they live and work. The challenge is to leverage both digital and physical retail experiences to meet new demands—without compromising results.

Software and Platforms

Software and Platforms

A new dawn for the Software & Platforms Industry

The next chapter of hypergrowth is here. Expanded tech, the battle for attention, and macroeconomic shifts have all led to an industry inflection point, with new opportunities on the horizon.

Travel

Travel

Discover new destinations

The travel industry is no stranger to disruption. And in the post-pandemic world, travel companies must continuously reinvent to outwit unforeseen circumstances, while providing cohesive, elevated experiences for customers.

Utilities

Utilities

Radically reinventing power for net zero

Utilities are the cornerstone in the transition to a carbon-neutral world. Achieving net-zero ambitions requires radical moves toward reinvention that will generate sustainable value for all.

See reinvention in action

Every day, we help our clients reinvent their businesses to reach their full potential. Using technology, data, AI and new ways of working. We push boundaries and shape the future of industries.

View client stories

We are an Industry of One

In the 2024 report, Accenture received the highest score in the Current Offering category, and among the highest scores in the Strategy and Market Presence categories.

The research conducted by Forrester evaluated 12 Workday services providers across 25 criteria, including Workday Human Capital Management, Workday Financial Management, Workday Extend and cloud platform, Workday Adaptive Planning, and Workday Analytics and Reporting (Prism).

We are a Leader in Everest Group’s PEAK Matrix: Marketing Services Assessment 2024

Per the report, “Accenture merged most of its marketing agencies to form Accenture Song, one of the largest technology-powered marketing service providers in the world.”

For this research, Everest Group assessed 34 marketing services providers. Accenture is the highest Leader on the Vision and Capability axis and the highest leader on the Market Impact axis.

Explore more

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in inaugural IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Life Sciences R&D Lab of the Future Technology Solutions and Consulting Services 2024 Vendor Assessment

In the report, Accenture is positioned as a Leader for both “Strategies” and “Capabilities”.

The IDC MarketScape evaluated 13 vendors who provide services to help implement a Lab of the Future (LotF) strategy and transform and modernize labs across the value chain, from experiment design to manufacturing.

Reinvent what your business could be

Our wide range of capabilities, ecosystem partnerships and unmatched industry expertise can help your business become the next best version of itself.

Capabilities

The capabilities to help you reinvent

Cloud

Cloud

Take the world by cloud

Every day, cloud computing becomes more integral in driving reinvention, and meeting the ever-changing needs of people around the world.

Customer Service

Customer Service

Turn customer service and proactive support into a growth engine

Impersonal and inconsistent interactions are leaving organizations scrambling to understand how to better support customers. Delivering seamless, data-driven experiences that feel intuitive, not reactive, is vital to unlocking new opportunities for growth.

Cybersecurity

Cybersecurity

De-risk tomorrow by boosting cybersecurity today

Infuse cybersecurity into your strategy and ecosystem to protect value, help prevent threat and build trust as you grow.

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Use AI with purpose

AI is more accessible than ever, and it’s rapidly transforming enterprises and the ways we live and work. The way you apply its potential will determine the impact and position your business to compete and achieve new levels of performance.

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digitize what you make, revolutionize how you make it

Reimagine the products you make and how you make them. Use data, digital and AI to increase resiliency and productivity and improve security and sustainability across the value chain.

Ecosystem Partners

Ecosystem Partners

From change to value faster

Reinvention doesn’t happen in a silo. Fast-track your journey with integrated applications and platforms that bring the latest industry- and function-specific capabilities, plus advanced data and AI offerings, to empower your people and business.

Emerging Technology

Emerging Technology

Shape the future

In a rapidly changing world, embrace emerging technology to transform and achieve greater efficiency, effectiveness, and breakthrough innovation.

Finance and Risk Management

Finance and Risk Management

Investing to build resilience and reduce enterprise risk

Amid intensifying market disruptions and escalating business volatility, there’s more pressure on Chief Financial Officers (CFOs) and Chief Risk Officers (CROs) to balance multiple interconnected transformations while sustaining company performance, profitability and safety.

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Plan, manage and execute capital projects efficiently

Combine human ingenuity with data and AI to deliver large-scale projects on time and within budget, while also achieving broader investment and sustainability objectives.

Learning

Learning

Become a talent creator

While technology plays a key role in business reinvention, it’s your people who determine its success. How can you build the skills they want, and you need, to grow faster?

Managed Services

Managed Services

Change more, faster

As organizations strive to optimize cost and accelerate growth, strategic managed services can help to better prepare them to reinvent operations and drive holistic value at scale.

Marketing and Experience

Marketing and Experience

Marketing for a multidimensional world

Options multiply. Consumer demands evolve. What’s trending today may not be tomorrow. Relevance is essential for growth—create customer experiences that keep up with change.

Metaverse

Metaverse

Make magic in the metaverse

The physical and virtual worlds are blending. The metaverse offers new ways to connect, create and consume. And it’s a fresh chance to make totally inclusive, responsible experiences.

Sales and Commerce

Sales and Commerce

Commerce at the speed of life

Commerce has blended into culture as preferences shift moment to moment. The challenge? Keeping up. Stay relevant by matching the pace and turning complexity into convenience.

Strategy

Strategy

Leading in the next decade

Boldly commit to continuous reinvention and join the small but growing number of companies reaching new levels of profitable growth for their businesses, while also providing greater contributions to humanity.

Supply Chain

Supply Chain

Lead the future with supply chain networks

Anticipate and respond to customer demand. Resilient by design and able to withstand disruptions, supply chain networks drive efficiency, sustainability and growth.

Sustainability

Sustainability

The sustainability imperative

Sustainability spans environmental, social and governance issues. Today every organization must embrace sustainability for future competitiveness.

Talent and Organization

Talent and Organization

Driving growth through people and technology

Thriving organizations are driving change at the intersection of technology and talent. The powerful combination of data and AI and real human experience unlocks new work structures, roles and environments which enable people and businesses to thrive.

Technology Transformation

Technology Transformation

Transform your technology to deliver change faster

Reinvent your digital core with the right strategy, talent and modern practices to increase ROI, drive efficiency and redirect spend to innovations that drive growth.

~250 partnerships to help accelerate change

View all partners

Industries

Unmatched industry expertise

Aerospace and Defense

Aerospace and Defense

Navigate headwinds

From economic uncertainty and supply chain disruptions to skill gaps and shifting consumer expectations, the Aerospace and Defense industry is being challenged. The time is now to embrace a digital-first mindset.

Automotive

Automotive

Get beyond the wheel

The traditional automotive industry has reached a crossroads. We are now operating in a mobility ecosystem, shifting into the next iteration of automotive. To move forward, it’s time to embrace the ecosystem, collaborate beyond industry lines, and find new ways of innovating and partnering for success.

Banking

Banking

Building the next generation of banks

Technology has changed the way people and businesses bank, and traditional strategies no longer work. Now is the time for bold new approaches to intensifying disruption.

Capital Markets

Capital Markets

Capital Markets: See opportunity everywhere

A growing number of retail investors. The transition to low-carbon economies. Infrastructure investments in growing markets. For those who reinvent, constant change is constant opportunity.

Chemicals

Chemicals

Embrace change as a constant

Traditionally seen as a mature, static industry, chemical companies are facing building pressure to move from reactive to proactive and speed innovation.

Communications and Media

Communications and Media

Be hyper-essential for the hyper-connected

People and businesses are always on, whether watching, working, or enabling innovative new growth. Keep them engaged and successful by delivering the continuous experiences and capabilities they expect and need.

Consumer Goods and Services

Consumer Goods and Services

Humans are reinventing the Consumer Goods and Services industry

In the age of digital commerce, it is hard to predict what consumers will buy – and why, when and where they buy it. To stay ahead of uncertainty, think like a consumer and focus on building strong relationships.

Energy

Energy

Use disruption to fuel change

Demand is up. Competition is fierce. People expect sustainability. With inflationary pressures, supply chain network disruptions, and an increased focus on security, energy companies need to change today to compete tomorrow.

Health

Health

Humanizing healthcare

People expect intuitive access to their healthcare and personalized experiences. Leaders that reinvent to create easy access and engaging experiences will stay resilient while delivering better outcomes.

High Tech

High Tech

Transforming the industry that transforms the world

The pressure is on to build innovative tech products and services, reimagine supply chain and manufacturing networks and identify new talent sources. Those who reinvent will lead.

Industrial

Industrial

Excelling at speed in Industrial

A myriad of trends from technology shifts to evolving B2B customer expectations, software-driven product purpose, enhanced services and more are driving companies to embrace continuous reinvention. The time is now to redefine industrial business models.

Insurance

Insurance

Change for resilience

Insurance is protection. As people and societies continuously change, carriers must digitize, connect and personalize to meet today’s more complex customer needs.

Life Science

Life Science

Redefining the possible in Life Sciences

To address the changing needs of patients, rising costs, demands for new treatments, and the need for accelerated R&D innovation, life sciences organizations must adopt a modern transformation approach.

Natural Resources

Natural Resources

Be a steward of the world’s natural resources

As the world looks towards decarbonization, mining, metals, forest products and building materials companies face increasing pressure to shift from being resource producers to resource stewards.

Public Service

Public Service

Create meaningful impact today and build stronger communities for tomorrow

Facing limited resources, increasingly rapid technology advances and a state of perma-crisis, public service organizations who embrace continuous change can have meaningful impact on outcomes for individuals and entire communities.

Private Equity

Private Equity

Reinvent the ways you create value

The next generation of private equity leaders will use an expanded set of value levers to achieve better outcomes.

Retail

Retail

Reset responsibly

Now is the time to responsibly reset, which means better serving the needs of customers, employees and the communities where they live and work. The challenge is to leverage both digital and physical retail experiences to meet new demands—without compromising results.

Software and Platforms

Software and Platforms

A new dawn for the Software & Platforms Industry

The next chapter of hypergrowth is here. Expanded tech, the battle for attention, and macroeconomic shifts have all led to an industry inflection point, with new opportunities on the horizon.

Travel

Travel

Discover new destinations

The travel industry is no stranger to disruption. And in the post-pandemic world, travel companies must continuously reinvent to outwit unforeseen circumstances, while providing cohesive, elevated experiences for customers.

Utilities

Utilities

Radically reinventing power for net zero

Utilities are the cornerstone in the transition to a carbon-neutral world. Achieving net-zero ambitions requires radical moves toward reinvention that will generate sustainable value for all.

See reinvention in action

Every day, we help our clients reinvent their businesses to reach their full potential. Using technology, data, AI and new ways of working. We push boundaries and shape the future of industries.

View client stories

We are an Industry of One

The research conducted by Forrester evaluated 12 Workday services providers across 25 criteria, including Workday Human Capital Management, Workday Financial Management, Workday Extend and cloud platform, Workday Adaptive Planning, and Workday Analytics and Reporting (Prism).

Capabilities

Awards

Reinvent what your business could be

Our wide range of capabilities, ecosystem partnerships and unmatched industry expertise can help your business become the next best version of itself.

Capabilities

The capabilities to help you reinvent

Cloud

Cloud

Take the world by cloud

Every day, cloud computing becomes more integral in driving reinvention, and meeting the ever-changing needs of people around the world.

Customer Service

Customer Service

Turn customer service and proactive support into a growth engine

Impersonal and inconsistent interactions are leaving organizations scrambling to understand how to better support customers. Delivering seamless, data-driven experiences that feel intuitive, not reactive, is vital to unlocking new opportunities for growth.

Cybersecurity

Cybersecurity

De-risk tomorrow by boosting cybersecurity today

Infuse cybersecurity into your strategy and ecosystem to protect value, help prevent threat and build trust as you grow.

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Use AI with purpose

AI is more accessible than ever, and it’s rapidly transforming enterprises and the ways we live and work. The way you apply its potential will determine the impact and position your business to compete and achieve new levels of performance.

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digitize what you make, revolutionize how you make it

Reimagine the products you make and how you make them. Use data, digital and AI to increase resiliency and productivity and improve security and sustainability across the value chain.

Ecosystem Partners

Ecosystem Partners

From change to value faster

Reinvention doesn’t happen in a silo. Fast-track your journey with integrated applications and platforms that bring the latest industry- and function-specific capabilities, plus advanced data and AI offerings, to empower your people and business.

Emerging Technology

Emerging Technology

Shape the future

In a rapidly changing world, embrace emerging technology to transform and achieve greater efficiency, effectiveness, and breakthrough innovation.

Finance and Risk Management

Finance and Risk Management

Investing to build resilience and reduce enterprise risk

Amid intensifying market disruptions and escalating business volatility, there’s more pressure on Chief Financial Officers (CFOs) and Chief Risk Officers (CROs) to balance multiple interconnected transformations while sustaining company performance, profitability and safety.

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Plan, manage and execute capital projects efficiently

Combine human ingenuity with data and AI to deliver large-scale projects on time and within budget, while also achieving broader investment and sustainability objectives.

Learning

Learning

Become a talent creator

While technology plays a key role in business reinvention, it’s your people who determine its success. How can you build the skills they want, and you need, to grow faster?

Managed Services

Managed Services

Change more, faster

As organizations strive to optimize cost and accelerate growth, strategic managed services can help to better prepare them to reinvent operations and drive holistic value at scale.

Marketing and Experience

Marketing and Experience

Marketing for a multidimensional world

Options multiply. Consumer demands evolve. What’s trending today may not be tomorrow. Relevance is essential for growth—create customer experiences that keep up with change.

Metaverse

Metaverse

Make magic in the metaverse

The physical and virtual worlds are blending. The metaverse offers new ways to connect, create and consume. And it’s a fresh chance to make totally inclusive, responsible experiences.

Sales and Commerce

Sales and Commerce

Commerce at the speed of life

Commerce has blended into culture as preferences shift moment to moment. The challenge? Keeping up. Stay relevant by matching the pace and turning complexity into convenience.

Strategy

Strategy

Leading in the next decade

Boldly commit to continuous reinvention and join the small but growing number of companies reaching new levels of profitable growth for their businesses, while also providing greater contributions to humanity.

Supply Chain

Supply Chain

Lead the future with supply chain networks

Anticipate and respond to customer demand. Resilient by design and able to withstand disruptions, supply chain networks drive efficiency, sustainability and growth.

Sustainability

Sustainability

The sustainability imperative

Sustainability spans environmental, social and governance issues. Today every organization must embrace sustainability for future competitiveness.

Talent and Organization

Talent and Organization

Driving growth through people and technology

Thriving organizations are driving change at the intersection of technology and talent. The powerful combination of data and AI and real human experience unlocks new work structures, roles and environments which enable people and businesses to thrive.

Technology Transformation

Technology Transformation

Transform your technology to deliver change faster

Reinvent your digital core with the right strategy, talent and modern practices to increase ROI, drive efficiency and redirect spend to innovations that drive growth.

~250 partnerships to help accelerate change

View all partners

Industries

Unmatched industry expertise

Aerospace and Defense

Aerospace and Defense

Navigate headwinds

From economic uncertainty and supply chain disruptions to skill gaps and shifting consumer expectations, the Aerospace and Defense industry is being challenged. The time is now to embrace a digital-first mindset.

Automotive

Automotive

Get beyond the wheel

The traditional automotive industry has reached a crossroads. We are now operating in a mobility ecosystem, shifting into the next iteration of automotive. To move forward, it’s time to embrace the ecosystem, collaborate beyond industry lines, and find new ways of innovating and partnering for success.

Banking

Banking

Building the next generation of banks

Technology has changed the way people and businesses bank, and traditional strategies no longer work. Now is the time for bold new approaches to intensifying disruption.

Capital Markets

Capital Markets

Capital Markets: See opportunity everywhere

A growing number of retail investors. The transition to low-carbon economies. Infrastructure investments in growing markets. For those who reinvent, constant change is constant opportunity.

Chemicals

Chemicals

Embrace change as a constant

Traditionally seen as a mature, static industry, chemical companies are facing building pressure to move from reactive to proactive and speed innovation.

Communications and Media

Communications and Media

Be hyper-essential for the hyper-connected

People and businesses are always on, whether watching, working, or enabling innovative new growth. Keep them engaged and successful by delivering the continuous experiences and capabilities they expect and need.

Consumer Goods and Services

Consumer Goods and Services

Humans are reinventing the Consumer Goods and Services industry

In the age of digital commerce, it is hard to predict what consumers will buy – and why, when and where they buy it. To stay ahead of uncertainty, think like a consumer and focus on building strong relationships.

Energy

Energy

Use disruption to fuel change

Demand is up. Competition is fierce. People expect sustainability. With inflationary pressures, supply chain network disruptions, and an increased focus on security, energy companies need to change today to compete tomorrow.

Health

Health

Humanizing healthcare

People expect intuitive access to their healthcare and personalized experiences. Leaders that reinvent to create easy access and engaging experiences will stay resilient while delivering better outcomes.

High Tech

High Tech

Transforming the industry that transforms the world

The pressure is on to build innovative tech products and services, reimagine supply chain and manufacturing networks and identify new talent sources. Those who reinvent will lead.

Industrial

Industrial

Excelling at speed in Industrial

A myriad of trends from technology shifts to evolving B2B customer expectations, software-driven product purpose, enhanced services and more are driving companies to embrace continuous reinvention. The time is now to redefine industrial business models.

Insurance

Insurance

Change for resilience

Insurance is protection. As people and societies continuously change, carriers must digitize, connect and personalize to meet today’s more complex customer needs.

Life Science

Life Science

Redefining the possible in Life Sciences

To address the changing needs of patients, rising costs, demands for new treatments, and the need for accelerated R&D innovation, life sciences organizations must adopt a modern transformation approach.

Natural Resources

Natural Resources

Be a steward of the world’s natural resources

As the world looks towards decarbonization, mining, metals, forest products and building materials companies face increasing pressure to shift from being resource producers to resource stewards.

Public Service

Public Service

Create meaningful impact today and build stronger communities for tomorrow

Facing limited resources, increasingly rapid technology advances and a state of perma-crisis, public service organizations who embrace continuous change can have meaningful impact on outcomes for individuals and entire communities.

Private Equity

Private Equity

Reinvent the ways you create value

The next generation of private equity leaders will use an expanded set of value levers to achieve better outcomes.

Retail

Retail

Reset responsibly

Now is the time to responsibly reset, which means better serving the needs of customers, employees and the communities where they live and work. The challenge is to leverage both digital and physical retail experiences to meet new demands—without compromising results.

Software and Platforms

Software and Platforms

A new dawn for the Software & Platforms Industry

The next chapter of hypergrowth is here. Expanded tech, the battle for attention, and macroeconomic shifts have all led to an industry inflection point, with new opportunities on the horizon.

Travel

Travel

Discover new destinations

The travel industry is no stranger to disruption. And in the post-pandemic world, travel companies must continuously reinvent to outwit unforeseen circumstances, while providing cohesive, elevated experiences for customers.

Utilities

Utilities

Radically reinventing power for net zero

Utilities are the cornerstone in the transition to a carbon-neutral world. Achieving net-zero ambitions requires radical moves toward reinvention that will generate sustainable value for all.

See reinvention in action

Every day, we help our clients reinvent their businesses to reach their full potential. Using technology, data, AI and new ways of working. We push boundaries and shape the future of industries.

View client stories

We are an Industry of One

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in The Forrester Wave™: Workday Services, Q2 2024

In the 2024 report, Accenture received the highest score in the Current Offering category, and among the highest scores in the Strategy and Market Presence categories.

The research conducted by Forrester evaluated 12 Workday services providers across 25 criteria, including Workday Human Capital Management, Workday Financial Management, Workday Extend and cloud platform, Workday Adaptive Planning, and Workday Analytics and Reporting (Prism).

Explore more

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in Everest Group’s PEAK Matrix: Marketing Services Assessment 2024

Per the report, “Accenture merged most of its marketing agencies to form Accenture Song, one of the largest technology-powered marketing service providers in the world.”

For this research, Everest Group assessed 34 marketing services providers. Accenture is the highest Leader on the Vision and Capability axis and the highest leader on the Market Impact axis.

Explore more

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in inaugural IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Life Sciences R&D Lab of the Future Technology Solutions and Consulting Services 2024 Vendor Assessment

In the report, Accenture is positioned as a Leader for both “Strategies” and “Capabilities”.

The IDC MarketScape evaluated 13 vendors who provide services to help implement a Lab of the Future (LotF) strategy and transform and modernize labs across the value chain, from experiment design to manufacturing.
