Our thinking

Accenture’s latest research and perspectives on how you can reinvent every part of the enterprise

Enterprise

We're helping CEOs, CSOs, and COOs reinvent how their organizations compete, grow and lead in an era of enterprise reinvention.

See all

Close

Research Report

The dawn of the agentic deal

Agentic AI is reshaping M&A. It embeds intelligent systems into operating models and workflows to unlock entirely new value pools. See how leading acquirers build AI into the deal thesis to drive compounding advantage.

Expand

Close

Perspective

The complexity dividend

Complexity can drain profits and stifle growth, but AI is the X factor, turning complexity into a strategic advantage that drives margin and market share.

Expand

Close

Journal Article

Harvard Business Review: For Multinational Companies, Localization Matters More Than Ever

The article argues that advantage now comes from operating as a network of deeply rooted regional businesses that can comply, compete and innovate locally while remaining globally coordinated.

Read more

Close

Research Report

Pulse of Change: What’s top of mind for today’s leaders

After two years of rapid AI acceleration, global executives enter 2026 with unmistakable confidence. But beneath the optimism, data shows a series of gaps standing in the way of scale and value.

Expand

Close

Growth in the age of AI

AI is reshaping markets as $27T moves to companies with Value Leader DNA—six behaviors that help them monetize smarter, innovate faster and build durable, future-ready growth.

Expand

Close

MIT Sloan Management Review: Five traits of the tech-driven CEO

The article argues that technology-driven CEOs don’t treat digital tools as operational support but as a primary source of strategic advantage.

Read more

Close

Research Report

Resilience redefined: From readiness to reinvention

Resilience appears to be rebounding to post-pandemic highs, but the gains mask a deeper vulnerability. Increased volatility requires adaptative resilience for competitiveness and growth.

Expand

Digital Core

We're helping CIOs, CTOs and CDOs reinvent their technology foundation to unlock the full value of cloud, data and AI.

See all

Close

Research Report

AI innovation is nonstop. Your cloud foundation should be too.

Modern cloud is the foundation for AI innovation. But data shows: most clouds are not AI-ready. Discover three strategic pathways, each with detailed actions for boosting cloud maturity to unleash the potential of AI.

Expand

Close

Perspective

The intelligent superhighway you need to unlock value from AI

Many pilot AI. Few have scaled value. Organizations pulling ahead align data, processes, workflows, talent, governance and operating models to create an AI superhighway—unlocking enterprise value, faster.

Expand

Close

Journal Article

Harvard Business Review: Design Processes to Evolve with Emerging Technology

This article argues that emerging technologies—especially generative and agentic AI—are enabling a fundamental shift: from periodic overhaul to continuous evolution.

Read more

Close

Research Report

Rewriting platform strategy for agentic AI

Agentic AI is reshaping work and redefining enterprise foundations. To capture its full value, companies must reinvent platforms and align AI, platform and business strategies.

Expand

Close

Perspective

Data center trends 2026: Shifting up a gear

Accelerating growth, new tech, and fierce competition are reshaping data centers in 2026. Discover the trends driving speed, efficiency, and innovation worldwide.

Expand

Close

Journal Article

Harvard Business Review: Turning real-time satellite data into a competitive advantage

The article argues that satellite data can no longer be experimental, as leaders use real-time orbital intelligence with AI and edge computing to strengthen risk management, supply chains, connectivity, and operations.

Read more

Close

Perspective

AI-ready infrastructure: Enabling enterprise potential

Organizations need to move beyond fragmented IT landscapes and build a modern, AI-ready infrastructure that is resilient, adaptive, and powered by AI.

Expand

Talent

We're helping CHROs and workforce leaders reinvent how they attract, develop and retain the talent that makes reinvention stick.

See all

Close

How can people and AI thrive together? Explore six leadership traits that enable Talent Reinventors to achieve breakthrough results and outperform peers.

Close

Perspective

Rethinking talent strategy

Discover how a human+AI talent strategy can unlock hidden value, boost creativity, and transform work design.

Expand

Close

Journal Article

Knowledge at Wharton: The Skills Mismatch Economy

The report highlights significant shifts that AI is driving, showing an oversupply of generalist skills and critical deficits in specialized, technical and execution-oriented capabilities.

Read more

Close

Research Report

The age of co-intelligence

The age of co-intelligence is here as humans and AI collaborate to drive growth, redeploy talent and turn skills into measurable value across business and society.

Expand

Close

Research Report

Learning, reinvented: Accelerating human-AI collaboration

Humans and AI must learn and adapt together through continuous co-learning. Yet only 11% of organizations are currently equipped to do so effectively, creating an urgent gap and a significant opportunity.

Expand

Close

Research Report

AI and your operating model: Radically new ways of working

Traditional workflows, functions jobs and skills will evolve with gen AI. Learn how you can accelerate reinvention with an operating model that holistically integrates tech, talent and processes to drive sustainable growth.

See all

Close

Perspective

Why systemic AI is the new growth infrastructure for manufacturers

Pilots prove value. Systemic AI unlocks it. Learn how leading manufacturers turn fragmented pilots into an operating model that gets smarter with every cycle.

Expand

Close

Rethinking the course to manufacturing’s future

Factories will look stunningly different by 2040. They will be AI-driven and hyper-automated with human oversight. Here’s how to lay the foundation for the future of manufacturing today.

Expand

Close

Research Report

Blueprint for success​

How top performers consistently deliver on their infrastructure and capital projects​' commitments.

Expand

Close

Perspective

Making self-funding supply chains real

Discover how AI and autonomous technologies create self‑funding supply chains, cutting costs, boosting productivity and enabling end‑to‑end growth.

Expand

Close

Perspective

Data center trends 2026: Shifting up a gear

Accelerating growth, new tech, and fierce competition are reshaping data centers in 2026. Discover the trends driving speed, efficiency, and innovation worldwide.

Expand

See all

Close

Research Report

Is your company ready for agentic commerce?

AI agents now sit between brands and consumers, comparing products, evaluating warranties, choosing a winner and completing purchases—autonomously, in seconds. It’s a generational reset of the rules of commerce.

Expand

Close

Research Report

Luxe Eternal: The customer edit

The customer edit explores how customers themselves are redefining luxury—what they value, aspire to and expect from brands today.

Expand

Close

Perspective

What it will really take for pharma to reinvent customer engagement

While human relationships are (and always will be) the crux of meaningful customer engagements, AI is reshaping how field teams and digital channels interact with customers.

Expand

Close

Research Report

How to win hearts, minds—and algorithms

AI is evolving from a useful tool to a trusted guide, loyal companion and second self. Building resilient relationships between consumers, brands and AI in times of uncertainty is essential to remain seen and relevant.

Expand

Close

Research Report

Customer service on the brink

What do customers really want? And how can companies get it right? Discover three essential actions to ensure your tech, data and generative AI investments deliver efficiencies, reduce costs and enhance customer satisfaction.

Expand

Cybersecurity

We’re helping CISOs reinvent cyber resilience—building defenses, protecting enterprises and managing risk.

See all

Close

Research Report

4 critical actions to take now to strengthen your cyber defenses

Cyber risks are growing faster than ever, outpacing security efforts. How do you get ahead of these threats? In this year’s State of Cybersecurity Resilience, learn the steps to build resilience as you embrace AI transformation.

Expand

Close

Perspective

Securing the digital core in the gen AI era

To close the gap in security maturity within the digital core and achieve reinvention readiness, organizations must activate three strategic levers. Here are the essential strategies for success.

Expand

Close

Safeguard against gen AI-powered attacks and protect AI environments

Cybercriminals are using gen AI-powered attacks to target organizations. To address these new risks and to accelerate gen AI success, organizations need to update their security posture and embed security by design.

Expand

Close

Journal Article

Microsoft: National Security in the Age of AI and Quantum (ME)

Microsoft and Accenture’s whitepaper shows cyber resilience is central to national security, shaping economic stability and sovereignty.

Read more

Finance

We're helping CFOs reinvent finance from a cost center into a strategic driver of enterprise value and growth.

See all

Close

Research Report

The dawn of the agentic deal

Agentic AI is reshaping M&A. It embeds intelligent systems into operating models and workflows to unlock entirely new value pools. See how leading acquirers build AI into the deal thesis to drive compounding advantage.

Expand

Close

Research Report

Actioning the Next Generation of Risk Management

To ensure safety, soundness and long term growth, banking leaders must shift from a reactive stance to a strategic model.

Expand

Close

Research Report

Risk is everywhere

Risk is everywhere and companies need to create a new risk mindset and capabilities across the enterprise. This pivot is critical for turning hyper-disruption into opportunities for business resilience and growth.

Expand

We're helping industry leaders reinvent their businesses with solutions built for the unique challenges and opportunities of their sector.

See all

Close

Research Report

Reinvent for growth: The signals shaping media’s next chapter

Grounded in global consumer and executive research, these five signals reveal how audience behavior, technology and transformation momentum are reshaping growth across the media industry.

Expand

Close

Research Report

Reinventing biopharma from lab to line

Sparking innovation and value in Biopharma production. How pharmaceutical manufacturing has evolved from behind-the-scenes operations to a strategic differentiator.

Expand

Close

Research Report

Top Banking Trends for 2026

Accenture’s Banking Trends 2026 reveals how agentic AI, smart money and shifting competition will reshape customer experience and growth.

Expand

Close

Research Report

Reimagining Public Services: Why experience is everything

Modernization isn’t just about adding tools—it’s about ensuring great experiences for residents and those who serve them. Agencies that align technology with human needs turn digital investments into enduring public value.

Expand

Close

Research Report

Holiday shopping 2025

Holiday shoppers, facing decision stress and high prices, are seeking value combined with experience, convenience and connection. Many are turning to Gen AI for inspiration, product comparisons and smarter shortlists.

Expand

Close

Research Report

Powered for Change 2025

One-off pilots won't decarbonize industry fast enough. Companies must shift from isolated projects to a multigenerational, AI-enabled approach.

Awards

Reinvent what your business could be

Our wide range of capabilities, ecosystem partnerships and unmatched industry expertise can help your business become the next best version of itself.

Capabilities

The capabilities to help you reinvent

Cloud

Cloud

Take the world by cloud

Every day, cloud computing becomes more integral in driving reinvention, and meeting the ever-changing needs of people around the world.

Customer Service

Customer Service

Turn customer service and proactive support into a growth engine

Impersonal and inconsistent interactions are leaving organizations scrambling to understand how to better support customers. Delivering seamless, data-driven experiences that feel intuitive, not reactive, is vital to unlocking new opportunities for growth.

Cybersecurity

Cybersecurity

De-risk tomorrow by boosting cybersecurity today

Infuse cybersecurity into your strategy and ecosystem to protect value, help prevent threat and build trust as you grow.

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Use AI with purpose

AI is more accessible than ever, and it’s rapidly transforming enterprises and the ways we live and work. The way you apply its potential will determine the impact and position your business to compete and achieve new levels of performance.

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digitize what you make, revolutionize how you make it

Reimagine the products you make and how you make them. Use data, digital and AI to increase resiliency and productivity and improve security and sustainability across the value chain.

Ecosystem Partners

Ecosystem Partners

From change to value faster

Reinvention doesn’t happen in a silo. Fast-track your journey with integrated applications and platforms that bring the latest industry- and function-specific capabilities, plus advanced data and AI offerings, to empower your people and business.

Emerging Technology

Emerging Technology

Shape the future

In a rapidly changing world, embrace emerging technology to transform and achieve greater efficiency, effectiveness, and breakthrough innovation.

Finance and Risk Management

Finance and Risk Management

Investing to build resilience and reduce enterprise risk

Amid intensifying market disruptions and escalating business volatility, there’s more pressure on Chief Financial Officers (CFOs) and Chief Risk Officers (CROs) to balance multiple interconnected transformations while sustaining company performance, profitability and safety.

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Plan, manage and execute capital projects efficiently

Combine human ingenuity with data and AI to deliver large-scale projects on time and within budget, while also achieving broader investment and sustainability objectives.

Learning

Learning

Become a talent creator

While technology plays a key role in business reinvention, it’s your people who determine its success. How can you build the skills they want, and you need, to grow faster?

Managed Services

Managed Services

Change more, faster

As organizations strive to optimize cost and accelerate growth, strategic managed services can help to better prepare them to reinvent operations and drive holistic value at scale.

Marketing and Experience

Marketing and Experience

Marketing for a multidimensional world

Options multiply. Consumer demands evolve. What’s trending today may not be tomorrow. Relevance is essential for growth—create customer experiences that keep up with change.

Metaverse

Metaverse

Make magic in the metaverse

The physical and virtual worlds are blending. The metaverse offers new ways to connect, create and consume. And it’s a fresh chance to make totally inclusive, responsible experiences.

Sales and Commerce

Sales and Commerce

Commerce at the speed of life

Commerce has blended into culture as preferences shift moment to moment. The challenge? Keeping up. Stay relevant by matching the pace and turning complexity into convenience.

Strategy

Strategy

Leading in the next decade

Boldly commit to continuous reinvention and join the small but growing number of companies reaching new levels of profitable growth for their businesses, while also providing greater contributions to humanity.

Supply Chain

Supply Chain

Lead the future with supply chain networks

Anticipate and respond to customer demand. Resilient by design and able to withstand disruptions, supply chain networks drive efficiency, sustainability and growth.

Sustainability

Sustainability

The sustainability imperative

Sustainability spans environmental, social and governance issues. Today every organization must embrace sustainability for future competitiveness.

Talent and Organization

Talent and Organization

Driving growth through people and technology

Thriving organizations are driving change at the intersection of technology and talent. The powerful combination of data and AI and real human experience unlocks new work structures, roles and environments which enable people and businesses to thrive.

Technology Transformation

Technology Transformation

Transform your technology to deliver change faster

Reinvent your digital core with the right strategy, talent and modern practices to increase ROI, drive efficiency and redirect spend to innovations that drive growth.

~250 partnerships to help accelerate change

View all partners

Industries

Unmatched industry expertise

Aerospace and Defense

Aerospace and Defense

Navigate headwinds

From economic uncertainty and supply chain disruptions to skill gaps and shifting consumer expectations, the Aerospace and Defense industry is being challenged. The time is now to embrace a digital-first mindset.

Automotive

Automotive

Get beyond the wheel

The traditional automotive industry has reached a crossroads. We are now operating in a mobility ecosystem, shifting into the next iteration of automotive. To move forward, it’s time to embrace the ecosystem, collaborate beyond industry lines, and find new ways of innovating and partnering for success.

Banking

Banking

Building the next generation of banks

Technology has changed the way people and businesses bank, and traditional strategies no longer work. Now is the time for bold new approaches to intensifying disruption.

Capital Markets

Capital Markets

Capital Markets: See opportunity everywhere

A growing number of retail investors. The transition to low-carbon economies. Infrastructure investments in growing markets. For those who reinvent, constant change is constant opportunity.

Chemicals

Chemicals

Embrace change as a constant

Traditionally seen as a mature, static industry, chemical companies are facing building pressure to move from reactive to proactive and speed innovation.

Communications and Media

Communications and Media

Be hyper-essential for the hyper-connected

People and businesses are always on, whether watching, working, or enabling innovative new growth. Keep them engaged and successful by delivering the continuous experiences and capabilities they expect and need.

Consumer Goods and Services

Consumer Goods and Services

Humans are reinventing the Consumer Goods and Services industry

In the age of digital commerce, it is hard to predict what consumers will buy – and why, when and where they buy it. To stay ahead of uncertainty, think like a consumer and focus on building strong relationships.

Energy

Energy

Use disruption to fuel change

Demand is up. Competition is fierce. People expect sustainability. With inflationary pressures, supply chain network disruptions, and an increased focus on security, energy companies need to change today to compete tomorrow.

Health

Health

Humanizing healthcare

People expect intuitive access to their healthcare and personalized experiences. Leaders that reinvent to create easy access and engaging experiences will stay resilient while delivering better outcomes.

High Tech

High Tech

Transforming the industry that transforms the world

The pressure is on to build innovative tech products and services, reimagine supply chain and manufacturing networks and identify new talent sources. Those who reinvent will lead.

Industrial

Industrial

Excelling at speed in Industrial

A myriad of trends from technology shifts to evolving B2B customer expectations, software-driven product purpose, enhanced services and more are driving companies to embrace continuous reinvention. The time is now to redefine industrial business models.

Insurance

Insurance

Change for resilience

Insurance is protection. As people and societies continuously change, carriers must digitize, connect and personalize to meet today’s more complex customer needs.

Life Science

Life Science

Redefining the possible in Life Sciences

To address the changing needs of patients, rising costs, demands for new treatments, and the need for accelerated R&D innovation, life sciences organizations must adopt a modern transformation approach.

Natural Resources

Natural Resources

Be a steward of the world’s natural resources

As the world looks towards decarbonization, mining, metals, forest products and building materials companies face increasing pressure to shift from being resource producers to resource stewards.

Public Service

Public Service

Create meaningful impact today and build stronger communities for tomorrow

Facing limited resources, increasingly rapid technology advances and a state of perma-crisis, public service organizations who embrace continuous change can have meaningful impact on outcomes for individuals and entire communities.

Private Equity

Private Equity

Reinvent the ways you create value

The next generation of private equity leaders will use an expanded set of value levers to achieve better outcomes.

Retail

Retail

Reset responsibly

Now is the time to responsibly reset, which means better serving the needs of customers, employees and the communities where they live and work. The challenge is to leverage both digital and physical retail experiences to meet new demands—without compromising results.

Software and Platforms

Software and Platforms

A new dawn for the Software & Platforms Industry

The next chapter of hypergrowth is here. Expanded tech, the battle for attention, and macroeconomic shifts have all led to an industry inflection point, with new opportunities on the horizon.

Travel

Travel

Discover new destinations

The travel industry is no stranger to disruption. And in the post-pandemic world, travel companies must continuously reinvent to outwit unforeseen circumstances, while providing cohesive, elevated experiences for customers.

Utilities

Utilities

Radically reinventing power for net zero

Utilities are the cornerstone in the transition to a carbon-neutral world. Achieving net-zero ambitions requires radical moves toward reinvention that will generate sustainable value for all.

See reinvention in action

Every day, we help our clients reinvent their businesses to reach their full potential. Using technology, data, AI and new ways of working. We push boundaries and shape the future of industries.

View client stories

We are an Industry of One

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in The Forrester Wave™: Workday Services, Q2 2024

In the 2024 report, Accenture received the highest score in the Current Offering category, and among the highest scores in the Strategy and Market Presence categories.

The research conducted by Forrester evaluated 12 Workday services providers across 25 criteria, including Workday Human Capital Management, Workday Financial Management, Workday Extend and cloud platform, Workday Adaptive Planning, and Workday Analytics and Reporting (Prism).

Explore more

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in Everest Group’s PEAK Matrix: Marketing Services Assessment 2024

Per the report, “Accenture merged most of its marketing agencies to form Accenture Song, one of the largest technology-powered marketing service providers in the world.”

For this research, Everest Group assessed 34 marketing services providers. Accenture is the highest Leader on the Vision and Capability axis and the highest leader on the Market Impact axis.

Explore more

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in inaugural IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Life Sciences R&D Lab of the Future Technology Solutions and Consulting Services 2024 Vendor Assessment

In the report, Accenture is positioned as a Leader for both “Strategies” and “Capabilities”.

The IDC MarketScape evaluated 13 vendors who provide services to help implement a Lab of the Future (LotF) strategy and transform and modernize labs across the value chain, from experiment design to manufacturing.

Rozvíjajte svoju kariéru

Od vývojárov a dizajnérov až po stratégov či SAP odborníkov, u nás nájdete nekonečné príležitosti na učenie, rast a prispievanie k pozitívnym zmenám.

Umelá inteligencia (AI) a dátová veda

Využite potenciál umelej inteligencie a dát a pomôžte firmám nanovo zadefinovať všetky aspekty podnikania – zodpovedným spôsobom.

Zistite viac

Poradenstvo

Špecializácia na priemyselné odvetvia. Dokonalý prehľad. Inovatívne nápady. Pomôžete klientom pochopiť, čo musia zmeniť, aby boli pripravení na budúcnosť.

Zistite viac

Inžinierstvo a výroba

Využívajte dáta, poznatky a nové technológie na pomoc klientom s inováciou výrobných procesov, aby mohli vyrábať rýchlejšie, efektívnejšie a udržateľnejšie.

Prevádzka podnikov

Využívajte dáta, poznatky a technológie na predefinovanie spôsobu, akým ľudia pracujú a zmeňte prevádzky firiem z transakčných na transformačné.

Softvérové inžinierstvo

Vytvárajte softvér, ktorý bude motorom zmien a prinesie ľuďom nové možnosti.

Stratégia

Úspech vychádza z inteligentnej stratégie. Využite svoje poznatky a strategické myslenie, a pomôžte klientom zmeniť sa a udržať si náskok pred konkurenciou.

Zistite viac

Technológie

Pracujte s technológiami, ktoré naši klienti potrebujú na svoju transformáciu a zmenu sveta k lepšiemu.

Odborníci na začiatku kariéry

Odborníci so skúsenosťami

Capabilities

Case studies

Awards

Reinvent what your business could be

Our wide range of capabilities, ecosystem partnerships and unmatched industry expertise can help your business become the next best version of itself.

Capabilities

The capabilities to help you reinvent

Cloud

Cloud

Take the world by cloud

Every day, cloud computing becomes more integral in driving reinvention, and meeting the ever-changing needs of people around the world.

Customer Service

Customer Service

Turn customer service and proactive support into a growth engine

Impersonal and inconsistent interactions are leaving organizations scrambling to understand how to better support customers. Delivering seamless, data-driven experiences that feel intuitive, not reactive, is vital to unlocking new opportunities for growth.

Cybersecurity

Cybersecurity

De-risk tomorrow by boosting cybersecurity today

Infuse cybersecurity into your strategy and ecosystem to protect value, help prevent threat and build trust as you grow.

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Use AI with purpose

AI is more accessible than ever, and it’s rapidly transforming enterprises and the ways we live and work. The way you apply its potential will determine the impact and position your business to compete and achieve new levels of performance.

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digitize what you make, revolutionize how you make it

Reimagine the products you make and how you make them. Use data, digital and AI to increase resiliency and productivity and improve security and sustainability across the value chain.

Ecosystem Partners

Ecosystem Partners

From change to value faster

Reinvention doesn’t happen in a silo. Fast-track your journey with integrated applications and platforms that bring the latest industry- and function-specific capabilities, plus advanced data and AI offerings, to empower your people and business.

Emerging Technology

Emerging Technology

Shape the future

In a rapidly changing world, embrace emerging technology to transform and achieve greater efficiency, effectiveness, and breakthrough innovation.

Finance and Risk Management

Finance and Risk Management

Investing to build resilience and reduce enterprise risk

Amid intensifying market disruptions and escalating business volatility, there’s more pressure on Chief Financial Officers (CFOs) and Chief Risk Officers (CROs) to balance multiple interconnected transformations while sustaining company performance, profitability and safety.

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Plan, manage and execute capital projects efficiently

Combine human ingenuity with data and AI to deliver large-scale projects on time and within budget, while also achieving broader investment and sustainability objectives.

Learning

Learning

Become a talent creator

While technology plays a key role in business reinvention, it’s your people who determine its success. How can you build the skills they want, and you need, to grow faster?

Managed Services

Managed Services

Change more, faster

As organizations strive to optimize cost and accelerate growth, strategic managed services can help to better prepare them to reinvent operations and drive holistic value at scale.

Marketing and Experience

Marketing and Experience

Marketing for a multidimensional world

Options multiply. Consumer demands evolve. What’s trending today may not be tomorrow. Relevance is essential for growth—create customer experiences that keep up with change.

Metaverse

Metaverse

Make magic in the metaverse

The physical and virtual worlds are blending. The metaverse offers new ways to connect, create and consume. And it’s a fresh chance to make totally inclusive, responsible experiences.

Sales and Commerce

Sales and Commerce

Commerce at the speed of life

Commerce has blended into culture as preferences shift moment to moment. The challenge? Keeping up. Stay relevant by matching the pace and turning complexity into convenience.

Strategy

Strategy

Leading in the next decade

Boldly commit to continuous reinvention and join the small but growing number of companies reaching new levels of profitable growth for their businesses, while also providing greater contributions to humanity.

Supply Chain

Supply Chain

Lead the future with supply chain networks

Anticipate and respond to customer demand. Resilient by design and able to withstand disruptions, supply chain networks drive efficiency, sustainability and growth.

Sustainability

Sustainability

The sustainability imperative

Sustainability spans environmental, social and governance issues. Today every organization must embrace sustainability for future competitiveness.

Talent and Organization

Talent and Organization

Driving growth through people and technology

Thriving organizations are driving change at the intersection of technology and talent. The powerful combination of data and AI and real human experience unlocks new work structures, roles and environments which enable people and businesses to thrive.

Technology Transformation

Technology Transformation

Transform your technology to deliver change faster

Reinvent your digital core with the right strategy, talent and modern practices to increase ROI, drive efficiency and redirect spend to innovations that drive growth.

~250 partnerships to help accelerate change

View all partners

Industries

Unmatched industry expertise

Aerospace and Defense

Aerospace and Defense

Navigate headwinds

From economic uncertainty and supply chain disruptions to skill gaps and shifting consumer expectations, the Aerospace and Defense industry is being challenged. The time is now to embrace a digital-first mindset.

Automotive

Automotive

Get beyond the wheel

The traditional automotive industry has reached a crossroads. We are now operating in a mobility ecosystem, shifting into the next iteration of automotive. To move forward, it’s time to embrace the ecosystem, collaborate beyond industry lines, and find new ways of innovating and partnering for success.

Banking

Banking

Building the next generation of banks

Technology has changed the way people and businesses bank, and traditional strategies no longer work. Now is the time for bold new approaches to intensifying disruption.

Capital Markets

Capital Markets

Capital Markets: See opportunity everywhere

A growing number of retail investors. The transition to low-carbon economies. Infrastructure investments in growing markets. For those who reinvent, constant change is constant opportunity.

Chemicals

Chemicals

Embrace change as a constant

Traditionally seen as a mature, static industry, chemical companies are facing building pressure to move from reactive to proactive and speed innovation.

Communications and Media

Communications and Media

Be hyper-essential for the hyper-connected

People and businesses are always on, whether watching, working, or enabling innovative new growth. Keep them engaged and successful by delivering the continuous experiences and capabilities they expect and need.

Consumer Goods and Services

Consumer Goods and Services

Humans are reinventing the Consumer Goods and Services industry

In the age of digital commerce, it is hard to predict what consumers will buy – and why, when and where they buy it. To stay ahead of uncertainty, think like a consumer and focus on building strong relationships.

Energy

Energy

Use disruption to fuel change

Demand is up. Competition is fierce. People expect sustainability. With inflationary pressures, supply chain network disruptions, and an increased focus on security, energy companies need to change today to compete tomorrow.

Health

Health

Humanizing healthcare

People expect intuitive access to their healthcare and personalized experiences. Leaders that reinvent to create easy access and engaging experiences will stay resilient while delivering better outcomes.

High Tech

High Tech

Transforming the industry that transforms the world

The pressure is on to build innovative tech products and services, reimagine supply chain and manufacturing networks and identify new talent sources. Those who reinvent will lead.

Industrial

Industrial

Excelling at speed in Industrial

A myriad of trends from technology shifts to evolving B2B customer expectations, software-driven product purpose, enhanced services and more are driving companies to embrace continuous reinvention. The time is now to redefine industrial business models.

Insurance

Insurance

Change for resilience

Insurance is protection. As people and societies continuously change, carriers must digitize, connect and personalize to meet today’s more complex customer needs.

Life Science

Life Science

Redefining the possible in Life Sciences

To address the changing needs of patients, rising costs, demands for new treatments, and the need for accelerated R&D innovation, life sciences organizations must adopt a modern transformation approach.

Natural Resources

Natural Resources

Be a steward of the world’s natural resources

As the world looks towards decarbonization, mining, metals, forest products and building materials companies face increasing pressure to shift from being resource producers to resource stewards.

Public Service

Public Service

Create meaningful impact today and build stronger communities for tomorrow

Facing limited resources, increasingly rapid technology advances and a state of perma-crisis, public service organizations who embrace continuous change can have meaningful impact on outcomes for individuals and entire communities.

Private Equity

Private Equity

Reinvent the ways you create value

The next generation of private equity leaders will use an expanded set of value levers to achieve better outcomes.

Retail

Retail

Reset responsibly

Now is the time to responsibly reset, which means better serving the needs of customers, employees and the communities where they live and work. The challenge is to leverage both digital and physical retail experiences to meet new demands—without compromising results.

Software and Platforms

Software and Platforms

A new dawn for the Software & Platforms Industry

The next chapter of hypergrowth is here. Expanded tech, the battle for attention, and macroeconomic shifts have all led to an industry inflection point, with new opportunities on the horizon.

Travel

Travel

Discover new destinations

The travel industry is no stranger to disruption. And in the post-pandemic world, travel companies must continuously reinvent to outwit unforeseen circumstances, while providing cohesive, elevated experiences for customers.

Utilities

Utilities

Radically reinventing power for net zero

Utilities are the cornerstone in the transition to a carbon-neutral world. Achieving net-zero ambitions requires radical moves toward reinvention that will generate sustainable value for all.

See reinvention in action

Every day, we help our clients reinvent their businesses to reach their full potential. Using technology, data, AI and new ways of working. We push boundaries and shape the future of industries.

View client stories

We are an Industry of One

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in The Forrester Wave™: Workday Services, Q2 2024

In the 2024 report, Accenture received the highest score in the Current Offering category, and among the highest scores in the Strategy and Market Presence categories.

The research conducted by Forrester evaluated 12 Workday services providers across 25 criteria, including Workday Human Capital Management, Workday Financial Management, Workday Extend and cloud platform, Workday Adaptive Planning, and Workday Analytics and Reporting (Prism).

Explore more

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in Everest Group’s PEAK Matrix: Marketing Services Assessment 2024

Per the report, “Accenture merged most of its marketing agencies to form Accenture Song, one of the largest technology-powered marketing service providers in the world.”

For this research, Everest Group assessed 34 marketing services providers. Accenture is the highest Leader on the Vision and Capability axis and the highest leader on the Market Impact axis.

Explore more

Toggle awards card detail view

We are a Leader in inaugural IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Life Sciences R&D Lab of the Future Technology Solutions and Consulting Services 2024 Vendor Assessment

In the report, Accenture is positioned as a Leader for both “Strategies” and “Capabilities”.

The IDC MarketScape evaluated 13 vendors who provide services to help implement a Lab of the Future (LotF) strategy and transform and modernize labs across the value chain, from experiment design to manufacturing.

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digitize what you make, revolutionize how you make it

Reimagine the products you make and how you make them. Use data, digital and AI to increase resiliency and productivity and improve security and sustainability across the value chain.

Ecosystem Partners

Ecosystem Partners

From change to value faster

Reinvention doesn’t happen in a silo. Fast-track your journey with integrated applications and platforms that bring the latest industry- and function-specific capabilities, plus advanced data and AI offerings, to empower your people and business.

Emerging Technology

Emerging Technology

Shape the future

In a rapidly changing world, embrace emerging technology to transform and achieve greater efficiency, effectiveness, and breakthrough innovation.

Finance and Risk Management

Finance and Risk Management

Investing to build resilience and reduce enterprise risk

Amid intensifying market disruptions and escalating business volatility, there’s more pressure on Chief Financial Officers (CFOs) and Chief Risk Officers (CROs) to balance multiple interconnected transformations while sustaining company performance, profitability and safety.

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Plan, manage and execute capital projects efficiently

Combine human ingenuity with data and AI to deliver large-scale projects on time and within budget, while also achieving broader investment and sustainability objectives.

Learning

Learning

Become a talent creator

While technology plays a key role in business reinvention, it’s your people who determine its success. How can you build the skills they want, and you need, to grow faster?

Managed Services

Managed Services

Change more, faster

As organizations strive to optimize cost and accelerate growth, strategic managed services can help to better prepare them to reinvent operations and drive holistic value at scale.

Marketing and Experience

Marketing and Experience

Marketing for a multidimensional world

Options multiply. Consumer demands evolve. What’s trending today may not be tomorrow. Relevance is essential for growth—create customer experiences that keep up with change.

Metaverse

Metaverse

Make magic in the metaverse

The physical and virtual worlds are blending. The metaverse offers new ways to connect, create and consume. And it’s a fresh chance to make totally inclusive, responsible experiences.

Sales and Commerce

Sales and Commerce

Commerce at the speed of life

Commerce has blended into culture as preferences shift moment to moment. The challenge? Keeping up. Stay relevant by matching the pace and turning complexity into convenience.

Strategy

Strategy

Leading in the next decade

Boldly commit to continuous reinvention and join the small but growing number of companies reaching new levels of profitable growth for their businesses, while also providing greater contributions to humanity.

Supply Chain

Supply Chain

Lead the future with supply chain networks

Anticipate and respond to customer demand. Resilient by design and able to withstand disruptions, supply chain networks drive efficiency, sustainability and growth.

Sustainability

Sustainability

The sustainability imperative

Sustainability spans environmental, social and governance issues. Today every organization must embrace sustainability for future competitiveness.

Talent and Organization

Talent and Organization

Driving growth through people and technology

Thriving organizations are driving change at the intersection of technology and talent. The powerful combination of data and AI and real human experience unlocks new work structures, roles and environments which enable people and businesses to thrive.

Technology Transformation

Technology Transformation

Transform your technology to deliver change faster

Reinvent your digital core with the right strategy, talent and modern practices to increase ROI, drive efficiency and redirect spend to innovations that drive growth.

~250 partnerships to help accelerate change

View all partners

Industries

Unmatched industry expertise

Aerospace and Defense

Aerospace and Defense

Navigate headwinds

From economic uncertainty and supply chain disruptions to skill gaps and shifting consumer expectations, the Aerospace and Defense industry is being challenged. The time is now to embrace a digital-first mindset.

Automotive

Automotive

Get beyond the wheel

The traditional automotive industry has reached a crossroads. We are now operating in a mobility ecosystem, shifting into the next iteration of automotive. To move forward, it’s time to embrace the ecosystem, collaborate beyond industry lines, and find new ways of innovating and partnering for success.

Banking

Banking

Building the next generation of banks

Technology has changed the way people and businesses bank, and traditional strategies no longer work. Now is the time for bold new approaches to intensifying disruption.

Capital Markets

Capital Markets

Capital Markets: See opportunity everywhere

A growing number of retail investors. The transition to low-carbon economies. Infrastructure investments in growing markets. For those who reinvent, constant change is constant opportunity.

Chemicals

Chemicals

Embrace change as a constant

Traditionally seen as a mature, static industry, chemical companies are facing building pressure to move from reactive to proactive and speed innovation.

Communications and Media

Communications and Media

Be hyper-essential for the hyper-connected

People and businesses are always on, whether watching, working, or enabling innovative new growth. Keep them engaged and successful by delivering the continuous experiences and capabilities they expect and need.

Consumer Goods and Services

Consumer Goods and Services

Humans are reinventing the Consumer Goods and Services industry

In the age of digital commerce, it is hard to predict what consumers will buy – and why, when and where they buy it. To stay ahead of uncertainty, think like a consumer and focus on building strong relationships.

Energy

Energy

Use disruption to fuel change

Demand is up. Competition is fierce. People expect sustainability. With inflationary pressures, supply chain network disruptions, and an increased focus on security, energy companies need to change today to compete tomorrow.

Health

Health

Humanizing healthcare

People expect intuitive access to their healthcare and personalized experiences. Leaders that reinvent to create easy access and engaging experiences will stay resilient while delivering better outcomes.

High Tech

High Tech

Transforming the industry that transforms the world

The pressure is on to build innovative tech products and services, reimagine supply chain and manufacturing networks and identify new talent sources. Those who reinvent will lead.

Industrial

Industrial

Excelling at speed in Industrial

A myriad of trends from technology shifts to evolving B2B customer expectations, software-driven product purpose, enhanced services and more are driving companies to embrace continuous reinvention. The time is now to redefine industrial business models.

Insurance

Insurance

Change for resilience

Insurance is protection. As people and societies continuously change, carriers must digitize, connect and personalize to meet today’s more complex customer needs.

Life Science

Life Science

Redefining the possible in Life Sciences

To address the changing needs of patients, rising costs, demands for new treatments, and the need for accelerated R&D innovation, life sciences organizations must adopt a modern transformation approach.

Natural Resources

Natural Resources

Be a steward of the world’s natural resources

As the world looks towards decarbonization, mining, metals, forest products and building materials companies face increasing pressure to shift from being resource producers to resource stewards.

Public Service

Public Service

Create meaningful impact today and build stronger communities for tomorrow

Facing limited resources, increasingly rapid technology advances and a state of perma-crisis, public service organizations who embrace continuous change can have meaningful impact on outcomes for individuals and entire communities.

Private Equity

Private Equity

Reinvent the ways you create value

The next generation of private equity leaders will use an expanded set of value levers to achieve better outcomes.

Retail

Retail

Reset responsibly

Now is the time to responsibly reset, which means better serving the needs of customers, employees and the communities where they live and work. The challenge is to leverage both digital and physical retail experiences to meet new demands—without compromising results.

Software and Platforms

Software and Platforms

A new dawn for the Software & Platforms Industry

The next chapter of hypergrowth is here. Expanded tech, the battle for attention, and macroeconomic shifts have all led to an industry inflection point, with new opportunities on the horizon.

Travel

Travel

Discover new destinations

The travel industry is no stranger to disruption. And in the post-pandemic world, travel companies must continuously reinvent to outwit unforeseen circumstances, while providing cohesive, elevated experiences for customers.

US Federal Government

US Federal Government

Your mission at the forefront of change

Staying ahead of change is essential to ensure your agency can take on any mission, mandate, or moment, so the US federal government can keep doing the extraordinary things it takes to make the nation stronger, safer, and life better for everyone.

Utilities

Utilities

Radically reinventing power for net zero

Utilities are the cornerstone in the transition to a carbon-neutral world. Achieving net-zero ambitions requires radical moves toward reinvention that will generate sustainable value for all.

See reinvention in action

Every day, we help our clients reinvent their businesses to reach their full potential. Using technology, data, AI and new ways of working. We push boundaries and shape the future of industries.

View client stories

We are an Industry of One

In the 2024 report, Accenture received the highest score in the Current Offering category, and among the highest scores in the Strategy and Market Presence categories.

The research conducted by Forrester evaluated 12 Workday services providers across 25 criteria, including Workday Human Capital Management, Workday Financial Management, Workday Extend and cloud platform, Workday Adaptive Planning, and Workday Analytics and Reporting (Prism).

For this research, Everest Group assessed 34 marketing services providers. Accenture is the highest Leader on the Vision and Capability axis and the highest leader on the Market Impact axis.

The IDC MarketScape evaluated 13 vendors who provide services to help implement a Lab of the Future (LotF) strategy and transform and modernize labs across the value chain, from experiment design to manufacturing.

Capabilities

Case studies

Awards

Reinvent what your business could be

Our wide range of capabilities, ecosystem partnerships and unmatched industry expertise can help your business become the next best version of itself.

Capabilities

The capabilities to help you reinvent

Cloud

Cloud

Take the world by cloud

Every day, cloud computing becomes more integral in driving reinvention, and meeting the ever-changing needs of people around the world.

Customer Service

Customer Service

Turn customer service and proactive support into a growth engine

Impersonal and inconsistent interactions are leaving organizations scrambling to understand how to better support customers. Delivering seamless, data-driven experiences that feel intuitive, not reactive, is vital to unlocking new opportunities for growth.

Cybersecurity

Cybersecurity

De-risk tomorrow by boosting cybersecurity today

Infuse cybersecurity into your strategy and ecosystem to protect value, help prevent threat and build trust as you grow.

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Data and Artificial Intelligence

Use AI with purpose

AI is more accessible than ever, and it’s rapidly transforming enterprises and the ways we live and work. The way you apply its potential will determine the impact and position your business to compete and achieve new levels of performance.

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digital Engineering and Manufacturing

Digitize what you make, revolutionize how you make it

Reimagine the products you make and how you make them. Use data, digital and AI to increase resiliency and productivity and improve security and sustainability across the value chain.

Ecosystem Partners

Ecosystem Partners

From change to value faster

Reinvention doesn’t happen in a silo. Fast-track your journey with integrated applications and platforms that bring the latest industry- and function-specific capabilities, plus advanced data and AI offerings, to empower your people and business.

Emerging Technology

Emerging Technology

Shape the future

In a rapidly changing world, embrace emerging technology to transform and achieve greater efficiency, effectiveness, and breakthrough innovation.

Finance and Risk Management

Finance and Risk Management

Investing to build resilience and reduce enterprise risk

Amid intensifying market disruptions and escalating business volatility, there’s more pressure on Chief Financial Officers (CFOs) and Chief Risk Officers (CROs) to balance multiple interconnected transformations while sustaining company performance, profitability and safety.

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Infrastructure and Capital Projects

Plan, manage and execute capital projects efficiently

Combine human ingenuity with data and AI to deliver large-scale projects on time and within budget, while also achieving broader investment and sustainability objectives.

Learning

Learning

Become a talent creator

While technology plays a key role in business reinvention, it’s your people who determine its success. How can you build the skills they want, and you need, to grow faster?

Managed Services

Managed Services

Change more, faster

As organizations strive to optimize cost and accelerate growth, strategic managed services can help to better prepare them to reinvent operations and drive holistic value at scale.

Marketing and Experience

Marketing and Experience

Marketing for a multidimensional world

Options multiply. Consumer demands evolve. What’s trending today may not be tomorrow. Relevance is essential for growth—create customer experiences that keep up with change.

Metaverse

Metaverse

Make magic in the metaverse

The physical and virtual worlds are blending. The metaverse offers new ways to connect, create and consume. And it’s a fresh chance to make totally inclusive, responsible experiences.

Sales and Commerce

Sales and Commerce

Commerce at the speed of life

Commerce has blended into culture as preferences shift moment to moment. The challenge? Keeping up. Stay relevant by matching the pace and turning complexity into convenience.

Strategy

Strategy

Leading in the next decade

Boldly commit to continuous reinvention and join the small but growing number of companies reaching new levels of profitable growth for their businesses, while also providing greater contributions to humanity.

Supply Chain

Supply Chain

Lead the future with supply chain networks

Anticipate and respond to customer demand. Resilient by design and able to withstand disruptions, supply chain networks drive efficiency, sustainability and growth.

Sustainability

Sustainability

The sustainability imperative

Sustainability spans environmental, social and governance issues. Today every organization must embrace sustainability for future competitiveness.

Talent and Organization

Talent and Organization

Driving growth through people and technology

Thriving organizations are driving change at the intersection of technology and talent. The powerful combination of data and AI and real human experience unlocks new work structures, roles and environments which enable people and businesses to thrive.

Technology Transformation

Technology Transformation

Transform your technology to deliver change faster

Reinvent your digital core with the right strategy, talent and modern practices to increase ROI, drive efficiency and redirect spend to innovations that drive growth.

~250 partnerships to help accelerate change

View all partners

Industries

Unmatched industry expertise

Aerospace and Defense

Aerospace and Defense

Navigate headwinds

From economic uncertainty and supply chain disruptions to skill gaps and shifting consumer expectations, the Aerospace and Defense industry is being challenged. The time is now to embrace a digital-first mindset.

Automotive

Automotive

Get beyond the wheel

The traditional automotive industry has reached a crossroads. We are now operating in a mobility ecosystem, shifting into the next iteration of automotive. To move forward, it’s time to embrace the ecosystem, collaborate beyond industry lines, and find new ways of innovating and partnering for success.

Banking

Banking

Building the next generation of banks

Technology has changed the way people and businesses bank, and traditional strategies no longer work. Now is the time for bold new approaches to intensifying disruption.

Capital Markets

Capital Markets

Capital Markets: See opportunity everywhere

A growing number of retail investors. The transition to low-carbon economies. Infrastructure investments in growing markets. For those who reinvent, constant change is constant opportunity.

Chemicals

Chemicals

Embrace change as a constant

Traditionally seen as a mature, static industry, chemical companies are facing building pressure to move from reactive to proactive and speed innovation.

Communications and Media

Communications and Media

Be hyper-essential for the hyper-connected

People and businesses are always on, whether watching, working, or enabling innovative new growth. Keep them engaged and successful by delivering the continuous experiences and capabilities they expect and need.

Consumer Goods and Services

Consumer Goods and Services

Humans are reinventing the Consumer Goods and Services industry

In the age of digital commerce, it is hard to predict what consumers will buy – and why, when and where they buy it. To stay ahead of uncertainty, think like a consumer and focus on building strong relationships.

Energy

Energy

Use disruption to fuel change

Demand is up. Competition is fierce. People expect sustainability. With inflationary pressures, supply chain network disruptions, and an increased focus on security, energy companies need to change today to compete tomorrow.

Health

Health

Humanizing healthcare

People expect intuitive access to their healthcare and personalized experiences. Leaders that reinvent to create easy access and engaging experiences will stay resilient while delivering better outcomes.

High Tech

High Tech

Transforming the industry that transforms the world

The pressure is on to build innovative tech products and services, reimagine supply chain and manufacturing networks and identify new talent sources. Those who reinvent will lead.

Industrial

Industrial

Excelling at speed in Industrial

A myriad of trends from technology shifts to evolving B2B customer expectations, software-driven product purpose, enhanced services and more are driving companies to embrace continuous reinvention. The time is now to redefine industrial business models.

Insurance

Insurance

Change for resilience

Insurance is protection. As people and societies continuously change, carriers must digitize, connect and personalize to meet today’s more complex customer needs.

Life Science

Life Science

Redefining the possible in Life Sciences

To address the changing needs of patients, rising costs, demands for new treatments, and the need for accelerated R&D innovation, life sciences organizations must adopt a modern transformation approach.

Natural Resources

Natural Resources

Be a steward of the world’s natural resources

As the world looks towards decarbonization, mining, metals, forest products and building materials companies face increasing pressure to shift from being resource producers to resource stewards.

Public Service
